title: If AI Takes Over Management, What's Left for Leaders?
affiliations: HEC Paris, HEC Paris and HEC Paris

detail.title: If AI Takes Over Management, What's Left for Leaders?
detail.abstract: How will managerial work evolve as AI systems increasingly automate organizational tasks? We argue that many managerial responsibilities–such as performance monitoring, scheduling, and compliance–are susceptible to partial automation, given their rule-based and structured nature. By contrast, tasks that rely heavily on creative and social intelligence–such as team building and employee development–are likely to remain more resistant to automation. Leadership activities, including articulating a vision, inspiring teams, and navigating crises, may be especially resilient, as they depend on forms of human intelligence that current AI systems cannot easily replicate.

AI.tldr: 管理工作的自动化程度将因任务性质而异：绩效监控、排班、合规等结构化任务容易被AI部分自动化，而团队建设、员工发展等依赖创造性和社交智能的任务更难被自动化，领导力活动（如愿景阐述、团队激励、危机应对）尤其具有韧性。
AI.research_question: AI系统日益自动化组织任务时，管理工作将如何演变？
AI.motivation: 随着AI技术在组织中的广泛应用，理解哪些管理职责将被自动化、哪些将保持人类主导具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于任务结构性和对特定智能类型的依赖程度来预测管理工作的自动化潜力。
AI.method: 概念性分析，基于任务特征（规则性、结构化程度）和对智能类型（创造性、社交性）的需求进行分类。
AI.findings: 结构化、规则性的管理任务（绩效监控、排班、合规）容易被AI部分自动化；依赖创造性和社交智能的任务（团队建设、员工发展）更难自动化；领导力活动（愿景阐述、团队激励、危机应对）最具韧性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于任务特征和所需智能类型的管理工作自动化潜力分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织在AI时代重新设计管理角色、培训管理者技能提供了指导，帮助管理者专注于AI难以替代的核心领导能力。

title: Strategic Governance of Healthcare Cyber Resilience: An Enterprise Architecture Analysis of Cognitive Bias Amplification
affiliations: University of Liverpool

detail.title: Strategic Governance of Healthcare Cyber Resilience: An Enterprise Architecture Analysis of Cognitive Bias Amplification

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no potential conflicts of interest with respect to the research, authorship, and/or publication of this article.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, patients, or personal health data. It is based entirely on publicly available documents, official government reports, and secondary literature. Therefore, formal ethics approval was not required under institutional or NHS research governance frameworks.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.
declarations.clinicalTrialRegistration: Not applicable. This research did not involve any clinical intervention, trial, or experimental treatment and therefore does not require a clinical trial registration number.

detail.abstract:
On 12 May 2017, WannaCry paralysed 80 NHS trusts (out of 236), costing £92m. Microsoft had released patches 58 days earlier at an estimated deployment cost of £2 million — a conservative ~46:1 prevention-to-recovery gap. Despite thorough investigations, new regulations, and enhanced oversight, the 2024 Synnovis attack cost £32.7m, underscoring the persistence of the pattern.

This paper uses enterprise architecture to reveal what conventional analysis missed: governance frameworks don't merely fail to prevent cognitive biases — they structurally embed and amplify them. This analysis highlights systemic design effects rather than individual fault — competently designed governance structures following best practice. 

Using architecture alternatives assessment — a TOGAF ADM technique for evaluating competing solutions against requirements, this study evaluates four conventional explanations (resource, process, coordination, and technical debt) against the cognitive bias amplification hypothesis. The latter provides superior explanatory power for systematic failure across 80 independent organisations.

The paper develops a multi-framework synthesis applying lean principles (WIP limits, visual management, flow optimisation) to governance architecture, addressing structural vulnerabilities through quantified implementation pathways. The approach directly transfers to AI governance, where healthcare organisations face identical architectural patterns at compressed time scales.

Drawing on behavioural economics research, this analysis shows that governance structures amplify cognitive biases even with competent decision-makers and sound processes. The analytical framework presented here uses publicly available NAO investigation data and parliamentary testimony; ongoing empirical research through CISO/CIO interviews and Freedom of Information requests will provide direct verification of trust-level characteristics and strengthen causal mechanisms linking governance architecture to cognitive bias amplification. The paper develops practical implementation mechanisms, including board-level cognitive bias correction workshops, with a ready-to-use governance oversight toolkit (Appendix B), enabling NHS Trust boards to discharge cyber resilience responsibilities without micromanaging technical operations.

For Academic Readers: Sections 4-5 demonstrate systematic alternatives analysis (TOGAF ADM) with cognitive psychology theoretical grounding.

For Practitioners: Appendix B provides ready-to-use board oversight questions; Section 5 offers implementation mechanisms within existing NHS structures.

PRACTITIONER RELEVANCE. This working paper directly addresses challenges faced by NHS Trust boards, Chief Information Security Officers, and Chief Information Officers in translating cyber threat intelligence into timely organisational action. The proposed governance architecture modifications — including work-in-progress limits, visual threat dashboards, and progressive chaos engineering — are designed for practical implementation within existing NHS federated structures. The author welcomes critical feedback from healthcare cybersecurity practitioners and NHS governance leaders on: (1) whether the cognitive bias explanation resonates with lived governance experience; (2) the practical feasibility of proposed mechanisms within Trust operational constraints; and (3) implementation barriers not addressed in the current analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文通过企业架构分析揭示，治理框架不仅未能防止认知偏差，反而在结构上嵌入并放大了这些偏差。研究使用TOGAF ADM技术评估了四种传统解释与认知偏差放大假说，发现后者对80个独立组织的系统性失败具有更优解释力。论文开发了将精益原则应用于治理架构的多框架综合方法，并提供了可直接实施的治理监督工具包。
AI.research_question: 为什么即使有完善的治理框架和最佳实践，医疗组织仍然会重复遭受类似的网络安全攻击？
AI.motivation: 2017年WannaCry攻击导致80个NHS信托机构瘫痪，成本9200万英镑，而预防成本仅为200万英镑，预防与恢复成本比为46:1。2024年Synnovis攻击再次造成3270万英镑损失，表明问题模式持续存在。
AI.theoretical_framework: 企业架构理论、认知心理学、行为经济学、精益原则（WIP限制、可视化管理、流程优化）、TOGAF ADM替代方案评估技术
AI.method: 使用TOGAF ADM的架构替代方案评估技术，评估四种传统解释（资源、流程、协调、技术债务）与认知偏差放大假说；结合公开的NAO调查数据和议会证词；通过CISO/CIO访谈和信息自由请求进行实证研究
AI.findings: 治理框架在结构上嵌入并放大了认知偏差，即使有称职的决策者和健全的流程；认知偏差放大假说对系统性失败具有更优解释力
AI.theory_contributions: 开发了将精益原则应用于治理架构的多框架综合方法；建立了治理架构与认知偏差放大的因果机制；为AI治理提供了直接可转移的分析框架
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可直接使用的治理监督工具包；开发了董事会级认知偏差纠正工作坊；提出了在现有NHS结构中可实施的机制，包括WIP限制、可视威胁仪表板和渐进混沌工程

title: Impact of Corporate Tax Implementation on Payroll and Compensation Practices in Dubai's Companies

detail.title: Impact of Corporate Tax Implementation on Payroll and Compensation Practices in Dubai's Companies

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants and therefore did not require ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: The author received no funding for this research.

detail.abstract: The introduction of corporate tax in the UAE has marked a significant shift in the country's business landscape. Effective from June 2023, UAE companies with profits exceeding AED 375,000 are now subject to a 9% corporate tax. This study explores how Dubai-based companies have adapted their payroll and compensation practices in response to the new tax framework. Using secondary data from government publications, financial statements, industry reports, and HR consultancy analyses, this research identifies the key strategies employed by organisations to remain compliant while maintaining employee satisfaction. Findings indicate that companies are restructuring salary packages, enhancing non-taxable benefits, adjusting end-of-service gratuity accruals, and investing in advanced payroll systems. The study also highlights the challenges organisations face, such as increased administrative costs and the need for continuous monitoring of tax regulations. Key Insight: 60% of Dubai companies increased housing allowances to retain employees after the implementation of corporate tax. By providing a comprehensive analysis of corporate tax impacts on HR and finance practices in Dubai, this paper contributes to the understanding of organisational adaptation strategies in emerging tax environments. It offers practical insights for finance professionals and HR managers navigating similar regulatory changes.

AI.tldr: 本文研究迪拜公司在阿联酋实施9%企业所得税后如何调整薪酬和薪资实践。研究发现公司通过重组薪资结构、增加非应税福利、调整服务终了酬金计提等方式应对税收变化，其中60%的迪拜公司增加了住房补贴以留住员工。
AI.research_question: 迪拜公司如何适应新的企业所得税框架，调整其薪资和薪酬实践？
AI.motivation: 阿联酋从2023年6月起对利润超过37.5万迪拉姆的公司征收9%企业所得税，这标志着该国商业环境的重大转变，需要研究企业如何应对这一变化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织适应理论、税收合规理论、人力资源管理理论
AI.method: 使用政府出版物、财务报表、行业报告和人力资源咨询分析的二手数据
AI.findings: 公司正在重组薪资方案、增强非应税福利、调整服务终了酬金计提，并投资先进的薪资系统；60%的迪拜公司增加了住房补贴以留住员工；组织面临行政成本增加和需要持续监控税收法规的挑战
AI.theory_contributions: 为新兴税收环境中组织适应策略的理解做出贡献
AI.practical_contributions: 为财务专业人员和人力资源管理者在类似监管变化中提供实用见解

title: Disconnected Hearts — The Tech Revolution of Intimacy
affiliations: Independent researcher

detail.title: Disconnected Hearts — The Tech Revolution of Intimacy

declarations.ethicsApproval: No ethics approval
declarations.funderStatement: No funder

detail.abstract: In the twenty-first century, intimacy has undergone a global digital mutation. Technology and economic liberalization have redrawn the boundaries of love, companionship, and identity. Across Asia and Europe, birth rates are declining while online connections are increasing; affection is now mediated through algorithms rather than shared physical spaces. This paper analyzes how automation, gender equality reforms, and economic precarity converge to reshape intimacy. Building on From Steel to Screens (Wardhan, 2025), which traced how deindustrialization commodified human bodies for survival, this volume follows that trajectory into the emotional and digital economies that now commodify desire itself. Together, the two works form a sociological continuum from the collapse of labor to the virtualization of love.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了21世纪亲密关系的数字化变革，探讨自动化、性别平等改革和经济不稳定如何共同重塑亲密关系，延续了从工业化到数字化时代的社会学连续性分析。
AI.research_question: 自动化、性别平等改革和经济不稳定如何共同重塑当代亲密关系？
AI.motivation: 21世纪亲密关系经历了全球数字化变异，技术和经济自由化重新定义了爱、陪伴和身份的边界，亚洲和欧洲出生率下降而在线连接增加，情感通过算法而非共享物理空间来中介。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Wardhan(2025)的《从钢铁到屏幕》理论框架，该理论追踪了去工业化如何将人体商品化以生存，本文延续这一轨迹进入情感和数字经济的分析。
AI.method: 未在摘要中明确说明具体研究方法。
AI.findings: 亲密关系正在经历数字化变异，爱、陪伴和身份的边界被技术和经济自由化重新定义，情感通过算法中介而非物理空间共享。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了从劳动力崩溃到爱情虚拟化的社会学连续性分析框架，将去工业化与数字化亲密关系联系起来。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了当代社会亲密关系变革的深层机制，为理解数字化时代人际关系变化提供了重要视角。

title: Algorithmic Bias and the Diversity Paradox in Leadership
affiliations: Queen's University

detail.title: Algorithmic Bias and the Diversity Paradox in Leadership
detail.abstract: We study how algorithmic biases in recruitment affect top management diversity. Individuals differ in talent and invest in human capital before appointment. When appointment thresholds differ systematically across groups, a higher threshold lowers entry-level representation but can raise representation at the top. By motivating the most talented individuals to invest more, higher thresholds generate a thicker upper tail of the ability distribution. Consequently, diversity at senior levels may increase even as entry-level diversity declines. The model challenges the "pipeline argument" and predicts that algorithmic biases may improve top-management diversity in meritocratic firms but reduce it in less meritocratic ones.

AI.tldr: 算法偏见在招聘中可能通过提高某些群体的进入门槛，激励最有才华的个体进行更多人力资本投资，从而增加高层管理的多样性，即使入门级多样性下降。
AI.research_question: 算法偏见如何影响高层管理团队的多样性？
AI.motivation: 挑战传统的"管道论"观点，探讨算法偏见可能对组织高层多样性产生的复杂影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人力资本投资理论、能力分布理论、算法偏见理论
AI.method: 理论建模分析，考虑个体天赋差异和人力资本投资决策
AI.findings: 更高的任命门槛会降低入门级代表性，但可能通过激励最有才华的个体增加投资，产生更厚的能力分布上尾，从而提高高层多样性。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了传统的"管道论"，提出了算法偏见可能对高层多样性产生积极影响的新机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织设计招聘算法和多样性政策提供了新视角，特别是在精英主义和非精英主义公司中的不同影响。

title: Emerging Growth Industries vs. Macroeconomic Shocks: Small-Cap and Large-Cap Volatility Divergence from Traditional Patterns
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Emerging Growth Industries vs. Macroeconomic Shocks: Small-Cap and Large-Cap Volatility Divergence from Traditional Patterns

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I am affiliated with Nova Research mentor Gladys Teng that helped me analyze data and guided me in my research work.

detail.abstract: Although there is comprehensive research on sensitivity of large-cap and small-cap stocks to macroeconomic shocks, a significant gap remains regarding whether these relationships persist within emerging high-growth industries that are increasingly significant in the modern economy. This study analyzes lead-lag relationships between macroeconomic factors (Federal Funds Rate (FFR) and Consumer Price Index (CPI)) and three prominent emerging industries: biotechnology, clean energy, and robotics from 2005 to 2025 (macroeconomic factors only 2013-2021). It also tracks the relationship between the same macroeconomic indicators and volatility of stocks based on capitalization (small-cap and large-cap, represented by the Russell 2000 Volatility Index (RVX) and the CBOE Volatility Index (VIX)). Using Granger causality and cross-correlation analyses on daily returns, I find that VIX consistently leads RVX, confirming the information flow hypothesis from liquid large-caps to less efficient small-caps. However, the Autoregressive Distributed Lag Model (ARDL) reveals that broad market volatility does not consistently drive the emerging sectors of the economy. Instead, it identifies such interdependencies as a strong bidirectional relationship between robotics and clean energy and robotics leading biotech. These findings suggest that emerging growth industries are primarily driven by technological innovations and policies rather than broad market trends, questioning conventional approaches to creating and managing portfolios and challenging the traditional view of this newly established sector as a uniform asset class.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了宏观经济因素（联邦基金利率和消费者价格指数）与三个新兴行业（生物技术、清洁能源和机器人技术）之间的领先滞后关系，发现新兴增长行业主要由技术创新和政策驱动，而非广泛市场趋势，这对传统投资组合管理方法提出了挑战。
AI.research_question: 宏观经济因素与新兴高增长行业之间是否存在领先滞后关系？这些关系是否与基于市值的股票波动性关系一致？
AI.motivation: 尽管已有大量关于大盘股和小盘股对宏观经济冲击敏感性的研究，但对于这些关系是否在现代经济中日益重要的新兴高增长行业中持续存在，仍存在显著空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息流假说（从流动性强的大盘股流向效率较低的小盘股）、领先滞后关系理论、新兴行业驱动因素理论
AI.method: 使用格兰杰因果关系和互相关分析日收益率数据，并应用自回归分布滞后模型（ARDL）
AI.findings: VIX持续领先于RVX，证实了信息从流动性强的大盘股流向效率较低的小盘股的假说；但广泛市场波动并不持续驱动新兴行业；机器人技术与清洁能源之间存在强双向关系，机器人技术领先于生物技术
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了将新兴行业视为统一资产类别的传统观点，提出了新兴行业主要由技术创新和政策驱动的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 对创建和管理投资组合的传统方法提出质疑，为投资者在新兴行业投资决策提供新视角

title: Bitcoin: Keep “Hodling”?
affiliations: UVA Darden and University of Virginia - Darden School of Business

detail.title: Bitcoin: Keep “Hodling”?

publicationDetails.journalName: Darden Case Collection

detail.abstract:
This case examines a fictional hedge fund manager's decision about whether to maintain his fund's position in bitcoin. It provides an opportunity for students to develop an investment thesis for or against bitcoin, evaluate alternative ways to gain exposure to bitcoin, and consider bitcoin's economic function (e.g., as a currency or commodity). The case can be used in an MBA elective course on fintech, capital markets, or investments.

Excerpt

Bitcoin: Keep “Hodling”?

Whether it goes up or down in the next year, or five or 10 years, I don't know. But the one thing I'm pretty sure of is that [Bitcoin]doesn't produce anything. It's got a magic to it and people have attached magic to lots of things.

—Warren Buffet, chairman and CEO, Berkshire Hathaway Inc.

I think the average investor should ask himself or herself what do you have in your portfolio that has [Bitcoin's] kind of track record—number one; is very, very underpenetrated; can provide a service of insurance against financial catastrophe that no one else can provide; and can go up ten times or fifty times. The answer is: nothing.

—Bill Miller, founder, chairman, CIO, Miller Value Partners

In mid-September 2025, John Brown, a hedge fund manager based in Miami, was reviewing his portfolio. His focus was on the fund's position in bitcoin. Brown had initiated a small position in the cryptocurrency (crypto) at the urging of one of the fund's limited partners (LPs) four years earlier. The bet had paid off, with the price of bitcoin more than doubling over the last four years (Exhibit 1). The path to get there, however, had been brutal.

AI.tldr: 该案例探讨一位虚构的对冲基金经理关于是否维持比特币持仓的决定，为学生提供机会来制定投资论点、评估比特币敞口方式，并思考比特币的经济功能。
AI.research_question: 对冲基金经理是否应该维持比特币持仓？
AI.motivation: 比特币作为一种新兴资产类别，其投资价值和风险需要系统评估，特别是在价格波动剧烈的情况下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于价值投资理论、资产配置理论和风险管理理论，结合比特币的特殊属性进行分析。
AI.method: 案例分析方法，通过虚构对冲基金经理的决策情境，结合比特币价格历史数据和专家观点。
AI.findings: 比特币投资存在显著风险和不确定性，但同时也具有独特的投资价值，需要基于个人投资目标和风险承受能力进行评估。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了传统投资理论在加密货币领域的应用，提供了评估新型数字资产的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为MBA学生和投资从业者提供了分析比特币投资决策的实用工具和方法论。

title: Stack: Capturing the Future of Digital Finance
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Stack: Capturing the Future of Digital Finance

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No personal or financial relationships with organizations or individuals influenced the research or conclusions in this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable; this study does not involve human participants, patients, or identifiable personal data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was self-funded by the author.

detail.abstract:
Audience:

Anyone seeking to understand the future of money, investing, and digital sovereignty-from newcomers to professionals navigating economic change. 

Objective:

To explain the evolution of digital finance, the structural shifts in global markets, and why frameworks like STACK provide disciplined, repeatable strategies for participating intelligently in this new era. This guide is written to help readers of all backgrounds understand not just how to participate, but why this transformation is inevitable, and how structured approaches allow participants to capture asymmetric opportunity while managing risk.

AI.tldr: 本文解释了数字金融的演变、全球市场的结构性转变，以及为什么像STACK这样的框架为智能参与这个新时代提供了有纪律、可重复的策略。
AI.research_question: 数字金融如何演变？全球市场发生了哪些结构性转变？为什么需要框架如STACK来智能参与这个新时代？
AI.motivation: 帮助不同背景的读者理解数字金融转型的必然性，以及如何通过结构化方法在管理风险的同时捕捉不对称机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字金融演变理论、全球市场结构性转变理论、风险管理理论。
AI.method: 解释性分析，框架介绍。
AI.findings: 数字金融的演变和全球市场的结构性转变是不可避免的，STACK等框架提供了有纪律、可重复的策略来智能参与这个新时代。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了数字金融演变和全球市场结构性转变的理论解释，强调了结构化方法在捕捉机会和管理风险中的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为读者提供了参与数字金融新时代的实用策略和框架，帮助他们在管理风险的同时捕捉不对称机会。

title: Talking to Hire: How Small Firms Pave their Way to Hire When Large Firms Lay Off
affiliations: Northwestern University - Kellogg School of Management, Northwestern University - Kellogg School of Management and

detail.title: Talking to Hire: How Small Firms Pave their Way to Hire When Large Firms Lay Off
detail.abstract: We study how firms change their hiring and disclosure strategies when they face greater hiring opportunities. In the setting of the technology industry's massive layoffs, we find evidence that small firms signal increased hiring intent and enhance their information environment when large firms in the same industry engage in layoffs. Specifically, small firms post more jobs following large firms' downsizing, with the increase primarily concentrated in roles related to information technology. Small firms with greater hiring intent further increase the length of their job postings to provide more information to their prospective employees. Using state-of-the-art machine learning technology, we analyze the content of job postings and find that small firms' job postings following layoffs contain more information about the company and the job description, as well as more specific keywords related to corporate culture and information technology. Using LinkedIn data, we present preliminary evidence of small firms' strategies being successful, as we observe a disproportionate flow of employees towards small firms. In additional analysis, we find evidence of small firms engaging in more innovative activities following the layoffs, consistent with human capital being an important driver of innovation. Overall, our paper suggests that firms traditionally at a disadvantage in attracting top talent respond to large-scale layoffs as an opportunity to grow their workforce. Further, firms seeking to hire during layoffs enhance the informational content of job postings to attract and inform prospective employees during periods of increased labor supply.

AI.tldr: 本文研究科技行业大规模裁员背景下，小企业如何调整招聘和信息披露策略。研究发现小企业在大企业裁员时增加招聘意向，特别是IT相关职位，并通过延长职位描述长度来提供更多信息，成功吸引了更多员工流向小企业。
AI.research_question: 当企业面临更多招聘机会时，它们如何改变招聘和信息披露策略？
AI.motivation: 研究科技行业大规模裁员背景下，小企业如何利用这一机会来吸引人才，填补传统上在人才竞争中的劣势。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信号理论和信息环境理论，探讨企业在劳动力市场变化时的策略调整行为。
AI.method: 使用机器学习技术分析职位发布内容，结合LinkedIn数据追踪员工流动模式。
AI.findings: 小企业在大企业裁员后增加招聘，特别是IT职位；职位描述更长、信息更丰富；成功吸引更多员工流向小企业；裁员后小企业创新活动增加。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了信号理论在招聘策略中的应用，深化了对企业信息环境动态调整的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为小企业提供了在人才竞争中的有效策略，展示了如何利用市场机会吸引顶尖人才。

title: Operational Linguistic Wisdom: Elective Connectivity and Linguistic Capital Activation in the Age of LLMs

detail.title: Operational Linguistic Wisdom: Elective Connectivity and Linguistic Capital Activation in the Age of LLMs

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no personal, financial, or organizational conflicts of interest that could have influenced the development of this conceptual–reflective paper. All conceptual frameworks and arguments were developed independently by the author through academic synthesis and AI-assisted drafting under full author supervision.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper is a conceptual and reflective study. It does not involve human participants, personal data, or experimental interventions; therefore, formal ethics approval was not required. All discussions of organizational examples are hypothetical and used solely for illustrative purposes.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant or financial support from any funding agency, public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The work was self-initiated and developed under the independent conceptual research program of Araya Nikah Social Enterprise Co., Ltd., Thailand.

detail.abstract: Prior scholarship largely treats language as a communication channel. In LLM-enabled contexts, language can be designed as cognitive infrastructure that activates organizational linguistic capital. This paper articulates a three-stage mechanism-Elective Connectivity, Capability Activation, and Reflexive Reconfiguration-that operationalizes this shift. Purpose. To formalize a testable conceptual model extending Operational Linguistic Wisdom (OLW) and the AI Value Reflection Hypothesis (AVRH) by specifying how linguistic capital can be ethically activated with LLMs. Design/methodology. Conceptual-reflective synthesis grounded in established theory (Bourdieu; Nonaka; Floridi). The paper provides construct clarity, propositions, boundary conditions, risks, and an illustrative vignette. No empirical claims are made. Findings (conceptual). Language can function as cognitive infrastructure when (i) connection to LLMs is elective and governed, (ii) dialogic prompting routines surface tacit knowledge and align values, and (iii) reflective insights are institutionalized into policies and processes. Originality/value. Reframes language from a carrier to an operable substrate for value reflection; specifies mechanisms, risks, and governance required for responsible organizational use of LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出语言在LLM环境下可作为认知基础设施，通过三阶段机制（选择性连接、能力激活、反思性重构）来激活组织语言资本，为负责任使用LLM提供理论框架。
AI.research_question: 在LLM赋能的环境中，语言如何从沟通渠道转变为可操作的认知基础设施来激活组织语言资本？
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要将语言视为沟通渠道，但在LLM环境下，语言可以设计为激活组织语言资本的认知基础设施。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Bourdieu、Nonaka和Floridi的理论，结合操作性语言智慧（OLW）和AI价值反思假说（AVRH）。
AI.method: 概念反思性综合方法，提供概念清晰度、命题、边界条件、风险分析和说明性案例，无实证主张。
AI.findings: 语言作为认知基础设施需要：(i)选择性且受治理的LLM连接；(ii)对话式提示程序挖掘隐性知识并调整价值观；(iii)反思性见解制度化到政策和流程中。
AI.theory_contributions: 将语言从载体重新定义为价值反思的可操作基底；具体说明机制、风险和治理要求。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织负责任使用LLM提供具体机制、风险管理和治理框架，促进语言资本的伦理激活。

title: Daily Recovery Experiences of Japanese Small Business Owners and the Link with Well-Being and Ill-Being
affiliations: Erasmus University Rotterdam (EUR) - Centre for Advanced Small Business Economics (CASBEC), Montpellier Business School, Kwansei Gakuin University, Leiden University and

detail.title: Daily Recovery Experiences of Japanese Small Business Owners and the Link with Well-Being and Ill-Being

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: Numerous studies deal with the link between daily recovery experiences (DRE) and mental health for employees. Hardly any studies exist for small business owners. This is surprising given that their health is not just important for themselves but also for their environment (such as employees, clients, suppliers, networks). In the present study we analyse if this link also works for some 2,400 Japanese small business owners. Next to overall DRE, four dimensions of DRE are distinguished (detachment, relaxation, mastery, and control). Mental health is captured using well-being (psychological well-being and job satisfaction) and ill-being (burnout and stress). First, we compare our DRE levels with many other (employee) studies. Second, controlling for many phenomena including participating in nomikai (a typical Japanese custom of getting together after office hours), we show that the quality of overall DRE is positively linked to well-being, and negatively to ill-being. Third, like the quality of overall DRE, nomikai activities of the owner are positively linked to their psychological well-being and job satisfaction, and negatively to burnout and stress. Its role seems to be independent of that of the quality of DRE.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨日本小企业主的日常恢复体验与心理健康的关系，发现整体DRE质量与幸福感正相关、与不良状态负相关，同时发现nomikai活动对心理健康有独立积极影响。
AI.research_question: 日本小企业主的日常恢复体验是否与心理健康相关？nomikai活动在其中扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注员工的日常恢复体验与心理健康，但小企业主的相关研究很少，而他们的健康不仅对自身重要，也影响员工、客户等环境。
AI.theoretical_framework: 日常恢复体验理论，包括四个维度：脱离、放松、掌控和精通；心理健康包括幸福感（心理幸福感和工作满意度）和不良状态（倦怠和压力）。
AI.method: 对约2400名日本小企业主进行实证研究，控制包括nomikai参与在内的多个变量，分析DRE与心理健康的关系。
AI.findings: 1）整体DRE质量与幸福感正相关、与不良状态负相关；2）nomikai活动独立于DRE，对心理健康有积极影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 将日常恢复体验理论扩展到小企业主群体，发现nomikai作为文化特定因素对心理健康的独立作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为小企业主提供改善心理健康的实践建议，强调日常恢复体验和社交活动的重要性。

title: Beliefs About Bots: How Employers Plan for AI in White-Collar Work
affiliations: ZEW – Leibniz Centre for European Economic Research, University of Mannheim and University of Mannheim

detail.title: Beliefs About Bots: How Employers Plan for AI in White-Collar Work

publicationDetails.detailsText: ZEW - Centre for European Economic Research Discussion Paper No. 25-057
publicationDetails.journalName: ZEW - Leibniz Centre for European Economic Research Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: We provide experimental evidence on how employers adjust expectations to automation risk in high-skill, white-collar work. Using a randomized information intervention among tax advisors in Germany, we show that firms systematically underestimate automatability. Information provision raises risk perceptions, especially for routine-intensive roles. Yet, it leaves short-run hiring plans unchanged. Instead, updated beliefs increase productivity and financial expectations with minor wage adjustments, implying within-firm inequality like limited rent-sharing. Employers also anticipate new tasks in legal tech, compliance, and AI interaction, and report higher training and adoption intentions.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过随机信息干预实验发现，德国税务顾问公司普遍低估了工作的自动化风险。提供自动化风险信息会提高风险感知，特别是对常规密集型工作，但短期内不影响招聘计划，而是通过提高生产率和财务预期来应对，导致公司内部不平等加剧。
AI.research_question: 雇主如何根据自动化风险调整对高技能白领工作的期望？
AI.motivation: 了解雇主对自动化风险的认知偏差及其对劳动力市场决策的影响，特别是在高技能白领工作领域。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于行为经济学中的认知偏差理论和自动化对劳动力市场影响的理论框架。
AI.method: 在德国税务顾问中进行随机信息干预实验。
AI.findings: 公司系统性低估自动化风险；信息提供提高风险感知，尤其对常规工作；短期招聘计划不变；更新信念提高生产率和财务预期，但工资调整有限，导致公司内部不平等；雇主预期新任务出现，培训和技术采用意愿增强。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了雇主在自动化风险认知上的系统性偏差，以及信息干预如何影响企业决策和内部不平等。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供关于自动化风险信息传播对劳动力市场影响的实证依据，帮助企业更好地应对自动化挑战。

title: When the Goalposts Move: Adaptive Materiality for Resilient Project Outcomes
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: When the Goalposts Move: Adaptive Materiality for Resilient Project Outcomes

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the founder and president of Green Project Management (GPM), the organization that developed the P5 Standard for Sustainability in Project Management referenced in this paper. The author also served as the principal author of the P5 Standard. No financial or external party influenced the research design, analysis, or conclusions presented.

detail.abstract: In this paper, I introduce Adaptive Materiality-a project-level governance approach designed to manage sustainability issues that do not stand still. Projects unfold within shifting social, ecological, and economic systems, and what matters at one moment can lose relevance the next. Drawing on systems thinking, sensemaking, and The GPM P5 Standard for Sustainability in Project Management (Version 3.1)-hereafter referred to as the P5 Standard-I show how continuous stakeholder dialogue and threshold-based triggers can keep governance responsive without adding unnecessary bureaucracy. Three illustrative vignettes-from infrastructure, energy, and digital transformation-demonstrate how adaptability sustains both resilience and legitimacy. The model differentiates Adaptive Materiality from dynamic and double materiality and offers practical indicators for evaluating relevance through time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了适应性重要性概念——一种项目级治理方法，用于管理不断变化的可持续性问题。该方法基于系统思维、意义建构和P5标准，通过持续的利益相关者对话和基于阈值的触发机制来保持治理的响应性。
AI.research_question: 如何设计项目级治理方法来管理不断变化的可持续性问题？
AI.motivation: 项目在动态的社会、生态和经济系统中展开，重要性问题会随时间变化，需要灵活的治理方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 系统思维、意义建构理论、GPM P5可持续性项目管理标准（第3.1版）
AI.method: 通过三个案例研究（基础设施、能源、数字化转型）展示适应性重要性的应用
AI.findings: 适应性重要性模型能够通过持续对话和阈值触发机制保持治理的响应性，同时维持韧性和合法性
AI.theory_contributions: 区分了适应性重要性与动态重要性、双重重要性概念，提供了评估随时间变化相关性的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了评估随时间变化相关性的实用指标，帮助项目管理者在不增加官僚主义的情况下保持治理的适应性

keywords.keywords: Effectiveness of the Motor Vehicle Tax Service System

detail.abstract:
The purpose of this study was to determine and analyze the effectiveness of the motor vehicle tax service system at the Gowa Regional Revenue UPTB, South Sulawesi Provincial Revenue Agency and the factors that hinder the effectiveness of the motor vehicle tax service system.

The data analysis technique used by the researcher is the Qualitative Data Analysis Technique. Research informants were selected by purposive sampling, informants from taxpayers and Gowa Samsat employees. Data collection techniques through interviews, observation and documentation.

The results of the study indicate that the effectiveness of the motor vehicle tax services system at the Gowa Regional Revenue UPTB is quite effective but still needs to be maximized because the slow service process is caused by limited infrastructure, including computers and printers that are often damaged because there are many old computer equipment and are also less able to support application systems that require high technical specifications, and narrow service rooms, and there are still many tables and chairs for service officers that are no longer suitable for use. In addition, the server network is often disrupted/unstable which causes disruption to the application system used when taxpayers make tax payments, and the accessibility of the Main Samsat office is far away so that taxpayers in rural areas need a long time and transportation costs to come to pay taxes to the Samsat office, as well as the lack of regular technical training on excellent service ethics for Human Resources/service officers so that they are less friendly in serving.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了Gowa地区税务局机动车辆税收服务系统的有效性，发现系统虽然基本有效但仍需优化。主要障碍包括基础设施不足（老旧电脑设备、狭窄服务空间）、服务器网络不稳定、偏远地区纳税人交通不便，以及人力资源缺乏服务培训。
AI.research_question: Gowa地区税务局机动车辆税收服务系统的有效性如何？哪些因素阻碍了该系统的有效性？
AI.motivation: 评估和改进机动车辆税收服务系统的效率，为纳税人提供更好的服务体验，提高税收征管效率。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公共服务有效性理论，重点关注基础设施、技术系统和人力资源对服务效率的影响。
AI.method: 定性数据分析技术，通过目的性抽样选择纳税人及Samsat员工作为研究信息提供者，采用访谈、观察和文档分析进行数据收集。
AI.findings: 机动车辆税收服务系统基本有效但需优化。主要问题包括：老旧电脑设备无法支持高规格应用系统、服务器网络不稳定、服务空间狭窄、偏远地区纳税人交通不便、服务人员缺乏定期培训导致服务态度不佳。
AI.theory_contributions: 为公共服务有效性理论提供了实证支持，强调了基础设施、技术系统和人力资源培训在公共服务系统中的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为Gowa地区税务局提供了具体的改进建议，包括更新设备、改善网络稳定性、扩大服务空间、提供远程服务选项以及加强员工服务培训，这些建议可应用于其他类似地区的税收服务系统优化。

title: Of (AI) Machine and Human (Labor): An Integrated Nexus of Work Operating System Architecture for Orchestrating Human-AI Collaborations
affiliations: , Newcastle University and Texas A&M University

detail.title: Of (AI) Machine and Human (Labor): An Integrated Nexus of Work Operating System Architecture for Orchestrating Human-AI Collaborations
detail.abstract: Rapid advances in artificial intelligence (AI) have significantly impacted virtually all aspects of the global society, including especially the labor markets. AI has the potential to transform almost all occupations to various degrees, and in certain labor market segments, has already started to drastically disrupt and reshape the labor market. The optimal approach to the division of labor between humans and AI has become one of the most fundamental focuses for industry practitioners, as well as academic researchers, to achieve ideal human-AI collaborations. Existing literature in the domain investigates usually at the level of work process maps or job descriptions. In this paper, we present Nexus of Work Operating System (NOW OS), the first integrated end-to-end operation system that analyzes human-AI collaboration from the atomic task (the smallest unit of real work tasks) level, and provides comprehensive functionalities of structuring, governing, and optimizing the task redesign, task assignment, and task process reengineering, to achieve the optimal human-AI collaboration for the organization. We present a conceptual model for analysis of human-AI collaboration that serves as the theoretical foundation for our proposed integrated operation system architecture. We detail the technical design of the proposed system functionalities. In addition, we describe a sample case to illustrate how our proposed system operates in an organization. Future directions of the technical development and implementation of the proposed system are also discussed.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了NOW OS系统，这是首个从原子任务层面分析人机协作的端到端操作系统，通过任务重构、分配和流程再造来实现最优人机协作。
AI.research_question: 如何从原子任务层面构建一个集成的人机协作操作系统，以实现组织内最优的人机协作？
AI.motivation: AI正在深刻影响劳动力市场，现有研究多停留在工作流程图或职位描述层面，缺乏从最小工作单元（原子任务）角度分析人机协作的系统性方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于原子任务分析的人机协作概念模型，作为集成操作系统架构的理论基础。
AI.method: 提出NOW OS系统的概念模型和技术设计，包括任务结构化、治理和优化功能，并通过案例研究说明系统运作。
AI.findings: 开发了首个从原子任务层面分析人机协作的端到端操作系统，能够有效支持任务重构、分配和流程再造。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于原子任务的人机协作分析概念模型，为人机协作研究提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: NOW OS系统为组织提供了实现最优人机协作的实用工具，具有任务结构化、治理和优化的综合功能。

detail.abstract:
The report provides an in-depth examination of the state of artificial intelligence (AI) governance and competitiveness across the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) region. It captures how Arab countries are adopting AI technologies, building digital infrastructure, and shaping regulatory frameworks to keep pace with global developments. Based on extensive fieldwork covering 327 AI and digital SMEs across ten countries, the study offers valuable insights into the opportunities and challenges shaping the region’s AI ecosystem.

The two key goals of this research are: to understand and address the growing governance and regulatory challenges resulting from the rapid adoption of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in key MENA markets, as well as the integration of the MENA region in global AI governance efforts. And second, to examine how AI adoption can be leveraged to drive economic growth and regional competitiveness while, in returning to the first goal, ensuring responsible governance. Findings reveal that the UAE and Saudi Arabia are emerging as regional leaders in AI readiness, supported by strong infrastructure, investment, and policy direction, while other MENA countries continue to navigate fragmented regulations, limited funding access, and talent gaps. Despite these disparities, the report highlights growing optimism among businesses and a shared recognition of the role of AI in driving innovation and economic growth.

By emphasizing responsible governance, ethical frameworks, and regional cooperation, the report calls for strengthening AI education, research, and investment to bridge the AI divide and position the MENA region as a competitive and inclusive contributor to the global AI landscape. The study was developed in partnership with Google.org.

AI.tldr: 该报告深入分析了中东和北非地区人工智能治理与竞争力的现状，基于对10个国家327家AI和数字中小企业的实地调查，揭示了该地区AI生态系统的发展机遇与挑战。研究发现阿联酋和沙特在AI准备度方面领先，而其他地区面临监管碎片化、资金不足和人才短缺等问题。报告呼吁加强负责任治理、区域合作，以缩小AI鸿沟。
AI.research_question: 中东和北非地区如何应对AI快速采用带来的治理挑战，以及如何利用AI推动经济增长和区域竞争力？
AI.motivation: 理解并应对中东和北非地区因AI快速采用而日益增长的治理和监管挑战，同时探讨如何利用AI促进经济增长和区域竞争力。
AI.theoretical_framework: AI治理理论、区域竞争力理论、负责任AI框架
AI.method: 基于对10个中东和北非国家327家AI和数字中小企业的广泛实地调查
AI.findings: 阿联酋和沙特在AI准备度方面成为区域领导者，拥有强大的基础设施、投资和政策支持；其他中东和北非国家面临监管碎片化、资金获取有限和人才缺口等挑战；企业对AI推动创新和经济增长的作用持乐观态度
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对中东和北非地区AI治理模式的理解，提出了区域AI竞争力评估框架，丰富了负责任AI治理的理论内涵
AI.practical_contributions: 为中东和北非国家制定AI政策和监管框架提供实证依据；为企业AI采用提供指导；促进区域合作以缩小AI鸿沟；为投资决策提供参考

title: A Strategic AI Safety Imperative: Towards a UAE Artificial Intelligence Safety Institute
affiliations: Mohammed Bin Rashid School of Government and University of Oxford - Blavatnik School of Government

detail.title: A Strategic AI Safety Imperative: Towards a UAE Artificial Intelligence Safety Institute
detail.abstract:
The United Arab Emirates (UAE) stands at a transformative inflection point in its artificial intelligence development journey. While the nation has made significant strides in AI innovation, deployment, solidified by strategic partnerships, a critical gap persists in translating these advancements into global AI security leadership. This policy brief builds the case for establishing a UAE Artificial Intelligence Safety Institute (AISI), both as an urgent national priority and a strategic complement to the Emirates' newly cemented role as the Middle East's AI infrastructure hub. The UAE’s strategic investment in AI was further amplified in mid 2025 by landmark agreements with the United States that position the UAE as a global AI infrastructure leader. The two countries agreed to an investment of $150 billion on AI infrastructure, which includes access to cutting-edge semiconductors and binding security commitments to prevent technology diversion, creates both new opportunities and responsibilities. With Abu Dhabi positioned to host hyperscale AI compute infrastructure capable of serving nearly half the world's population within a 2,000-mile radius, the Emirates now faces imperative to pioneer security frameworks that protect not just national interests but the integrity of global AI ecosystems. The proposed AISI would leverage three strategic advantages:

1) The UAE's established cybersecurity leadership, demonstrated through its world-class threat detection and mitigation capabilities;

2) its unique geopolitical position as a trusted partner to competing AI powers; and

3) The unprecedented scale of sovereign investments in AI infrastructure through vehicles like MGX and G42.

By focusing on advanced AI security research, verification mechanisms, and international coordination, the AISI would address critical gaps in the global AI safety landscape while protecting the UAE’s $1 trillion investments in next-generation technologies. Such step would align with the security obligations of the US-UAE AI Acceleration Partnership, which mandates robust safeguards for American-sourced technologies while enabling the UAE to emerge as a global hub for developing transnational AI safety standards. As frontier AI capabilities advance exponentially, the window for establishing governance frameworks that keep pace with infrastructure growth is closing rapidly. The AISI represents not just a strategic necessity for securing the UAE’s AI ambitions, but an opportunity to redefine global norms for safe, beneficial AI development in an era of intensifying technological competition.

AI.tldr: 本文主张建立阿联酋人工智能安全研究所（AISI），以解决阿联酋在AI基础设施投资激增背景下的安全治理缺口，将技术优势转化为全球AI安全领导力。
AI.research_question: 如何将阿联酋在AI基础设施方面的战略投资转化为全球AI安全领导力？
AI.motivation: 阿联酋在AI基础设施方面获得1500亿美元投资，成为中东AI枢纽，但面临将技术优势转化为安全领导力的关键缺口。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于网络安全领导力、地缘政治优势和大规模主权投资三大战略优势构建AI安全治理框架。
AI.method: 政策分析框架，结合战略优势分析和治理需求评估。
AI.findings: 建立AISI可填补全球AI安全治理空白，保护阿联酋1万亿美元技术投资，同时履行美阿AI合作协议的安全义务。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出将基础设施投资转化为安全领导力的治理模型，强调安全框架与基础设施增长的同步性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为阿联酋提供建立全球AI安全标准的路线图，保护国家投资并重塑全球AI安全规范。

title: Mass Media and Foreign Policy Decision-Making in Emerging Democracies: Insights from Bangladesh

detail.title: Mass Media and Foreign Policy Decision-Making in Emerging Democracies: Insights from Bangladesh
detail.abstract: This study explores the influence of mass media on foreign policy decision-making in emerging democracies, focusing specifically on Bangladesh. It investigates how media shapes policy by serving both as a governmental watchdog and an agenda setter, using the 'CNN effect' framework, which suggests that news coverage can impact political outcomes. The research examines three key dimensions: (1) the potential for media influence; (2) the conditions that facilitate or limit such influence; and (3) recent historical cases that illustrate the media's impact on foreign policy. Empirically, the study draws on semi-structured interviews with ten officials from Bangladesh's Ministry of Foreign Affairs, providing insights into the interaction between media narratives and policy formulation. The findings indicate that while the media does not directly dictate foreign policy, it significantly shapes public opinion, frames discourse, and establishes an environment that influences policymaking. The study presents a conceptual model identifying three roles of media-accelerant, impediment, and agenda-setting agency-offering a framework for understanding the dynamics between media and policy in emerging democracies. This research contributes to global media studies and Bangladesh-specific policy analysis, highlighting the nuanced role of media in shaping governance and public perception.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了大众媒体对新兴民主国家（以孟加拉国为例）外交政策决策的影响，发现媒体通过塑造公众舆论、框定话语和创造影响决策环境来间接影响政策，而非直接决定政策。
AI.research_question: 大众媒体如何影响新兴民主国家的外交政策决策？
AI.motivation: 研究新兴民主国家中媒体与外交政策的互动关系，特别是在孟加拉国这样的背景下，理解媒体作为政府监督者和议程设定者的双重角色。
AI.theoretical_framework: CNN效应框架，即新闻报道可以影响政治结果的理论。
AI.method: 对孟加拉国外交部十名官员进行半结构化访谈的定性研究。
AI.findings: 媒体不直接决定外交政策，但显著影响公众舆论、话语框架和决策环境；提出了媒体作为加速器、障碍和议程设定机构的三重角色模型。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了理解新兴民主国家媒体与政策动态关系的概念模型，丰富了全球媒体研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为孟加拉国政策分析提供了框架，强调了媒体在塑造治理和公众认知中的微妙作用。

title: DGR-KBQA: A Knowledge-Base Question Answering Framework Based on Intent Ranking and Unsupervised Retrieval Refinement
affiliations: Inner Mongolia University and Inner Mongolia University

detail.title: DGR-KBQA: A Knowledge-Base Question Answering Framework Based on Intent Ranking and Unsupervised Retrieval Refinement
detail.abstract: Knowledge Base Question Answering (KBQA) aims to answer natural-language questions by reasoning over structured Knowledge Bases (KBs). Recent approaches increasingly rely on Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate executable logical forms, enabling end-to-end KBQA. However, this paradigm faces two persistent challenges: (i) semantic deviation, where the model fails to capture the true intent of the question and thus generates misaligned logical forms, and (ii) hallucination, where it invents unsupported entities or relations that cannot be executed against the KB. These issues are amplified in multi-hop and compositional queries, ultimately degrading answer accuracy. To address these limitations, we propose DGR-KBQA, a KBQA framework based on intent ranking and unsupervised retrieval refinement. DGR-KBQA follows a Detect–Generate–Retrieve pipeline. First, it detects and ranks candidate intents for a question, selecting the optimal intent to guide downstream reasoning. This intent supervision improves semantic fidelity by conditioning the LLM on what the question is actually asking. Second, conditioned on the question and its optimal intent, a fine-tuned LLM generates a logical form. Third, we apply unsupervised, phrase-level entity and relation retrieval to repair KB-inconsistent generations before executing the resulting query against the KB. We evaluate DGR-KBQA on WebQuestionsSP (WebQSP) and ComplexWebQuestions (CWQ). Experimental results show consistent improvements in F1, Hits@1, and exact-match accuracy over strong IR-based, semantic parsing–based, and LLM-based baselines. These findings demonstrate that explicitly injecting intent guidance and enforcing KB-consistent refinement mitigates hallucination, improves logical-form executability, and leads to more accurate and interpretable KBQA.

AI.tldr: DGR-KBQA是一个基于意图排序和无监督检索优化的KBQA框架，通过检测-生成-检索流程解决语义偏差和幻觉问题，在WebQSP和CWQ数据集上显著提升了问答准确性。
AI.research_question: 如何解决KBQA中LLM生成逻辑形式时的语义偏差和幻觉问题，以提高问答准确性？
AI.motivation: 当前基于LLM的KBQA方法在多跳和组合查询中面临语义偏差（模型未能捕捉问题真实意图）和幻觉（生成KB不支持实体或关系）两大挑战，导致答案准确性下降。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于意图监督和KB一致性约束的理论框架，通过意图检测和排名来指导LLM生成，结合无监督检索优化确保生成内容的可执行性。
AI.method: 提出DGR-KBQA框架，采用检测-生成-检索三阶段流程：1）检测并排序候选意图；2）基于最优意图生成逻辑形式；3）无监督短语级实体关系检索修复KB不一致生成。
AI.findings: 在WebQSP和CWQ数据集上的实验表明，DGR-KBQA在F1、Hits@1和精确匹配准确率上均优于基于IR、语义解析和LLM的基线方法。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了意图监督和KB一致性约束的理论框架，为LLM在KBQA中的可控生成提供了理论指导。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了实用的KBQA框架，显著提升了多跳和组合查询的准确性，为实际KBQA应用提供了有效的解决方案。

title: Cyclicality of Tax Expenditures
affiliations: Hebrew University of Jerusalem _ Public Policy

detail.title: Cyclicality of Tax Expenditures
detail.abstract: This paper provides the first systematic examination of the cyclicality of tax expenditures using panel data for both developed and developing economies. The analysis reveals that tax expenditures exhibit pronounced procyclicality in developing economies, whereas in developed economies they display a countercyclical pattern. These results are consistent with prior research on statutory tax and deficit adjustments across the business cycle. A stylized model further demonstrates that the observed behavior in developing economies is largely anticipated, given that tax expenditures are excluded from the formal budget, thereby creating scope for non-transparent political maneuvering.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统性地研究了税收支出的周期性特征，发现在发展中国家税收支出呈现明显的顺周期性，而在发达国家则呈现逆周期性。这一发现与先前关于法定税收和赤字调整的研究一致。理论模型表明，发展中国家税收支出被排除在正式预算之外，为不透明的政治操作创造了空间。
AI.research_question: 税收支出在不同经济发展水平国家中的周期性特征是什么？
AI.motivation: 首次系统性地研究税收支出的周期性特征，填补了现有文献的空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于税收支出理论和商业周期理论，构建了分析税收支出周期性的理论框架。
AI.method: 使用发达和发展中国家的面板数据进行实证分析，并构建了一个风格化模型。
AI.findings: 发展中国家税收支出呈现顺周期性，发达国家税收支出呈现逆周期性。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统性地揭示了税收支出的周期性特征，为理解税收政策在不同经济发展阶段的作用提供了理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于税收支出管理的重要参考，特别是在发展中国家如何提高税收支出的透明度和问责制方面。

title: The Global Fragility Index: A Path-Independent Measure of Statistical Fragility
affiliations: University of Washington - School of Medicine

detail.title: The Global Fragility Index: A Path-Independent Measure of Statistical Fragility

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no personal, financial, or institutional conflicts of interest related to this study. All analyses were performed independently, with no external influence on design, interpretation, or reporting.
declarations.ethicsApproval: No human or animal subjects were involved. The study is a methodological and computational analysis using publicly available or simulated data.
declarations.funderStatement: This work received no external funding. The author developed all research, software, and documentation without institutional or commercial sponsorship.

detail.abstract:
Background: The fragility index quantifies statistical fragility by counting the number of outcome changes needed to reverse statistical significance. However, it depends on arbitrary event definitions and follows specific toggle rules that may not find the actual minimum perturbation. We introduce the global fragility index, a path-independent measure that identifies the minimum number of observation moves across all possible paths in a contingency table.

Methods: The global fragility index is defined as the minimum number of single-observation moves between cells of a contingency table, with total sample size fixed, required to reverse statistical significance at α=0.05. Unlike the fragility index, which toggles outcomes within a single arm according to specific rules, the global fragility index evaluates all possible cell-to-cell moves to identify the true global minimum. The global fragility quotient normalizes for sample size by dividing the global fragility index by the total sample size. We present the theoretical framework, computational approach, and worked examples for 2×2 and r×c tables.

Results: The global fragility index removes three key dependencies present in existing fragility metrics: (1) event/non-event labeling ambiguity, (2) reference arm selection in balanced designs, and (3) toggle path rules. By definition, the global fragility index will always be less than or equal to the fragility index, since it finds the global minimum while the fragility index follows a predetermined path. The global fragility index naturally extends to multi-group comparisons (r×c tables) using Fisher–Freeman–Halton exact tests. Worked examples demonstrate how the global fragility index provides a more sensitive assessment of study fragility by calculating the global minimum number of single-observation moves required to flip statistical significance.

Conclusions: The global fragility index is a more sensitive measure of fragility, removing arbitrary dependencies and identifying the actual minimum perturbation required to reverse statistical findings. While computationally more intensive than the fragility index, the global fragility index provides the definitive answer to the fundamental question: what is the smallest change to the data that would alter the conclusion? This makes the global fragility index a more sensitive measure of fragility for r × c tables.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了全局脆弱性指数，这是一种路径独立的统计脆弱性度量方法，通过计算在列联表中所有可能路径上翻转统计显著性所需的最小观测值移动次数，克服了传统脆弱性指数的局限性。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个更敏感、路径独立的统计脆弱性度量方法，能够识别翻转统计显著性所需的最小扰动？
AI.motivation: 传统脆弱性指数依赖于任意的事件定义和特定的切换规则，可能无法找到实际的最小扰动，需要一种更全面的脆弱性评估方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于列联表理论和统计显著性翻转概念，提出全局脆弱性指数的理论框架，包括单观测值移动的最小化计算。
AI.method: 定义全局脆弱性指数为在固定样本量下，通过列联表中所有可能的单元格间单观测值移动来翻转统计显著性所需的最小移动次数，并开发相应的计算方法。
AI.findings: 全局脆弱性指数消除了现有脆弱性度量的三个关键依赖：事件/非事件标签模糊性、平衡设计中参考组选择、切换路径规则，且总是小于或等于传统脆弱性指数。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了路径独立的脆弱性度量理论框架，扩展了多组比较的脆弱性评估方法，为统计稳健性分析提供了新的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了更敏感的脆弱性评估工具，帮助研究者识别研究结果的稳健性，特别是在小样本或边缘显著性的情况下，为统计结论的可靠性提供量化依据。

title: AIVO Visibility Beta™ v1.0 (2025)
affiliations: Independent researcher

detail.title: AIVO Visibility Beta™ v1.0 (2025)
detail.abstract: The AIVO Visibility Beta™ (AVB) AIVO Visibility Beta™ (AVB) framework quantifies the sensitivity of financial performance to probabilistic fluctuations in brand visibility within generative-AI ecosystems. Extending the AIVO Standard's Prompt-Space Occupancy Score (PSOS™), AVB introduces a coefficient linking visibility variance to enterprise outcomes and treats visibility as a non-financial exposure class. Based on stochastic recall tests across leading AI assistants (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity), the framework defines complementary metrics-Visibility Elasticity Factor (VEF), AIVO Exposure Ratio (AER), and AIVO Visibility Index (AVI). Together they form a reproducible linkage from probabilistic recall to EBITDA volatility. Using anonymized multi-sector data, AVB provides a baseline methodology for CFOs, boards, and analysts to integrate AI-visibility risk into governance and ESG reporting. Empirical simulations show that firms with AVB > 1 AVB > 1 face heightened earnings volatility from AI-model shifts. AVB is not a tradable instrument or forecast; it is a governance tool aligning marketing measurement with financial risk management. Limitations include assumptions of linearity and reliance on prompt-based testing; future work should address non-linear dynamics.

AI.tldr: AVB框架量化了财务绩效对生成式AI生态系统中品牌可见性波动的敏感性，通过可见性弹性因子、AIVO暴露比率和AIVO可见性指数等指标，建立了从概率性召回率到EBITDA波动的可复制联系。
AI.research_question: 如何量化金融绩效对生成式AI生态系统中品牌可见性概率波动的敏感性？
AI.motivation: 随着生成式AI的普及，品牌在AI助手（如ChatGPT、Gemini等）中的可见性成为影响企业财务表现的关键非财务风险因素，需要建立系统性的量化框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于AIVO标准的提示空间占用分数（PSOS™），将可见性视为非财务风险暴露类别，建立可见性方差与企业结果之间的系数关系。
AI.method: 使用随机召回测试方法，在主要AI助手（ChatGPT、Gemini、Claude、Perplexity）上进行测试，开发可见性弹性因子、AIVO暴露比率和AIVO可见性指数等互补指标。
AI.findings: 实证模拟显示，AVB > 1的企业面临因AI模型变化而加剧的收益波动性；该框架为CFO、董事会和分析师提供了将AI可见性风险整合到治理和ESG报告中的基准方法。
AI.theory_contributions: 将品牌可见性概念化为非财务风险暴露类别，建立了可见性波动与财务绩效之间的量化理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为CFO、董事会和分析师提供了可操作的治理工具，将营销测量与财务风险管理相结合，支持ESG报告和风险治理实践。

title: The Economic Inversion of "Late Stage Capitalism"
affiliations: Università Bocconi

detail.title: The Economic Inversion of "Late Stage Capitalism"

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: This paper aims to develop a new long-run economic framework to examine and explain the fundamental economic forces behind the issues of today's developed economies, such as growing inequality, and stagnant standards of living, despite the presence of economic growth. We divide demand into "actual" and "artificial" demand, grounding this categorization in microeconomic theory. We argue that there has been a fundamental shift in the mature economies, which have shifted from growth through meeting actual demand, to growth through artificially expanding demand through social engineering. The reason for this, we argue, is that most primary needs of the citizens of the developed economies had been met prior to the 1970-s oil crisis, which made generating demand a better tool for growth than technological innovation, a result achievable both in the presence of collusion and without it, through agents looking out for their own interests in a free-market economy. We argue that neoliberalism accidentally was the medicine that allowed the developed economies to continue their growth, by unlocking the hands of governments and markets to freely use social engineering to generate demand. Given a decreasing marginal utility of consumption, something supported by contemporary behavioral research, our model shows that under certain conditions, planned obsolescence can boost economic growth, and inequality can continue to grow even among theoretical agents with equivalent education, fair compensation for labor, but different capital endowments, and that workers can even experience decreasing standards of living in a growing economy in which they contribute all of the labor.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个新的长期经济框架，将需求分为"实际需求"和"人工需求"，解释发达经济体在经济增长的同时出现不平等加剧和生活水平停滞的原因。研究发现，发达经济体从满足实际需求转向通过社会工程人为扩大需求来推动增长，新自由主义政策无意中为这种转变提供了条件。
AI.research_question: 发达经济体在经济增长的同时为何会出现不平等加剧和生活水平停滞的问题？
AI.motivation: 解释当代发达经济体中经济增长与不平等加剧、生活水平停滞并存的矛盾现象
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于微观经济理论的需求分类框架（实际需求vs人工需求）、边际效用递减理论、新自由主义理论
AI.method: 理论模型构建和分析，结合行为经济学研究支持
AI.findings: 1）发达经济体从满足实际需求转向人为扩大需求来推动增长；2）新自由主义政策促进了这种转变；3）计划性淘汰可以促进经济增长；4）即使在教育公平、劳动报酬公平的情况下，资本禀赋差异仍会导致不平等加剧；5）工人可能在增长经济中经历生活水平下降
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了新的长期经济分析框架，将需求分类为实际需求和人工需求，为理解当代经济矛盾提供了新的理论视角
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者理解经济增长与不平等的关系提供新视角，揭示了新自由主义政策在需求创造方面的作用机制

title: The impact of AI-Generated Entrepreneurial Narratives on a Prosocial Micro-lending Platform
affiliations: Independent Researcher, USA.

detail.title: The impact of AI-Generated Entrepreneurial Narratives on a Prosocial Micro-lending Platform
detail.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence (AI) is reshaping how entrepreneurial ideas are communicated and evaluated. Yet its implications for prosocial entrepreneurship remain underexplored. This study examines how AI-generated narratives affect funding outcomes on a prosocial peer-to-peer lending platform. Based on data from Kiva, a global platform that supports micro-entrepreneurs, we conceptualize AI as an epistemic disruptor, reshaping how micro-entrepreneurs communicate their ventures, financial needs, and intentions, to potential lenders. We use perplexity, which measures the fluency and coherence of loan application narratives, as a proxy for AI-generated content to test three hypotheses. The findings indicate that loan applications with narratives perceived as AI-generated are more likely to be funded than those perceived to be human-written, implying that well-structured narratives attract lenders. Likewise, loan applications tagged as user favorites attract more funding, reflecting the influence of social endorsement as a cue for loans that are popular, trustworthy and desirable. Interestingly, tagged applications perceived as AI-generated experience lower funding success than tagged applications perceived as human-authored. We interpret this finding through the lens of authenticity theory, suggesting negative reactions when narratives appear inauthentic. Put together, the findings reveal that AI both facilitates and complicates entrepreneurial communication, simultaneously improving readability while challenging authenticity. By connecting epistemic risk, social signaling, and authenticity concerns, this study advances understanding of entrepreneurship in AI-augmented environments. The findings have practical implications for financial inclusion, highlighting the importance of using generative AI in ways that preserve trust within digital lending ecosystems.

detail.abstract:
California’s state taxation system generates significant revenue; however, persistent budget deficits, mismanagement of taxpayer funds, and inefficiencies continue to plague the state’s financial stability. The allocation of taxpayer money is frequently dictated by partisan agendas, bureaucratic inefficiencies, and shifting priorities rather than by the needs and preferences of taxpayers. This has led to chronic underfunding of essential services, erratic spending patterns, and widespread public dissatisfaction with the state’s fiscal governance. Local governments further exacerbate these issues through inefficient budgetary decisions, contributing to misallocated funds and service shortfalls.

This Article proposes the Direct Democracy Tax Credit (“DDTC”), a policy designed to shift the financial decision-making power from government officials to taxpayers by allowing resident Californians—who live, work, and rely on public services in the state—to allocate their state income tax payment to specific public service sectors. This initiative seeks to enhance fiscal accountability, reduce political interference in budget decisions, and create a more transparent and taxpayer-driven allocation system. The DDTC expands California’s tradition of ballot initiatives by letting individual taxpayers annually allocate funds without ballot access barriers, majority vote requirements, or costly campaigns. To ensure stability, a Direct Democracy Fund would collect and distribute taxpayer-directed funds while maintaining oversight at the municipal, county, and state levels.

Additionally, safeguards, including state intervention through federal funding, corporate tax revenue, and sales and use tax revenue, would prevent critical service disruptions while preserving taxpayer autonomy.

By placing funding decisions in the hands of taxpayers and enforcing strict oversight on the entities receiving funds, this proposal aims to mitigate bureaucratic inefficiencies, eliminate politically motivated spending, and restore public trust in California’s financial system. Ultimately, this Article offers a practical solution to the state’s ongoing fiscal challenges by aligning budget allocations with taxpayer priorities, fostering government accountability, and promoting more efficient public spending.

title: Interest Rate Pass-Through With Adjustable Rate Mortgages
affiliations: Duke University, Nova School of Business and Economics and Bank of Portugal - Department of Economics

detail.title: Interest Rate Pass-Through With Adjustable Rate Mortgages
detail.abstract: Adjustable-rate mortgages (ARMs) transmit monetary policy less directly than commonly assumed. Exploiting variation in ARM rate reset timing in Portugal-where over 90% of mortgages are indexed to Euribor-during the European Central Bank's 2022-2023 tightening cycle, we show sizable household responses. Following resets, mortgage renegotiations rise by 10 percentage points, transfers to new banks by 4, partial prepayments by 5, and full prepayments by 3, offsetting roughly 17% of the payment increase implied by policy rates. These adjustments occur immediately after rate resets, consistent with selective inattention, and are more pronounced among younger, more educated, and higher-balance borrowers. Supply-side factors amplify these effects: competition intensifies as rates rise, with households at more flexible banks or in areas with greater broker presence exhibiting higher switching and prepayment activity. Our findings show that even in ARM-dominated mortgage markets, borrower behavior, market frictions, and sticky deposit rates jointly shape monetary policy pass-through.

detail.abstract: This paper explores the nature and scope of state action doctrine. It discusses whether the loyalty test is purely procedural or also touches on potential substantive public interest justifications. It investigates the operational standards developed in case law and the consequences thereof for liability. It also covers the state coercion defence. It finds that, generally speaking, both loyalty and coercion tests follow the strict logic of the EU legal order in which regulatory measures are subject to democratic control and private agreements to the competition rules. That said, it also finds that some areas of concern still remain.

detail.abstract: Social commentators bemoan that we are losing a shared reality. With information bubbles on social media and personally-tailored entertainment content, each person is now an island. detail.title: Geopolitical Risk, Bank Lending and Real Effects on Firms: Evidence from the Russian Invasion of Ukraine

publicationDetails.journalName: ECB: Working Paper Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: This paper investigates whether geopolitical risk causes a reduction in bank lending. In particular, it focuses on how the increase in geopolitical risk stemming from the Russian invasion of Ukraine affected euro area bank credit supply. Matching granular supervisory and credit register data and using a panel difference-in-difference approach, the results show that banks with larger exposure to the increase in geopolitical risk cut lending significantly more than those with smaller exposure. Banks with greater exposure raised impairments despite exhibiting similar levels of credit distress to their peers, suggesting that the fall in lending was driven by uncertainty. Moreover, firms that were heavily reliant on banks with high exposure to geopolitical risk were unable to fully substitute this shortfall in credit by borrowing more from less affected banks, which significantly constrained firm investment and employment.

title: Disruptive Innovation and Antitrust
affiliations: Université de Montréal and University of Namur

detail.title: Disruptive Innovation and Antitrust
detail.abstract: This paper analyses how disruptive innovation fits within current antitrust policy and practice. Disruptive innovation occurs when the incumbent firm is displaced despite, or even because of, the choices that made that firm successful. As such, it highlights shortcomings of current antitrust theory: models of competition in or even for the market fail to account fully for dynamic effects. Disruptive innovation represents competition on the market, where the relevant market is endogenized. Competition on the market is characterized by sideways competition, where an entrant tries to gain a position of strength by shifting the value network or by replacing the dominant design at the expense of the incumbent. The paper analyses how competition on the market could be factored into antitrust analysis and practice on the basis of recent cases in the US and the EU. Antitrust law already has a mixture of substantive and procedural rules that can be harnessed to address concerns related to the main defensive strategies used by firms to prevent disruptive innovation taking place. In the case of monopolization provisions, addressing conduct aimed at blocking access to complementary assets is the most pressing issue. Under merger control, it is not only “killer acquisitions” that are problematic, but also acquisitions designed to deny a foothold to a potential disruptor or to copy its offerings. We explore how antitrust metrics and theories of harm could evolve in these respects, and offer some concrete proposals as regards their implementation.
