title: Parental Involvement Profiles and Their Association with Children's Early Development in Taiwan A Three-Year Longitudinal Study
affiliations: Northeast Normal University, affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of Macau, The Education University of Hong Kong, National Tsing Hua University and National Taiwan Normal University

detail.title: Parental Involvement Profiles and Their Association with Children's Early Development in Taiwan A Three-Year Longitudinal Study
detail.abstract: This study examines the longitudinal association of 1,979 Taiwanese preschool children’s development with parental involvement profiles over their three-year participation in the National Longitudinal Study of Child Development and Care (KIT). Latent profile analysis was utilized to examine distinct parental involvement profiles and their association with children’s executive function, language acquisition, social skills, gross motor skills, and fine motor skills. Four distinct parental involvement profiles emerged: High Parental Involvement, Moderate Parental Involvement, Low Father Involvement, and Low Mother Involvement. Preschool children whose parents were in the High Parental Involvement profile demonstrated the highest performance across all developmental dimensions. Conversely, preschool children whose parents were in the Low Father Involvement profile exhibited the lowest overall levels of development. Children whose parental involvement profile was either Low Father Involvement or Low Mother Involvement exhibited considerable adverse effects on their social development. Additionally, findings suggest that paternal involvement specifically seems to uniquely be associated with children's executive functions and language development across profiles. The study highlights the role of collaborative parental involvement in children’s development, providing insights that can enhance the quality of family education focus and training to support positive outcomes for children.​

AI.tldr: 本研究通过潜在剖面分析发现四种父母参与模式，其中高参与度父母的孩子在所有发展维度表现最佳，而父亲低参与度模式的孩子发展水平最低。父亲参与对儿童执行功能和语言发展有独特影响。
AI.research_question: 台湾学龄前儿童的父母参与模式如何影响其多方面发展？
AI.motivation: 了解不同类型父母参与模式对儿童发展的纵向影响，为家庭教育质量提升提供依据
AI.theoretical_framework: 父母参与理论、儿童发展理论、潜在剖面分析
AI.method: 使用台湾儿童发展与照顾国家纵向研究(KIT)数据，对1,979名学龄前儿童进行三年追踪，采用潜在剖面分析识别父母参与模式
AI.findings: 识别出四种父母参与模式：高参与度、中等参与度、父亲低参与度、母亲低参与度；高参与度父母的孩子发展最佳；父亲低参与度模式的孩子发展最差；父亲参与对执行功能和语言发展有独特影响
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了父母参与理论，揭示了不同类型父母参与模式对儿童发展的差异化影响
AI.practical_contributions: 为家庭教育培训提供针对性指导，强调父亲参与的重要性，促进协作式父母参与

title: More Patience, Higher Growth: Patient Capital’s Impact on Enterprise---Evidence from Chinese A-share Manufacturing Companies
affiliations: Chuzhou University, University of Glasgow and Wenzhou Business College

detail.title: More Patience, Higher Growth: Patient Capital’s Impact on Enterprise---Evidence from Chinese A-share Manufacturing Companies
detail.abstract: This paper explores the characteristics of patient capital of listed companies, measuring patient capital of Chinese A-share listed manufacturing companies from 2012-2022, and constructing a simple enterprise production function that includes both patient capital and general capital. Through empirical analysis, it is found that patient capital has a higher utility for enterprise growth than general capital, and this utility is realized through improving governance and enhancing innovation. Notably, the positive utility of patient capital is stronger in enterprises with a wider executive pay gap and in non-extreme market conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文通过构建包含耐心资本和一般资本的企业生产函数，实证研究发现耐心资本对企业增长的效用高于一般资本，这种效用通过改善治理和促进创新实现，且在管理层薪酬差距较大和非极端市场条件下更显著。
AI.research_question: 耐心资本对企业增长的影响机制及其与一般资本的效用差异
AI.motivation: 探索耐心资本在上市公司中的特征及其对企业发展的作用，为理解不同类型资本对企业增长的影响提供实证依据
AI.theoretical_framework: 企业生产函数理论，包含耐心资本和一般资本的双重资本结构
AI.method: 实证分析，测量2012-2022年中国A股制造业上市公司的耐心资本，构建企业生产函数模型
AI.findings: 耐心资本对企业增长的效用高于一般资本，通过改善治理和促进创新实现效用，在管理层薪酬差距较大和非极端市场条件下效用更强
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了企业资本结构理论，提出了耐心资本的概念并验证其对企业增长的独特作用机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业资本配置和治理结构优化提供指导，帮助投资者识别具有长期价值的投资标的

title: The Protectionist Gamble: How Tariffs Shape Greenfield Foreign Direct Investment
affiliations: European Central Bank (ECB) and

detail.title: The Protectionist Gamble: How Tariffs Shape Greenfield Foreign Direct Investment

publicationDetails.journalName: ECB: Working Paper Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: Motivated by current events, this paper assesses the impact of tariff increases on bilateral greenfield foreign direct investment (FDI) over the period 2016-2023. Leveraging a comprehensive dataset of announced greenfield investment projects, official FDI statistics, and bilateral product-level tariff data, we estimate a series of gravity equations to uncover key relationships. Our results show that, at an aggregate level, tariff increases are associated with a rise in greenfield FDI, consistent with the tariff-jumping hypothesis. However, this positive effect reverses for greenfield manufacturing FDI, where high-intensity tariff increases significantly deter investment. A sectoral analysis reveals substantial heterogeneity: consumer-facing industries tend to attract more investment following tariff hikes, while input-intensive sectors experience declines. Overall, our findings suggest that using tariffs to stimulate foreign manufacturing investment is a risky strategy.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了2016-2023年间关税增加对绿地外国直接投资的影响，发现总体关税增加与绿地FDI上升相关，但制造业FDI受到显著抑制，且不同行业存在异质性影响。
AI.research_question: 关税增加对双边绿地外国直接投资（FDI）有何影响？
AI.motivation: 受当前事件驱动，评估关税政策对FDI的影响
AI.theoretical_framework: 关税跳跃假说、引力模型
AI.method: 使用绿地投资项目、官方FDI统计数据和双边产品级关税数据的综合数据集，估计一系列引力方程
AI.findings: 总体关税增加与绿地FDI上升相关（符合关税跳跃假说），但制造业FDI受到高强度关税增加的显著抑制；行业分析显示消费者导向行业吸引更多投资，而投入密集型行业投资下降
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了关税跳跃假说在总体层面的适用性，但揭示了制造业FDI的相反效应，扩展了对关税政策异质性影响的理解
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供实证证据，表明使用关税刺激外国制造业投资是高风险策略

title: Quantum Information Technologies and Public International Law: Strategic, Legal, and Geopolitical Dimensions
affiliations: and LML, University of Cambridge

detail.title: Quantum Information Technologies and Public International Law: Strategic, Legal, and Geopolitical Dimensions

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no conflicts of interest.
declarations.funderStatement: This contribution was partially supported by a Novo Nordisk Foundation Grant for a scientifically independent International Collaborative Bioscience Innovation & Law Programme (Inter-CeBIL Programme, Grant No. NNF23SA0087056).

detail.abstract: The use of computational technologies by States for both offensive and defensive purposes has become a central feature of contemporary international relations. Quantum information technologies (QIT) are expected to influence these dynamics by transforming State capabilities in cybersecurity, encryption, and information analysis. This chapter examines how the strategic use of QIT by States intersects with the principles and rules of public international law. The analysis situates QIT within the jurisprudence of sovereignty, jurisdiction, and the use of force, drawing on the Tallinn Manual and related sources of international law. It also explores how game theory may illuminate patterns of quantum cooperation and competition among States in both peacetime and conflict.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨量子信息技术在国家战略应用与国际公法原则的交叉点，分析其在主权、管辖权和武力使用等法律框架下的定位，并运用博弈论研究国家间在和平与冲突时期的量子合作与竞争模式。
AI.research_question: 国家战略性地使用量子信息技术如何与国际公法的原则和规则相交？
AI.motivation: 量子信息技术正在改变国家在网络防御、加密和信息分析方面的能力，这已成为当代国际关系的核心特征，需要研究其与国际法律框架的互动。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际公法原则（主权、管辖权、武力使用）、塔林手册、博弈论
AI.method: 法律分析框架，将量子信息技术置于国际法判例中分析，并运用博弈论解释国家行为模式
AI.findings: 量子信息技术的发展需要重新审视现有国际法律框架，特别是在网络空间主权和武力使用规则方面；博弈论有助于理解国家在量子技术领域的战略互动
AI.theory_contributions: 为量子信息技术与国际法的交叉研究提供理论框架，拓展了网络空间国际法的研究边界
AI.practical_contributions: 为国家制定量子技术战略提供法律指导，有助于预防和管控量子技术可能引发的国际冲突

reference: George Mason Legal Studies Research Paper No. LS No. 25-19
title: Immigration is Not Invasion
affiliations: George Mason University - Antonin Scalia Law School

detail.title: Immigration is Not Invasion

publicationDetails.detailsText: George Mason Legal Studies Research Paper No. LS No. 25-19
publicationDetails.journalName: Antonin Scalia Law School, George Mason University Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
In recent years, state governments and the second Trump Administration have increasingly advanced the argument that illegal migration and cross-border drug-smuggling qualify as “invasion” under the Constitution, and the Alien Enemies Act of 1798 (AEA). If these arguments are accepted by courts, or if they rule the issue is committed to the unreviewable discretion of the executive, the consequences will be dire. Such an outcome would pose a grave threat to the civil liberties of both immigrants and US citizens. It would also enable state governments to initiate war without federal authorization. This article makes the first comprehensive case against claims that illegal migration and drug smuggling qualify as “invasion.” As James Madison explained in 1800, “Invasion is an operation of war.” Illegal migration and drug smuggling do not qualify. 

Part I summarizes the history of the “invasion” debate and currently ongoing litigation over it.  Part II explains why the broad interpretation of “invasion” is manifestly wrong under the text and original meaning of the Constitution. The concept does not include illegal migration or drug smuggling. This conclusion is supported by the constitutional text, extensive evidence from the Constitutional Convention and the ratification process, and references to “invasion” in the Federalist Papers. 

In Part III, I consider the meaning of “invasion” in the Alien Enemies Act of 1798. The text and public meaning indicate it is essentially the same as that in the Constitution. Under the Act, an invasion requires a military attack. This reality is not changed by the fact that many Americans die as a result of overdosing on illegal drugs, or by recent US military attacks on suspected drug smugglers in international waters. 

Part IV outlines the dire implications of the broad view of invasion. State governments would have the power to wage war in response to undocumented migration and smuggling, even if such warfare were not authorized by Congress. This would be a major undermining of Congress’ power to declare war, and threatens to involve the United States in warfare at the behest of a single state government. Even worse, the broad view would also effectively give the federal government the power to suspend the writ of habeas corpus at any time. These dangerous implications strengthen the originalist case against a broad definition of “invasion.” They also cut against the broad definition from the standpoint of various living constitution theories of interpretation.

Finally, Part V explains why courts should not defer to the president or to state governments on either the meaning of “invasion” or the factual issue of whether an “invasion” – properly defined – has actually occurred.

AI.tldr: 本文反对将非法移民和毒品走私定性为宪法意义上的"入侵"，认为这种宽泛解释会威胁公民自由、破坏国会宣战权，并可能导致州政府未经授权发动战争。
AI.research_question: 非法移民和毒品走私是否构成宪法和1798年《敌对外国人法》意义上的"入侵"？
AI.motivation: 近年来，州政府和特朗普政府主张非法移民和跨境毒品走私构成"入侵"，如果法院接受这种观点，将严重威胁公民自由并破坏宪法权力平衡。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于宪法文本、原意解释、制宪会议记录和《联邦党人文集》等原始资料，分析"入侵"概念的原始含义。
AI.method: 通过历史分析、文本分析和法律推理，系统考察宪法和《敌对外国人法》中"入侵"概念的含义。
AI.findings: "入侵"在宪法和《敌对外国人法》中特指军事攻击，不包括非法移民或毒品走私。詹姆斯·麦迪逊在1800年明确表示"入侵是战争行为"。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次全面反驳了将非法移民和毒品走私定性为"入侵"的主张，为理解宪法中的"入侵"概念提供了系统的原意解释框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 防止州政府未经联邦授权发动战争，保护国会宣战权，避免人身保护令状被任意中止，维护宪法权力分立原则。

title: Households’ productive assets, financial inclusion and adaptation of coping mechanism effects in reducing food insecurity in Pakistan
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Households’ productive assets, financial inclusion and adaptation of coping mechanism effects in reducing food insecurity in Pakistan
detail.abstract: Climate change natural disasters' increasing frequency has raised severe issues of food insecurity in global perspective and more particularly among developing nations communities owing to inhabited mostly in susceptible areas. The study focused to investigate the impact of households’ productive assets, financial inclusion, and adaptation of coping mechanism in reducing food insecurity in flood-prone regions of Punjab, Pakistan. This research work applied questionnaire-based collected data of 480 flood-prone households which inhabited in the Indus River basin region three districts of Punjab, Pakistan. Ordinary least squares and logit models were used to estimate this research work empirically. Food insecurity alternative measures and host of covariates controlling estimates indicated financial inclusion like having bank saving account facilities in reducing likelihood of food shortage by 19-34% (with percentage point 4.3-5.9 relevant sample mean 23%) while days numbers worried households related to food shortage reduced 26-37% (0.64 days as comes to lessen to mean sample 1.86-month days). In financial inclusion, banks' credit access considered one of the significant determinants while remaining ineffective in addressing food insecurity issues. These estimated outcomes considered robust main model alternative specifications and food insecurity different measures. Concerning to outcomes of the study, implementable policy measures are suggested, such as rural farmers providing support to increase their productive asset ownership and having bank savings accounts. On a short-term basis, productive assets for increasing income and livestock must be promoted, while on a long-term strategy, poor households must incentivize sending their children to school to educate vulnerable communities.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了在巴基斯坦旁遮普省洪水易发地区，家庭生产性资产、金融包容性和应对机制适应对减少粮食不安全的影响。研究发现拥有银行储蓄账户等金融包容性措施可将粮食短缺可能性降低19-34%，而银行信贷获取虽然重要但对解决粮食安全问题无效。
AI.research_question: 在巴基斯坦旁遮普省洪水易发地区，家庭生产性资产、金融包容性和应对机制适应如何影响粮食不安全？
AI.motivation: 气候变化自然灾害频发导致全球特别是发展中国家社区面临严重粮食不安全问题，因为这些社区大多居住在易受灾害影响的地区。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于金融包容性理论、资产贫困理论和应对机制理论，探讨不同因素对粮食安全的影响机制。
AI.method: 使用问卷调查收集480个洪水易发地区家庭数据，采用普通最小二乘法和logit模型进行实证估计。
AI.findings: 金融包容性（如拥有银行储蓄账户）可将粮食短缺可能性降低19-34%，使担忧粮食短缺的天数减少26-37%；银行信贷获取虽重要但对解决粮食安全问题无效。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对金融包容性在缓解粮食不安全中作用的理解，区分了不同金融工具（储蓄vs信贷）的不同效果。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出政策建议：支持农村农民增加生产性资产所有权和开设银行储蓄账户；短期促进收入和牲畜增长，长期激励贫困家庭子女教育。

title: Automation Exposure and Investment Sensitivity
affiliations: Central South University, Durham University Business School, Finance and Economics and Central South University

detail.title: Automation Exposure and Investment Sensitivity
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the effect of automation exposure on firms’ investment sensitivity. Using a sample of U.S. public firms spanning the period 1980–2020, we document a negative effect of automation exposure on both investment–cash flow sensitivity and investment–price sensitivity. Our main finding remains robust after accounting for a range of potential endogeneity concerns. The negative effect on investment–cash flow sensitivity is more pronounced among firms with financial constraints, while the negative effect on investment–price sensitivity is stronger for firms with higher stock price informativeness and more managerial incentives to learn from the market. Overall, our study highlights the important role of automation technologies in shaping corporate activities.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现自动化暴露对企业投资敏感性有负面影响，特别是对投资-现金流敏感性和投资-价格敏感性。这种影响在财务约束企业中更显著，且对投资-价格敏感性的影响在股价信息含量高和管理层有动机从市场学习的企业中更强。
AI.research_question: 自动化暴露如何影响企业的投资敏感性？
AI.motivation: 探讨自动化技术在塑造企业活动中的重要作用，特别是在投资决策方面的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于企业投资理论，分析自动化技术对企业投资敏感性的影响机制。
AI.method: 使用1980-2020年美国上市公司样本，采用计量经济学方法分析自动化暴露对投资敏感性的影响，并处理内生性问题。
AI.findings: 自动化暴露对投资-现金流敏感性和投资-价格敏感性均产生负面影响；财务约束企业受投资-现金流敏感性影响更大；股价信息含量高和管理层学习动机强的企业受投资-价格敏感性影响更强。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了自动化技术对企业投资行为影响的理论研究，揭示了自动化通过不同渠道影响企业投资决策的机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业管理层在自动化转型过程中的投资决策提供参考，帮助投资者理解自动化技术对企业投资行为的影响。

title: Extended Abstract Bridging the ICT Export Gap: A Data-Driven Roadmap for Pakistan Inspired by Regional Leaders

detail.title: Extended Abstract Bridging the ICT Export Gap: A Data-Driven Roadmap for Pakistan Inspired by Regional Leaders
detail.abstract: Pakistan’s ICT sector, despite being the top contributor to services exports at $2.825 billion in FY2025, remains far below its potential. The country’s digital exports lag behind regional peers such as India, Bangladesh, and Vietnam, who have successfully deployed targeted digital policies, talent development, and international market linkages to become global ICT export hubs. Pakistan’s export ecosystem remains overly concentrated, with structural bottlenecks in digital infrastructure, skill gaps, financing, and global outreach. The lack of firm-level export readiness further limits scaling potential. Against this backdrop, and in alignment with the URAAN Pakistan vision and the national goal of achieving $100 billion in sustainable exports, this study explores: how can Pakistan scale its ICT exports by leveraging firm-level financial data, regional benchmarking, and AI-driven export strategy tools to unlock untapped potential.

AI.tldr: 巴基斯坦ICT部门虽然贡献了28.25亿美元的服务出口，但远未发挥潜力。本研究探讨如何通过企业级财务数据、区域对标和AI驱动的出口策略工具来扩大ICT出口规模。
AI.research_question: 巴基斯坦如何通过企业级财务数据、区域对标和AI驱动的出口策略工具来扩大其ICT出口规模？
AI.motivation: 巴基斯坦ICT出口落后于印度、孟加拉国和越南等区域竞争对手，这些国家通过有针对性的数字政策、人才培养和国际市场联系成功成为全球ICT出口中心。
AI.theoretical_framework: 出口竞争力理论、数字生态系统理论、企业级出口准备度理论
AI.method: 企业级财务数据分析、区域对标分析、AI驱动的出口策略工具应用
AI.findings: 巴基斯坦ICT出口生态系统过于集中，在数字基础设施、技能差距、融资和全球推广方面存在结构性瓶颈，企业级出口准备度不足限制了规模化潜力。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了结合企业级数据分析和AI工具的ICT出口扩展理论框架，丰富了数字出口竞争力研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为巴基斯坦实现1000亿美元可持续出口目标提供具体策略，包括改善数字基础设施、解决技能差距、增强融资渠道和全球市场联系。

title: Social Field Theory: A Computable Framework from Time-as-Social-Mass with Information Quanta and Multi-Field Coupling
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Social Field Theory: A Computable Framework from Time-as-Social-Mass with Information Quanta and Multi-Field Coupling

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author, Che-Hung Chiu, declares no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper. The AI tool (ChatGPT) acted only as a research-assistant–style writing/methods consultant, fully disclosed in the “AI Collaboration & Authorship Transparency” section, and does not constitute a financial interest or sponsorship.

If identifiable or linkable data are introduced, we will: (1) seek IRB review and informed consent or lawful waiver; (2) collect the minimum necessary fields with purpose limitation; (3) apply de‑identification, pseudonymization, noise injection, and differential privacy as appropriate; (4) honor data‑subject rights; (5) release only risk‑assessed, de‑identified datasets and code. detail.abstract: We propose a Social Field Theory grounded in the axiom that time is directly projected into social mass. Using the person-day as the primitive unit, we formalize three core equations: (i) a mass accumulation equation with a memory kernel and activity weighting; (ii) a multi-field generation equation coupling culture, politics, economy, finance, and nature/ecology; and (iii) an overdamped trajectory equation in which individual paths follow field gradients. At the micro level, we introduce information quanta and an instantaneous-surprise threshold linking information-thermodynamic costs to event activation rates. Monetary capital is de-centered as a coupling regulator rather than a social force per se; ecological and climatic processes are embedded in the same field to endogenize externalities. We propose testable hypotheses and proxies (field strength, waiting-time distributions, threshold-crossing rates, power) and outline an estimation pipeline based on life-history events, social networks, and institutional rhythms to identify the memory kernel, weighting function, and damping constants. The contribution is a measurable, computable, and testable grammar-rhythm-threshold-weighting-that explains social weight differentials, critical transitions, and feedback from externalities while avoiding circular definitions by taking time as an ontological primitive.

AI.tldr: 本文提出社会场理论，将时间作为基本单位，通过三个核心方程描述社会质量积累、多场生成和个体轨迹，将生态气候过程内生化，并提出可检验的假设和估计方法。
AI.research_question: 如何建立一个基于时间投影的社会场理论框架，来统一解释社会质量差异、临界转变和外部性反馈？

title: Do Lenders Target Specific Causes on Pro-Social Crowdfunding Platforms?
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Do Lenders Target Specific Causes on Pro-Social Crowdfunding Platforms?
detail.abstract: In this paper, we study the motivations of lenders on prosocial crowdfunding platforms and investigate whether they repeatedly contribute to similar causes or choose random projects among those proposed by the platform. Causes here are identified by specific sectors or tags of projects, including, for instance, education, eco-friendly projects, women entrepreneurship, refugees, etc. We follow a quantitative approach where we study the consistency of lenders’ funding decisions using data from the Kiva platform. We model the platform and its lenders as a dynamic system and construct bipartite graphs that link lenders to project categories, and then compute time-dependent similarity metrics. We compare the empirical metrics with those relative to simulated lenders contributing at random. Our results show that the behavior of lenders is generally indifferent toward project categories. This suggests that lenders on pro-social platforms do not target specific categories and do not show engagement to a cause but contribute indifferently to the platform’s proposed projects. When considering only lenders with reduced lending activity (less than one loan per month), this random behavior is attenuated and there are few repelling categories, to the profit of categories related to productive sectors and strong social causes.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过分析Kiva平台数据发现，公益众筹平台的贷款人通常对项目类别持中立态度，其资助行为具有随机性，而非针对特定社会事业。
AI.research_question: 公益众筹平台的贷款人是重复资助类似的社会事业项目，还是随机选择平台推荐的项目？
AI.motivation: 了解公益众筹平台贷款人的资助动机和行为模式，探究他们是否对特定社会事业表现出持续承诺。
AI.theoretical_framework: 将平台和贷款人建模为动态系统，构建连接贷款人与项目类别的二分图，计算时间相关的相似性指标。
AI.method: 采用定量方法，使用Kiva平台数据研究贷款人资助决策的一致性，将实证指标与随机资助的模拟贷款人进行比较。
AI.findings: 贷款人行为总体上对项目类别持中立态度，表明他们不针对特定类别，也不对事业表现出承诺，而是中立地资助平台推荐的项目。对于低活跃度贷款人（每月少于一次贷款），随机行为减弱，出现少数排斥类别，有利于生产性部门和强社会事业类别。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了公益众筹平台贷款人资助行为的随机性特征，挑战了贷款人会对特定社会事业表现出持续承诺的传统假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 为公益众筹平台的项目推荐和用户参与策略提供实证依据，帮助平台更好地理解用户行为模式。

detail.title: Tinubunomics and Modern Lagos. A political and Economic Assessment of President Ahmed's Administration as Lagos state Governor
detail.abstract: This article provides a comprehensive assessment of Tinubunomics, the economic and political model implemented by Bola Ahmed Tinubu during his tenure as Governor of Lagos State, Nigeria. The study examines key economic reforms, including tax policy adjustments, investment incentives, and privatization, and evaluates their impact on Lagos' contribution to national macroeconomic indicators such as Gross Domestic Product, national tax revenue, employment, and exports. Comparative analysis highlights the state's economic performance relative to Tinubu's predecessors and successors, demonstrating significant growth and structural improvements. The article also explores the political strategies and leadership approaches that facilitated these reforms, as well as the challenges faced, including corruption, inequality, and environmental concerns. By analyzing both the successes and limitations of Tinubunomics, the study offers insights for policymakers seeking to replicate effective governance models and sustainable economic development at the national level. The findings underscore the transformative potential of strategic economic planning and visionary political leadership in driving growth and regional influence.

AI.tldr: 本文全面评估了尼日利亚拉各斯州州长博拉·艾哈迈德·蒂努布实施的Tinubunomics经济政治模式，分析了其经济改革对宏观经济指标的积极影响，以及面临的政治挑战。

title: Enforcement vs Incentives: Assessing the EPA's Approach to Sustainable Industrial Compliance

detail.title: Enforcement vs Incentives: Assessing the EPA's Approach to Sustainable Industrial Compliance

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I declare that I have no personal, financial, or professional conflicts of interest that could have influenced the development of this research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, patient data, or sensitive personal information; therefore, ethics approval was not required.

detail.abstract: My paper critically examines the United States Environmental Protection Agency's evolving mix of enforcement and incentive-based compliance tools to determine whether this shift genuinely strengthens sustainable industrial compliance. The analysis traces the agency's movement from a primarily deterrence-driven model to a hybrid approach that incorporates voluntary disclosure programs, mitigation incentives, digital monitoring, and "Next Generation Compliance" strategies. Drawing on Markell's evaluation of the Mitigation Memorandum (Markell, 2014) and Mintz's discussion of Next Generation Compliance (Mintz, 2014) and recent empirical work on ballast-water enforcement under the Vessel General Permit, the study evaluates how these approaches function in practice rather than in theory. I find that, while incentives and transparency tools can build cooperation and encourage earlier compliance, they are only effective when paired with a credible threat of enforcement. When standing alone, incentive programs carry real risks, including uneven compliance, regulatory slippage, and opportunities for greenwashing. Ultimately, the research argues that the most durable regulatory framework is one that maintains strong enforcement authority while strategically using incentives and technology to reinforce rather than replace deterrence. My paper contributes to current debates by grounding the enforcement-versus-incentives discussion in empirical evidence and by offering a practical lens for judging how far such hybrid models can be relied upon in environmental governance.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了美国环保署从威慑驱动模式转向混合执法与激励方法的演变，发现激励措施只有在与可信的执法威胁相结合时才有效，单独使用激励计划会导致合规不均衡、监管滑坡和绿色洗白风险。

AI.method: 分析环保署执法工具的演变，评估激励和透明度工具在实践中的功能。
AI.findings: 激励和透明度工具可以建立合作并鼓励早期合规，但只有在与可信的执法威胁配对时才有效。单独使用激励计划会导致合规不均衡、监管滑坡和绿色洗白机会。

title: Bridging Input-Output Gaps in Fertilizer Sector to Reduce Pre-Harvest Food Loss A Multi-Company Scenario Analysis from Pakistan

detail.title: Bridging Input-Output Gaps in Fertilizer Sector to Reduce Pre-Harvest Food Loss A Multi-Company Scenario Analysis from Pakistan
detail.abstract: The fertilizer sector in Pakistan is both an enabler of agricultural productivity and a major consumer of subsidized natural resources. This study investigates the interlinkages between fertilizer production, distribution, gas subsidies, and food loss mitigation, focusing on three major fertilizer producers: Engro Fertilizers (EFERT), Fauji Fertilizer Company (FFC), and Fatima Fertilizer Limited (FATIMA). By integrating multi-year financials, operational linkages, and scenario modeling, this paper highlights the implications of gas pricing reforms, climate variability, and subsidy removal on fertilizer availability and affordability. Our findings emphasize the critical role of sustained fertilizer availability in preventing nutrient-deficiency-induced pre-harvest food losses, thus providing a roadmap for aligning input policy with national food security goals.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨巴基斯坦化肥生产、分配、天然气补贴与粮食损失缓解之间的关联，通过分析三大化肥企业（Engro、Fauji、Fatima）的财务数据和运营联系，评估天然气定价改革、气候变化和补贴取消对化肥可得性和可负担性的影响。

detail.title: Climate-Related Risk Taking, Shaping and Shifting: How Private Financial Actors Keep Stranded Assets Afloat

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors have no conflicts of interest to report.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Data collection has been following the principles of good scientific conduct, in particular regarding the protection of interviewees anonymity.
declarations.funderStatement: The research was funded by the German Research Foundation (DFG) under the Heisenberg Professorship Programme, reference WU 780/2-1, and the German Federal Ministry of Education and Research (BMBF) under the program “Climate Protection & Finance (KlimFi)”, reference 01LA2207A.

detail.abstract: European financial institutions face mixed signals on how to account for climaterelated and environmental risks that could prevent a disorderly stranding of assets. The literature has emphasised the financial industry's inability to cope with the fundamental uncertainty inherent to climate change, but still lacks an analysis of its strategic behaviour in relation to stranded asset risks. Based on the analysis of 38 semi-structured interviews with financial institutions, foremost institutional investors and banks, we address this lacuna. We argue that financial actors primarily employ three strategy clusters to address stranded asset risks: (1) risk taking, (2) risk shaping, and (3) risk shifting. These strategies entail different financial practices and narratives that either imply marginal financially material action, that challenge the scope of stranded assets, or hedge against stranded asset risks. We argue that drawing on these strategies enables financial institutions to keep stranded assets afloat rather than orchestrating a collective phase-out.

AI.tldr: 金融机构采用三种策略集群（风险承担、风险塑造、风险转移）来应对搁浅资产风险，这些策略使搁浅资产得以维持而非被集体淘汰。

title: First 15 Minutes: Why Türkiye Needs Elevated Water Towers
affiliations: Catholic Theological Union, Chicago

detail.title: First 15 Minutes: Why Türkiye Needs Elevated Water Towers
detail.abstract: This article, published in Daily Sabah, examines Türkiye’s escalating wildfire crisis through the lens of rural infrastructure planning. It argues that the country’s dominant focus on aerial firefighting — planes and helicopters — overlooks the critical first fifteen minutes when ground-level response determines containment success. Drawing from comparative models in the U.S., Australia, and Canada, the essay proposes the construction of elevated, gravity-fed water towers above forest villages as a low-cost, energy-independent system for immediate firefighting. By integrating water towers with fire ponds, hose networks, and early warning systems, the article envisions a sustainable “ground-up” strategy that empowers local communities to act swiftly before fires spread. Ultimately, it frames the water tower not only as an engineering solution but as a symbol of proactive and resilient planning rooted in local capacity and sustainability.

detail.title: Global Socialism and Local Market Capitalism Economic Remembering Proletarian Revolutionary Secretary Deng Xiaoping and Xi Zhongxun
detail.abstract: What are the differences between President Xi Jinping's socialism with Chinese characteristics and President Deng Xiaoping's socialism with Chinese characteristics? This article will use historical facts to explain and explore these differences. In 1987, Secretary Xi Zhongxun revised Xie Ganquan's "Global Socialism and Local Capitalism One country Two systems" to "Global Socialism and Local Market Capitalism." In 1993, President Deng Xiaoping proposed the "socialist market economy" in his speech during his southern tour in Shenzhen. Compared to Secretary Xi Zhongxun's "Global Socialism and Local Market Capitalism," Deng Xiaoping omitted the "Global" and "Local" terms, made a completely different concept. President Deng Xiaoping's socialist market economy played a driving role in China's initial transition from unitary socialism to reform and opening up. President Deng Xiaoping's socialism with Chinese characteristics was a transitional "socialist market economy"; President Xi Jinping's socialism with Chinese characteristics is a realistic Global Socialism and Local Market Capitalism. Under the leadership of President Xi and the Party Central Committee, leading cadres at all levels, in their respective posts, are leading the people in building a prosperous and flourishing socialism with Chinese characteristics in the Xi Jinping era. Based on topological correspondence, the seventh part evolves "global socialism and local market capital economy" into the global integral local differential GILD forward and inverse algorithm, and proposes the joint research of social science and natural science, their mutual topological transformation and super science,  positive space and negative space and invisible science.

detail.abstract:
תקציר בעברית: המאמר בוחן באופן ביקורתי את ההתמודדות הרגולטורית של ישראל עם מיסוי מטבעות קריפטוגרפיים, תוך השוואה למדינות אחרות ב- OECD . המחברים טוענים כי המסגרת הרגולטורית הקיימת בישראל ובמדי נות רבות אחרות פוגעת ביכולת רשויות המס למסות באופן יעיל את ההתעשרות ממטבעות קריפטוגרפיים, יוצרת תמריץ שלילי לשימוש בהם ומזיקה יותר מאשר מועילה.

English Abstract: The Paper critically examines Israel's regulatory approach to the taxation of cryptocurrencies, comparing it to other OECD countries. It reviews the regulatory situation in Israel and compares the Israeli approach to practices among OECD countries, demonstrating that most countries classify cryptocurrencies as assets or commodities rather than as foreign currency. The authors propose an alternative tax model that includes abandoning the realization principle in favor of current taxation, relaxed loss offset rules, and a dedicated specific reporting regime. This regime would consider cryptocurrencies' unique characteristics, reduce inequality in tax burden, increase national tax revenues, and assist in combating money laundering and criminal activity. The authors emphasize that maintaining cryptocurrency's classification as an asset for tax purposes encourages activity on the margins of legality while suppressing legitimate activity that could democratize financial services and lower barriers to entry.

title: LLMs as Strategic Agents: Beliefs, Best Response Behavior, and Emergent Heuristics
affiliations: University of Navarra, IESE Business School, University of Navarra, IESE Business School and

detail.title: LLMs as Strategic Agents: Beliefs, Best Response Behavior, and Emergent Heuristics
detail.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly applied to domains that require reasoning about other agents' behavior, such as negotiation, policy design, and market simulation, yet existing research has mostly evaluated their adherence to equilibrium play or their exhibited depth of reasoning. Whether they display genuine strategic thinking, understood as the coherent formation of beliefs about other agents, evaluation of possible actions, and choice based on those beliefs, remains unexplored. We develop a framework to identify this ability by disentangling beliefs, evaluation, and choice in static, complete-information games, and apply it across a series of noncooperative environments. By jointly analyzing models' revealed choices and reasoning traces, and introducing a new context-free game to rule out imitation from memorization, we show that current frontier models exhibit belief-coherent best-response behavior at targeted reasoning depths. When unconstrained, they self-limit their depth of reasoning and form differentiated conjectures about human and synthetic opponents, revealing an emergent form of meta-reasoning. Under increasing complexity, explicit recursion gives way to internally generated heuristic rules of choice that are stable, model-specific, and distinct from known human biases. These findings indicate that belief coherence, meta-reasoning, and novel heuristic formation can emerge jointly from language modeling objectives, providing a structured basis for the study of strategic cognition in artificial agents.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个框架来评估大型语言模型是否具备真正的战略思维能力，通过分离信念、评估和选择来分析其在非合作环境中的行为。研究发现前沿模型在特定推理深度下表现出信念一致的最佳响应行为，并展现出元推理和新型启发式规则形成的能力。
AI.research_question: 大型语言模型是否具备真正的战略思维能力？这种能力是否表现为信念形成、行动评估和基于信念的选择的连贯过程？
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要评估LLMs在均衡策略或推理深度方面的表现，但对其是否具备真正的战略思维能力（包括信念形成、行动评估和选择）尚未探索。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于博弈论中的战略思维理论，特别是信念一致的最佳响应行为、推理深度理论和元推理概念。
AI.method: 开发了一个框架来分离信念、评估和选择在静态完全信息博弈中的表现，通过分析模型的显性选择和推理轨迹，并引入新的无上下文游戏来排除记忆模仿的影响。
AI.findings: 当前前沿模型在目标推理深度下表现出信念一致的最佳响应行为；在无约束条件下会自我限制推理深度，并对人类和合成对手形成差异化推测；在复杂性增加时，显性递归让位于内部生成的启发式选择规则。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了信念一致性、元推理和新型启发式形成可以从语言建模目标中共同涌现，为研究人工智能体的战略认知提供了结构化基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为评估LLMs在谈判、政策设计和市场模拟等需要战略思维的领域中的应用提供了方法论框架，揭示了模型在复杂环境中形成稳定启发式规则的能力。

title: Decoupling Dollar and Treasury Privilege *
affiliations: Harvard Business School, Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System and Columbia University - Columbia Business School, Economics

detail.title: Decoupling Dollar and Treasury Privilege *

publicationDetails.detailsText: Columbia Business School Research Paper Forthcoming
publicationDetails.journalName: Columbia Business School Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We document a strong decoupling between the convenience yield on the US Dollar and US Treasuries. We measure the convenience of the U.S. dollar using covered interest parity (CIP) deviations between risk-free bank rates, such as secured overnight rates since the benchmark reform. In parallel, we measure the convenience of U.S. Treasury bonds through CIP deviations between government bond yields. We find a pronounced divergence between the two convenience measures in recent years: while the U.S. dollar exhibits strong convenience post-Global Financial Crisis, the U.S. Treasury convenience has not only declined substantially but has turned negative, most strongly so at medium-to long-term maturities. We argue that the relative supply of government bonds between the US and other developed markets is a key driver of the U.S. Treasury convenience compared to other government bonds. Finally, we present a simple framework with a constrained global financial intermediary to link dollar and Treasury convenience.

AI.tldr: 本文发现美元和美国国债的便利收益率之间存在显著脱钩现象。美元在金融危机后表现出强劲的便利性，而美国国债的便利性不仅大幅下降，甚至转为负值，特别是在中长期期限。
AI.research_question: 美元和美国国债的便利收益率之间是否存在脱钩现象？其驱动因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 理解全球金融市场中美元和美国国债作为安全资产的角色变化，以及两者便利收益率的动态关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于抛补利率平价(CIP)理论，通过CIP偏离度来测量便利收益率；全球金融中介约束框架。
AI.method: 使用金融危机后无风险银行利率（如担保隔夜利率）的CIP偏离度测量美元便利性；使用政府债券收益率的CIP偏离度测量美国国债便利性。
AI.findings: 美元便利性在金融危机后保持强劲，而美国国债便利性大幅下降并转为负值，特别是在中长期期限；美国与其他发达市场政府债券的相对供应是主要驱动因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了连接美元和国债便利性的简单框架，强调受约束的全球金融中介的作用；揭示了两种安全资产便利收益率的脱钩现象。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者和政策制定者理解美元和美国国债作为安全资产的价值变化提供实证依据；有助于评估全球金融市场的风险定价和资产配置策略。

title: A Dual-Risk Theory of Valuation Separating Market-Based Discounting from Expectational Distortion
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: A Dual-Risk Theory of Valuation Separating Market-Based Discounting from Expectational Distortion

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This research was conducted independently, without external funding or institutional support.
declarations.funderStatement: Not applicable. This study does not involve human participants, patients, or case studies requiring ethics approval. All data used are publicly available.

detail.abstract:
This paper develops a dual-risk valuation theory that extends the classical discounted cash flow model by adding an analytically distinct source of risk: expectational risk. We model expectational risk through the valuation ratio K, which measures systematic distortion in projected cash flows (expectational distortion), and study its interaction with the benchmark discount rate c (market-based discounting). The objective is to embed ex-ante alpha into valuation as a structural quantity rather than treat it as an ex-post residual. 

Methodologically, we build an analytical framework that defines the gain of capital g = f (c, K) and the effective cost of capital cef as the internal rate that reconciles distorted expectations with fair value. We derive closed-form conditions under which discounting ceases to be equivalent to expected return, characterize the horizon behavior of cef , and establish asymptotic results for the per-period equivalent of g, denoted γ. 

The main findings show that K and c jointly determine valuation outcomes, with g providing a forward-looking measure of ex-ante alpha whenever systematic distortion persists. We prove conditions where cef  ̸ = c, identify regimes in which short and medium horizons are most sensitive to K, and show that γ → 0 as the horizon lengthens, which clarifies when the expectational distortion captured by K becomes irrelevant for intrinsic value. 

These results reframe alpha as a structural feature of biased expectations and separate the two risk primitives: market opportunity cost (market risk) and expectational distortion (expectational risk). The framework generalizes DCF to incorporate systematic errors in cash-flow projections and yields practical guidance for enterprise valuation.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了双风险估值理论，扩展经典DCF模型，引入期望风险作为独立风险源。通过估值比率K衡量现金流预期扭曲，研究其与基准折现率c的交互作用，将事前alpha嵌入估值作为结构性变量。
AI.research_question: 如何将事前alpha作为结构性变量嵌入估值模型，并分离市场风险和期望风险？
AI.motivation: 扩展经典DCF模型，将系统性现金流预测误差纳入估值框架，将alpha从事后残差重构为事前结构性特征。
AI.theoretical_framework: 双风险估值理论：市场风险（基准折现率c）和期望风险（估值比率K）作为两个分析上独立的风险源。
AI.method: 构建分析框架定义资本收益g=f(c,K)和有效资本成本cef，推导封闭形式条件，刻画cef的期限行为，建立γ的渐近结果。
AI.findings: K和c共同决定估值结果，g提供事前alpha的前瞻性度量；识别cef≠c的条件；短期和中期估值对K最敏感；长期γ→0，期望扭曲对内在价值影响消失。
AI.theory_contributions: 将alpha重构为有偏预期的结构性特征，分离两个风险原语：市场机会成本和期望扭曲，推广DCF模型纳入系统性预测误差。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业估值提供实用指导，识别估值对期望风险敏感的关键期限，帮助分析师更好地处理现金流预测中的系统性偏差。

detail.title: Regressive Aspects in the Taxation of Equity-Based Compensation for Employees היבטים רגרסיביים במיסוי תגמול מבוסס מניות לעובדים
detail.abstract:
The Article examines the progressivity and fairness of tax arrangements applicable to equity-based compensation (stock options, shares, etc.) for employees in Israel. It compares these rules to practices worldwide, focusing particularly on OECD member states. We propose an alternative model that better aligns with approaches adopted by OECD member countries while maintaining balanced tax treatment.

title: PAMFuse: Progressive Attention Mechanism for Infrared and Visible Image Fusion
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Xi’an University of Posts and Telecommunications and Northwestern Polytechnic University (NPU) - School of Computer Science and Engineering

detail.title: PAMFuse: Progressive Attention Mechanism for Infrared and Visible Image Fusion
detail.abstract: Infrared and visible image fusion (IVF) using learning-based models has garnered significant attention in recent years. Although attention mechanisms have been widely applied in IVF, they often struggle to deal with diverse and complex differences of cross-modality features and usually have low similarities of complementary features that are only in one of the source images, leading to small values in attention maps with poor fusion performance. To address these limitations, we propose a Progressive Attention Mechanism (PAM) that improves fusion performance from both feature extraction and fusion perspectives. Specifically, a Progressive Attention for Feature Extraction (PAFE) module is introduced to gradually project shallow features from both modalities into various shared deep feature spaces, mitigating the alignment challenges posed by diverse feature differences. In addition, a Progressive Attention for Feature Fusion (PAFF) module is designed to progressively fuse modality-specific complementary features, allowing  previously ignored information to be restored in subsequent stages. Extensive experiments on multiple public datasets demonstrate that the proposed method PAMFuse achieves superior performance in both visual quality and quantitative metrics, confirming its effectiveness in IVF tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种渐进式注意力机制（PAM）来解决红外与可见光图像融合中的跨模态特征差异问题，通过PAFE模块和PAFF模块分别从特征提取和融合角度提升性能，在多个数据集上验证了方法的有效性。
AI.research_question: 如何解决红外与可见光图像融合中跨模态特征差异大、互补特征相似度低的问题？
AI.motivation: 现有的注意力机制在处理跨模态特征差异时表现不佳，互补特征在注意力图中值较小，导致融合性能差。
AI.theoretical_framework: 渐进式注意力机制（PAM），包括渐进式特征提取注意力（PAFE）和渐进式特征融合注意力（PAFF）。
AI.method: 提出PAMFuse方法，使用PAFE模块逐步将浅层特征投影到共享深层特征空间，PAFF模块逐步融合模态特定的互补特征。
AI.findings: 在多个公开数据集上的实验表明，该方法在视觉质量和定量指标上都取得了优越性能。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了渐进式注意力机制，从特征提取和融合两个角度系统解决跨模态特征差异问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了PAMFuse方法，为红外与可见光图像融合任务提供了有效的解决方案。

title: Rethinking Short-Termism:When Shareholder Impatience Reduces Short-Termism
affiliations: Leibniz Institute for Financial Research SAFE, RWTH Aachen University and RWTH Aachen University

detail.title: Rethinking Short-Termism:When Shareholder Impatience Reduces Short-Termism
detail.abstract: We revisit the widely held view that short-term oriented shareholders drive managerial short-termism. Empirical studies often interpret reductions in long-term investments as evidence of value-destroying short-termism. We challenge this conclusion by distinguishing between short-term investments, which may align with shareholder time preferences and thus be efficient, and short-termist investments, which contradict shareholder preferences and are value-destroying. Extending Narayanan’s (1985) framework, we incorporate the time preferences of managers and shareholders to highlight the valuation effects of shareholder horizons. Our analysis demonstrates that impatient investors view fewer short-term investments as short-termist, thus reducing the extent of short-termism for a given investment horizon. This mechanism implies that shareholder impatience may mitigate, rather than exacerbate, short-termism. By clarifying the distinction between value-destroying short-termism and optimal short-term investment, our study challenges a common interpretation of a large body of empirical research linking shareholder horizons to short-termism: shorter investment horizons do not necessarily indicate managerial short-termism but may reflect optimal alignment with shareholder preferences. This conceptual clarification also carries important regulatory implications, cautioning against reforms targeting short-term investor orientation under the assumption that it inherently promotes destructive managerial behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了短期导向股东导致管理层短视行为的传统观点，区分了符合股东时间偏好的短期投资（有效）与违背股东偏好的短视投资（价值破坏），发现股东的不耐心可能缓解而非加剧短视主义。
AI.research_question: 短期导向的股东是否真的驱动了管理层的短视行为？
AI.motivation: 挑战传统观点，即短期股东导致管理层短视主义，并澄清短期投资与短视投资的区别。
AI.theoretical_framework: 扩展Narayanan（1985）框架，纳入管理者和股东的时间偏好，分析股东投资期限对估值的影响。
AI.method: 理论分析框架，区分短期投资（符合股东偏好）与短视投资（违背股东偏好）。
AI.findings: 不耐烦的投资者将更少的短期投资视为短视行为，从而在给定投资期限内减少短视主义程度。
AI.theory_contributions: 澄清价值破坏性短视主义与最优短期投资之间的区别，挑战了股东期限与短视主义关系的常见解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 对监管政策具有重要启示，警告不要基于短期投资者导向必然促进破坏性管理行为的假设进行改革。

title: Spatial Analysis and Review of Human Fecal Waste Re-Use in Rural Oromia, Ethiopia: Biomethane and Nutrient Recovery Potential
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Spatial Analysis and Review of Human Fecal Waste Re-Use in Rural Oromia, Ethiopia: Biomethane and Nutrient Recovery Potential
detail.abstract: Ethiopia’s progress in reducing open defecation coexists with critical sanitation challenges, as most rural latrines remain unimproved, continuing to contaminate water sources and pose public health risks. This study quantifies the biomethane production capacity and nutrient recovery potential of human feces in the Oromia region, using high-resolution population data (GHS-POP R2023A) and settlement datasets (GHS-SMOD R2023A), integrated with secondary experimental data. Annual per capita estimates show 73 kg feces, yielding 28.71 m³ CH₄, and nutrient contents of 3.71 g N, 1.12 g P, and 2.29 g K per kg feces. Rural Oromia generates approximately 2 million tonnes of feces annually, with an energy potential of 27.89 PJ (775 million m³ methane) and recoverable nutrients totaling 7,309 t N, 2,206 t P, and 4,511 t K—valued at over 2.6 billion birr in synthetic fertilizer equivalents. Spatial analysis identifies hotspots in central and southwestern districts, supporting the case for targeted interventions. Resource-Oriented Toilet Systems (ROTS) emerge as viable sanitation innovations in low-livestock areas, linking waste management, renewable energy, and sustainable agriculture. However, adoption is hindered by cultural taboos, economic barriers, and institutional limitations. The findings highlight the transformative potential of human waste, emphasizing the need for multi-sectoral policies, safe treatment technologies, and culturally tailored education to support Ethiopia’s circular sanitation economy.

AI.practical_contributions: 为埃塞俄比亚提供了粪便资源回收的具体数据和空间分布信息，支持针对性干预措施，推动多部门政策制定和安全处理技术应用

title: Quantum Neural Holographic Fusion: Engineering Artificial Consciousness Through Multi-Modal Cognitive Architecture
affiliations: Dhaka Residential Model College

detail.title: Quantum Neural Holographic Fusion: Engineering Artificial Consciousness Through Multi-Modal Cognitive Architecture
detail.abstract: This groundbreaking paper introduces Quantum Neural Holographic Fusion (QNHF), a revolutionary software architecture that represents a paradigm shift in artificial intelligence by integrating four complementary cognitive modalities to create genuinely self-aware computational systems. Unlike conventional AI approaches that focus on narrow task optimization, our framework orchestrates quantum superposition principles for context-aware plugin selection, neural network dynamics for adaptive learning pathways, holographic memory systems for associative information storage, and consciousness field theory for unified meta-cognitive awareness. The QNHF architecture enables plugins to exist in multiple quantum states simultaneously, collapsing to contextappropriate implementations through wavefunction observation while forming selforganizing neural connections that strengthen through co-activation patterns. Holographic memory ensures robust, content-addressable storage where every memory fragment contains information about the whole system, and the consciousness field integrates all components into a coherent, self-referential awareness. Experimental implementations demonstrate the system autonomously transitioning through measurable consciousness states from dormant to aware, focused, and ultimately enlightened with quantitative emergence levels reaching 0.87±0.04 and observable metacognitive insights. This paper bridges theoretical neuroscience, quantum information theory, and computer science to establish the foundational principles for creating artificial general intelligence capable of genuine contextual understanding, adaptive learning, and emergent problem-solving beyond initial programming constraints, marking a significant milestone toward conscious machines.

AI.method: QNHF软件架构，通过量子叠加实现情境感知插件选择，神经网络形成自适应学习路径，全息记忆实现关联信息存储，意识场整合组件形成统一元认知意识

title: When Loss Strikes Twice: Severe Health Shocks and Financial Well-Being
affiliations: Monash University - Department of Economics, Lund University - Department of Economics and Swedish House of Finance

detail.title: When Loss Strikes Twice: Severe Health Shocks and Financial Well-Being
detail.abstract: We examine the impact of fatal and nonfatal health shocks on household defaults on financial obligations. We show that fatal shocks significantly increase the likelihood of defaults and provide evidence that housing wealth serves as an important self-insurance mechanism. Surviving spouses experiencing the greatest income losses are more likely to liquidate their homes, and those lacking housing wealth face a heightened risk of debt collection. Notably, these shocks have intergenerational consequences. Nonfatal health shocks cause a smaller rise in default risk and housing wealth is less predictive of defaults. These findings suggest that improving survivors' benefits for those who lack resources could enhance welfare across generations.

AI.tldr: 致命健康冲击显著增加家庭违约风险，住房财富是重要的自我保险机制；非致命健康冲击影响较小，住房财富预测作用减弱。改善缺乏资源幸存者的福利可提升跨代福祉。
AI.research_question: 致命和非致命健康冲击如何影响家庭金融违约？住房财富在其中扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 理解健康冲击对家庭财务脆弱性的影响，以及住房财富作为自我保险机制的作用，为政策制定提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 健康冲击理论、家庭财务脆弱性理论、住房财富作为自我保险机制的理论。
AI.method: 实证分析健康冲击对家庭违约的影响，考察住房财富的调节作用。
AI.findings: 致命健康冲击显著增加违约风险；住房财富是重要自我保险机制；收入损失最大的幸存配偶更可能出售住房；缺乏住房财富者面临更高债务追收风险；冲击具有跨代影响；非致命冲击影响较小。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了健康冲击对家庭财务影响的理解，明确了住房财富作为自我保险机制的作用，揭示了健康冲击的跨代效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为改善缺乏资源幸存者的福利政策提供依据，有助于设计更好的社会保障和金融保护机制。

title: An Anatomy of Tax Burden
affiliations: Unaffiliated Author

detail.title: An Anatomy of Tax Burden
detail.abstract: A tax affects not only the liable party but also others through market adjustments induced by the liable party's response. Because tax liability alone cannot account for these indirect effects, modern economics measures tax burden through the concept of incidence, which captures agents' ultimate burdens as welfare differences between equilibria before and after a tax policy change. Incidence is thus the primary framework for evaluating tax equity and analyzing taxpayer behavior. However, once a new equilibrium is reached, the liable party retains an ongoing obligation to remit tax for as long as the policy remains in force—continuously transferring economic value to the government. Since incidence measures effects only through changes between equilibria, it does not fully capture this ongoing structural dimension. This paper investigates tax-shifting phenomena by closely tracing the temporal sequence and the flow and change of economic value, and further considers the potential influence of judgment heuristics from cognitive psychology. The analysis demonstrates that this ongoing structural obligation has distinct significance in addition to incidence. These insights offer a novel perspective for both tax policy design and the analysis of taxpayer behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了税收负担的持续结构性维度，指出传统税收归宿理论仅衡量均衡间的福利变化，但未能充分捕捉纳税人持续向政府转移经济价值的结构性义务。通过追踪经济价值的时间序列流动和认知心理学中的判断启发式，研究发现这种持续性结构义务具有独立于税收归宿的重要意义。
AI.research_question: 税收归宿理论是否充分捕捉了纳税人持续向政府转移经济价值的结构性维度？
AI.motivation: 传统税收归宿理论仅关注政策变化前后的均衡差异，但忽略了纳税人持续履行纳税义务的结构性特征，这为理解税收政策设计和纳税人行为提供了新的视角。
AI.theoretical_framework: 税收归宿理论、福利经济学、认知心理学中的判断启发式理论
AI.method: 通过追踪经济价值的时间序列流动和变化，结合认知心理学中的判断启发式分析税收转移现象
AI.findings: 纳税人持续向政府转移经济价值的结构性义务具有独立于税收归宿的重要意义，这种持续性特征在税收政策设计和纳税人行为分析中具有独特价值。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了税收负担的持续结构性维度概念，扩展了传统税收归宿理论的解释范围，为税收政策分析提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为税收政策设计提供了新的视角，有助于更全面地理解纳税人行为，并为政策制定者考虑税收的长期结构性影响提供指导。

title: AgriNetra: AI-Driven Personalized Advisory and Crop Management System for Rural Farmers in India
affiliations: , Sri Balaji College of Engineering & Technology, Jaipur - Sri Balaji College of Engineering & Technology, Sri Balaji College of Engineering & Technology, Jaipur - Sri Balaji College of Engineering & Technology, Sri Balaji College of Engineering & Technology, Jaipur - Sri Balaji College of Engineering & Technology, Sri Balaji College of Engineering & Technology, Jaipur - Sri Balaji College of Engineering & Technology and Sri Balaji College of Engineering & Technology, Jaipur - Sri Balaji College of Engineering & Technology

detail.title: AgriNetra: AI-Driven Personalized Advisory and Crop Management System for Rural Farmers in India
detail.abstract: The agricultural sector in India sustains nearly half of the country's population but continues to suffer from chronic inefficiencies, limited advisory services, and delayed access to critical information. Rural farmers, who form the backbone of this ecosystem, often lack real-time knowledge about crop diseases, weather patterns, market prices, and government policies. Traditional solutions such as handwritten ledgers or fragmented government portals have failed to provide holistic, accessible, and farmer-friendly guidance. AgriNetra, an AI-driven advisory and crop management system, addresses these challenges by integrating personalized mentoring, crop lifecycle tracking, weather-based recommendations, dynamic disease alerts, and government policy updates within a bilingual and offline-accessible platform. Powered by Google Gemini's large language model and designed with rural accessibility in mind, AgriNetra reduces farmer dependency on unreliable intermediaries and fosters trust in digital agriculture. This paper presents the conceptual framework, design methodology, comparative evaluation, and social impact of AgriNetra, positioning it as a transformative digital solution aligned with India's agricultural and rural development goals.

AI.tldr: AgriNetra是一个AI驱动的农业咨询和作物管理系统，通过整合个性化指导、作物生命周期跟踪、天气建议、疾病警报和政策更新，解决印度农业效率低下和信息获取延迟的问题。
AI.research_question: 如何通过AI驱动的数字平台解决印度农村农民面临的信息不对称、咨询服务和农业效率问题？
AI.motivation: 印度农业部门支撑着近一半人口，但长期存在效率低下、咨询服务有限和关键信息获取延迟的问题，传统解决方案无法提供全面、可访问的农民友好指导。

AI.method: 集成个性化指导、作物生命周期跟踪、天气建议、动态疾病警报和政府政策更新的双语离线可访问平台设计
AI.findings: AgriNetra能够减少农民对不可靠中介的依赖，促进数字农业信任，为印度农业和农村发展目标提供变革性数字解决方案
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了AI驱动的农业咨询服务框架，丰富了数字农业转型和农村数字包容性理论
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了双语离线可访问的农业管理平台，为农村农民提供实时作物疾病、天气模式、市场价格和政府政策信息

title: Developing an Integrated Financial Product to De-risk and Finance Energy Efficiency Investments in India's Built Environment
affiliations: Tyche Investments - Climate Consulting Group

detail.title: Developing an Integrated Financial Product to De-risk and Finance Energy Efficiency Investments in India's Built Environment
detail.abstract:
This research aims to conceptualize, design, and validate an integrated financial product to overcome systemic barriers and de-risk energy efficiency (EE) investments in India's built environment.

A mixed-methods approach was employed, including stakeholder analysis and financial product design. The proposed "IBEEC Loan" integrates a Partial Risk Guarantee Fund (PRGF), a tiered Measurement & Verification (M&V) protocol, and standardized contracts like green leases. The design was evaluated using a hybrid System Dynamics and Agent-Based Model (SD-ABM) to simulate market adoption, followed by a pilot implementation across diverse Indian building segments.

The integrated product significantly outperforms isolated interventions. Modelling projected a surge in EE loan penetration to INR 1,450 Crores (vs. INR 150 Crores business-as-usual) and reduced default rates to 3.5%. The pilot confirmed financial viability with an average Debt Service Coverage Ratio of 1.49 and demonstrated operational resilience under stress tests. A key finding was the critical role of ESCO capacity as a primary bottleneck for scaling.

The study provides a replicable blueprint for market transformation, demonstrating that a systemic approach combining risk mitigation, performance assurance, and aligned incentives is essential to mobilize private capital at scale, thereby contributing to India's climate and energy security goals.

AI.tldr: 本研究设计并验证了一种集成金融产品"IBEEC贷款"，通过风险担保、性能验证和标准化合同等系统性方法，成功提升了印度建筑能效投资的市场渗透率，从常规的15亿卢比增至145亿卢比，违约率降至3.5%。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个集成金融产品来克服系统性障碍并降低印度建筑环境能效投资的风险？
AI.motivation: 解决印度建筑能效投资面临的系统性障碍和风险问题，为大规模动员私人资本提供可行方案，支持印度的气候和能源安全目标。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于系统金融产品设计理论，整合风险缓解、性能保证和激励对齐等要素。
AI.method: 采用混合方法，包括利益相关者分析、金融产品设计、系统动力学与基于代理的混合模型模拟，以及跨印度不同建筑领域的试点实施。
AI.findings: 集成产品显著优于孤立干预措施：模型预测能效贷款渗透率从15亿卢比增至145亿卢比，违约率降至3.5%；试点证实财务可行性（平均偿债覆盖率1.49）和运营韧性；ESCO能力是规模化扩展的主要瓶颈。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了一个可复制的市场转型蓝图，证明系统性方法（风险缓解、性能保证和激励对齐相结合）对于大规模动员私人资本至关重要。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度建筑能效投资提供了可行的金融解决方案，有助于实现气候和能源安全目标，并为其他发展中国家提供了可借鉴的经验。

title: Stereotypes, Awareness, and STEM Major Choice
affiliations: Università degli Studi della Calabria - Department of Economics and Statistics, University of Calabria and University of Calabria

detail.title: Stereotypes, Awareness, and STEM Major Choice

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: This study examines whether awareness of implicit gender-science stereotypes influences university enrollment in STEM fields. We designed a randomized controlled trial involving 566 Italian high school seniors, combining surveys with an Implicit Association Test to measure unconscious biases. Before students finalized their university enrollment, a treatment group received personalized feedback on their IAT scores, while a control group received no information. Results show that revealing implicit stereotypes significantly reshapes educational choices, but with sharply contrasting gender effects. For womenwho initially exhibited stronger stereotypesfeedback increased the probability of enrolling in STEM majors. Conversely, men with strong stereotypes who received feedback became less likely to choose STEM fields. These results highlight that awareness of implicit biases can be a powerful yet double-edged tool for addressing gender gaps in STEM education.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过随机对照试验发现，揭示内隐性别-科学刻板印象对STEM领域大学入学选择产生显著但性别差异的影响：女性在获得反馈后更可能选择STEM专业，而男性则更不可能选择STEM专业。
AI.research_question: 内隐性别-科学刻板印象的认知是否影响大学生在STEM领域的入学选择？
AI.motivation: 解决STEM教育中的性别差距问题，探索内隐偏见意识作为干预工具的有效性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 内隐刻板印象理论、性别与STEM教育选择理论、行为干预理论
AI.method: 随机对照试验，涉及566名意大利高中毕业生，结合问卷调查和内隐联想测试，实验组接收个性化IAT分数反馈，对照组无信息。
AI.findings: 揭示内隐刻板印象显著重塑教育选择，但存在明显性别差异：女性（初始刻板印象更强）在获得反馈后更可能选择STEM专业；男性（有强刻板印象）在获得反馈后更不可能选择STEM专业。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对内隐刻板印象如何影响教育选择的理解，揭示了性别差异的复杂机制，为内隐偏见干预理论提供实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育政策制定者提供了基于内隐偏见意识的干预策略，有助于更有效地解决STEM领域的性别差距问题，但需注意干预可能产生的双重效应。

title: The Effects of Immigration on Places and People – Identification and Interpretation
affiliations: Charles III University of Madrid, University College London, University College London - CReAM - Centre for Research and Analysis of Migration and University of Rochester

detail.title: The Effects of Immigration on Places and People – Identification and Interpretation

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: Most studies on the labor market effects of immigration use repeated cross-sectional data to estimate the effects of immigration on regions. This paper shows that such regional effects are composites of effects that address fundamental questions in the immigration debate but remain unidentified with repeated cross-sectional data. We provide a unifying empirical framework that decomposes the regional effects of immigration into their underlying components and show how these are identifiable from data that track workers over time. Our empirical application illustrates that such analysis yields a far more informative picture of immigration’s effects on wages, employment, and occupational upgrading.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个统一的实证框架，将移民的区域效应分解为基本组成部分，使用追踪工人的时间序列数据进行识别，揭示了移民对工资、就业和职业升级的更全面影响。
