title: Sovereignty as a Priced Asset: Brexit and the UK's Fiscal Capacity
affiliations: Northwestern University, Kellogg School of Management

detail.title: Sovereignty as a Priced Asset: Brexit and the UK's Fiscal Capacity
detail.abstract: This paper develops a positive theory of the financial consequences of political sovereignty, using the United Kingdom as a natural experiment. The 2016 Brexit referendum is modelled as a sovereignty shock—a fall in the country’s fiscal and financial integration with the European core—while the 2022 “Truss mini-budget’’ represents a fiscal shock under reduced integration. In a continuous-time international asset-pricing model with incomplete risk sharing and an endogenous fiscal constraint, lower integration tightens fiscal capacity, raises gilt risk premia, and reduces their convenience yield as safe assets. These channels widen the gilt–Bund spread, increase the EUR/GBP currency risk premium, and depreciate sterling through a modified uncovered-interest-parity condition. Calibrated to event-study data, the model reproduces the observed 10–15 bp rise in spreads, 40 bp increase in currency risk premia, 6–10 percent pound depreciation after Brexit, and the 2022 gilt yield spike. The results quantify the financial price of sovereignty: autonomy amplifies market discipline but reduces fiscal space.

AI.tldr: 本文通过英国脱欧作为自然实验，构建了政治主权对金融影响的正向理论。研究发现主权冲击会收紧财政能力、提高国债风险溢价、降低安全资产便利收益，导致英镑贬值。量化结果显示主权有金融代价：自主性增强市场纪律但减少财政空间。
AI.research_question: 政治主权对金融后果的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 利用英国脱欧作为自然实验，研究主权冲击对金融市场的系统性影响
AI.theoretical_framework: 连续时间国际资产定价模型，包含不完全风险分担和内生财政约束
AI.method: 理论建模与事件研究数据校准相结合的方法
AI.findings: 主权冲击导致国债-德国国债利差扩大10-15bp，货币风险溢价增加40bp，英镑贬值6-10%，2022年国债收益率飙升
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了主权冲击影响金融市场的理论框架，揭示了财政能力、风险溢价和便利收益的传导机制
AI.practical_contributions: 量化了主权的金融代价，为政策制定者理解主权与金融稳定关系提供参考

title: The Evolution of Portfolio Theory: Integrating Machine Learning with Markowitz Optimization
affiliations: University of Edinburgh

detail.title: The Evolution of Portfolio Theory: Integrating Machine Learning with Markowitz Optimization
detail.abstract: Modern Portfolio Theory (MPT), developed by Harry Markowitz, transformed investment practices by wisely balancing risk and return. Nonetheless, its efficacy wanes in fluctuating financial markets due to its dependence on historical data and fixed assumptions. This paper investigates incorporating Machine Learning (ML) techniques into the traditional Markowitz optimization framework to enhance portfolio construction and risk management processes. It highlights the use of supervised learning for forecasting asset returns, unsupervised learning for asset clustering, and reinforcement learning for adjusting portfolios dynamically. An empirical analysis utilizing recent U.S. market data reveals that ML models improve risk assessment, asset selection, and adaptive portfolio allocation. Techniques such as linear regression, clustering algorithms, and principal component analysis (PCA) facilitate superior forecasting and portfolio design in various market environments. The research also shows that ML can enhance Sharpe ratios in specific market conditions compared to conventional MPT. ML increases portfolio flexibility and robustness by aligning predictive modeling with optimization objectives. This evolving methodology lays the foundation for a more responsive, data-informed investment strategy in today's finance, providing a viable alternative to the limitations of traditional models.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨将机器学习技术整合到传统Markowitz投资组合优化框架中，以改进投资组合构建和风险管理。实证分析显示机器学习模型能提升风险评估、资产选择和适应性资产配置能力，在特定市场条件下优于传统现代投资组合理论。
AI.research_question: 如何将机器学习技术整合到传统Markowitz投资组合优化框架中，以增强投资组合构建和风险管理？
AI.motivation: 现代投资组合理论在波动金融市场中效果减弱，因其依赖历史数据和固定假设。机器学习技术能够提供更动态和适应性强的解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Markowitz的现代投资组合理论，结合机器学习理论框架，包括监督学习、无监督学习和强化学习。
AI.method: 使用美国市场数据进行实证分析，应用线性回归、聚类算法和主成分分析等机器学习技术进行资产收益预测、资产聚类和动态投资组合调整。
AI.findings: 机器学习模型能够改善风险评估、资产选择和适应性资产配置，在特定市场条件下能够提高夏普比率。
AI.theory_contributions: 将机器学习与传统投资组合理论相结合，为投资组合优化提供了新的理论框架和方法论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资实践提供了更灵活、稳健的投资组合管理方法，能够更好地适应不同市场环境，提高投资绩效。

title: Do Capital Requirements and Their International Differences Affect Banks' Profitability?
affiliations: Halle Institute for Economic Research, Deutsche Bundesbank and

detail.title: Do Capital Requirements and Their International Differences Affect Banks' Profitability?

publicationDetails.journalName: Deutsche Bundesbank Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: A key element of the Basel III reforms are stricter capital requirements, which have been implemented with varying degrees of stringency across jurisdictions. We examine the impact of these requirements on bank profitability in the US and Europe between 2019 and 2024. We find no evidence that higher capital ratios or requirements negatively affect profitability. However, our results indicate that international differences in capital requirements can influence the profitability of banks that operate globally: Since capital requirements in a jurisdiction apply only to domestic banks and foreign subsidiaries, foreign banks operating through cross-border or branch-based activities may gain a competitive advantage. Nevertheless, the effect appears to be limited to the subsample of German significant institutions (SIs). Moreover, our analysis of policy scenarios based on the estimated spillover effects suggests that lowering capital requirements is not an effective strategy for improving bank profitability and could even be detrimental if reciprocated by foreign jurisdictions.

AI.tldr: 巴塞尔III改革中更严格的资本要求对银行盈利能力没有负面影响，但国际差异可能给跨境经营的银行带来竞争优势，不过这种效应仅限于德国重要机构。降低资本要求并非改善银行盈利的有效策略。
AI.research_question: 巴塞尔III资本要求对欧美银行盈利能力的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 巴塞尔III改革在不同司法管辖区以不同程度严格实施，需要研究这些资本要求对银行盈利能力的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于银行资本监管理论和国际银行业竞争理论，分析资本要求对银行盈利的影响机制。
AI.method: 使用2019-2024年欧美银行数据，分析资本比率和资本要求对盈利能力的影响，并评估政策情景。
AI.findings: 更高的资本比率或要求不会负面影响盈利能力；国际资本要求差异可能给跨境经营的银行带来竞争优势，但仅限于德国重要机构；降低资本要求不是改善盈利的有效策略。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对资本监管与银行盈利能力关系的理解，揭示了国际资本要求差异的竞争效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构制定资本政策提供实证依据，建议不要通过降低资本要求来提升银行盈利，因为可能产生负面溢出效应。

title: The Decline of Congregate Care in the United States Foster Care System, 2004-2022
affiliations: Pennsylvania State University - Penn State, Washington University in St-Louis and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The Decline of Congregate Care in the United States Foster Care System, 2004-2022
detail.abstract: BackgroundThe use of congregate care (CC) has declined substantially in the US in the past 20 years. The Family First Prevention Services Act of 2018 (FFPSA), which sought to curb the use of CC, is often understood to be a central driver in this decline. However, much of the decline occurred in the years preceding FFPSA. The nature of the decline in the years preceding and following FFPSA remains unknown.ObjectivesTo understand how states reduced CC from 136,000 placements in 2004 to 39,000 placements in 2022.Participants and SettingAll children in out-of-home care in 2004, 2018, and 2022 in the US.MethodsThis study uses federal foster care census files and decomposition analysis to examine national and state-specific changes in CC placements before and after FFPSA, which limited federal cost sharing for CC placements. We decompose the difference in CC placements between 2004 and 2018 (pre-FFPSA) and the difference between 2018 and 2022 (post-FFPSA).ResultsCC placements declined by 69,411 between 2004 and 2018, driven by reduced shares of older, behaviorally-complex children in the foster care system and reduced use of CC for younger, lower-needs children. CC placements declined by 28,077 between 2018 and 2022, overwhelmingly due to decreases in the foster care population size rather than reduced use of CC within foster care.ConclusionsStates’ capacity to maintain older and behaviorally-complex children into kinship or other family foster care remains limited following FFPSA; rather, those children are less likely to enter foster care at all.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了美国集体照料使用量从2004年13.6万例下降到2022年3.9万例的原因。研究发现，在FFPSA法案前，下降主要源于寄养系统中年龄较大、行为复杂儿童比例减少；FFPSA法案后，下降主要源于寄养人口规模整体减少而非集体照料使用率降低。
AI.research_question: 美国各州如何将集体照料安置从2004年的136,000例减少到2022年的39,000例？
AI.motivation: 理解在FFPSA法案前后集体照料使用量下降的性质和原因，因为大部分下降发生在FFPSA法案之前。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分解分析框架，用于区分集体照料变化的不同驱动因素。
AI.method: 使用联邦寄养普查数据和分解分析方法，分析2004-2018年（FFPSA前）和2018-2022年（FFPSA后）集体照料安置的国家和州级变化。
AI.findings: 2004-2018年间集体照料减少69,411例，主要由于寄养系统中年龄较大、行为复杂儿童比例减少；2018-2022年间减少28,077例，主要由于寄养人口规模减少。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了FFPSA法案对集体照料使用的实际影响机制，挑战了该法案是集体照料下降主要驱动因素的传统观点。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于集体照料减少具体机制的证据，表明各州在将年龄较大、行为复杂儿童安置到亲属或其他家庭寄养方面的能力仍然有限。

title: XdoP Benchmark: 20-Year Academic Adoption Roadmap (2026-2045) Mobile Distributed Data Center Performance, Resilience, and Operational Readiness Standard

detail.title: XdoP Benchmark: 20-Year Academic Adoption Roadmap (2026-2045) Mobile Distributed Data Center Performance, Resilience, and Operational Readiness Standard

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the Founder of Zuup and the principal architect of the XdoP Benchmark framework described in this roadmap. The author has a professional interest in the adoption and success of this standard, as it may benefit companies and organizations involved in mobile distributed data center development, testing, and certification. This roadmap is proposed as an open standard framework intended for broad industry adoption through a multi-stakeholder consortium model. The author advocates for transparent governance, balanced representation of stakeholders (vendors, operators, government, academia), and open-source implementation to prevent regulatory capture or unfair competitive advantage. No financial compensation has been received for the development of this roadmap, and the author welcomes collaboration with industry, government, and academic stakeholders in refining and implementing this framework.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This research does not involve human subjects, patient data, or experiments requiring ethics approval. This paper presents a technical standards roadmap and policy framework for industry adoption.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The XdoP Benchmark roadmap was developed independently by the author. The roadmap proposes future funding mechanisms for a potential XdoP Standards Consortium (including government grants, industry membership dues, and certification fees), but no such funding currently exists. This document represents a pre-competitive standards proposal intended to stimulate community discussion and collaboration.

detail.abstract: The XdoP Benchmark represents the first comprehensive, physics-grounded methodology for evaluating Mobile Distributed Data Centers (MDDCs) across seven critical operational domains. This 20-year adoption roadmap establishes the strategic framework for transforming the XdoP Benchmark from an initial methodology into a globally recognized industry standard that enables regulatory compliance, drives technology innovation, and ensures mission-critical system reliability. By 2045, the XdoP Benchmark will serve as the universal standard for MDDC evaluation, integrated into international regulatory frameworks, procurement specifications, and certification programs worldwide, driving $500B+ in MDDC deployments while achieving 50% reduction in operational carbon footprint.

AI.tldr: XdoP基准是首个全面、基于物理学的移动分布式数据中心评估方法，涵盖7个关键运营领域。该20年采用路线图旨在将其从初始方法发展为全球行业标准，推动监管合规、技术创新和系统可靠性，到2045年成为MDDC评估的通用标准。
AI.research_question: 如何建立移动分布式数据中心(MDDC)的综合评估标准并推动其成为全球行业标准？
AI.motivation: 当前缺乏针对移动分布式数据中心的全面评估方法，需要建立物理基础的标准化框架来支持行业发展、监管合规和技术创新。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于物理学的评估方法论，涵盖七个关键运营领域的多维评估框架。
AI.method: 采用20年采用路线图的战略框架方法，从方法论发展为行业标准。
AI.findings: XdoP基准能够成为MDDC评估的全球标准，预计到2045年将推动5000亿美元以上的MDDC部署，同时实现运营碳足迹减少50%。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了首个基于物理学的移动分布式数据中心综合评估理论框架，填补了该领域标准化评估的理论空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为MDDC行业提供了可操作的评估标准，支持监管合规、技术创新和可持续发展目标，具有显著的经济和环境效益。

title: Geopolitics and Innovation: A Systematic Literature Review of Firm Responses to the U.S.-China Trade War

detail.title: Geopolitics and Innovation: A Systematic Literature Review of Firm Responses to the U.S.-China Trade War
detail.abstract:
Purpose: This study aims to systematically examine how the U.S.-China trade war has shaped firm-level innovation activities. It identifies key risk factors triggered by geopolitical tensions, analyzes firm-level responses, and evaluates long-term strategic shifts in innovation and industrial strategies.

Methodology: The study employed a systematic literature review (SLR) approach following established guidelines for transparent and replicable synthesis. A structured search across ScienceDirect, JSTOR, and Emerald databases was conducted using Boolean keyword combinations related to the trade war and innovation. A total of sixteen empirical studies were identified and analyzed descriptively, focusing on theoretical mechanisms, empirical findings, and contextual variations. Findings: The review finds that the trade war introduced substantial trade policy uncertainty (TPU), producing heterogeneous impacts across firms and sectors. Financially constrained and export-dependent firms reduced R&D and experienced declines in patent quality, while larger firms and those with state support increased innovation. Common adaptive responses included geographic diversification of R&D, ESG-driven innovation, and the pursuit of indigenous technologies. TPU thus functions not only as a constraint but also as a conditional driver of "precautionary innovation" aimed at reducing foreign dependence and securing long-term competitiveness.

Unique Contribution to Theory, Policy and Practice: This study provides one of the first systematic syntheses of firm-level innovation responses to the U.S.-China trade war. It contributes to theory by framing trade policy uncertainty as both a deterrent and a stimulus to innovation. For policymakers, it highlights the importance of coordinated industrial policies that enhance resilience and technological self-reliance. For practitioners, it offers insights into how firms can transform external shocks into opportunities for long-term strategic adaptation and innovation-led competitiveness.

AI.tldr: 本研究系统分析了中美贸易战如何影响企业创新活动，发现贸易政策不确定性既抑制了财务受限企业的研发投入，又推动了大型企业的预防性创新，促使企业采取地理多元化、ESG创新和本土技术发展等适应性策略。
AI.research_question: 中美贸易战如何影响企业层面的创新活动？
AI.motivation: 系统考察中美贸易战引发的地缘政治紧张局势对企业创新的影响，识别关键风险因素并分析企业应对策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贸易政策不确定性(TPU)理论框架，将TPU视为创新的约束条件和条件性驱动因素。
AI.method: 采用系统性文献综述(SLR)方法，在ScienceDirect、JSTOR和Emerald数据库中检索，分析16项实证研究。
AI.findings: 贸易战引入的TPU对企业产生异质性影响：财务受限和出口依赖企业减少研发投入，专利质量下降；大型企业和获得国家支持的企业增加创新；企业采取地理多元化、ESG创新和本土技术发展等适应性策略。
AI.theory_contributions: 将贸易政策不确定性理论化为创新的双重作用机制——既是抑制因素又是刺激因素，提出"预防性创新"概念。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供增强韧性和技术自主的产业政策建议，为企业提供将外部冲击转化为长期战略适应机会的实践指导。

title: Lithium’s “resource curse”: aquatic environment risks from the Chinese clean energy industry
affiliations: Minzu University of China, Minzu University of China, Guangdong Yuehai Water Investment Co., Ltd., Minzu University of China, Minzu University of China, Minzu University of China, Minzu University of China, Minzu University of China, Ghent University, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Minzu University of China, Minzu University of China and Inner Mongolia University of Technology

detail.title: Lithium’s “resource curse”: aquatic environment risks from the Chinese clean energy industry
detail.abstract: Rapidly increasing lithium-ion battery production, central to transitioning to clean energy, is increasing anthropogenic lithium emissions to aquatic environments. China supplies 77% of global lithium-ion battery capacity but lacks national monitoring of lithium in water and faces environmental risks. We determined lithium in water samples from around China and reached three conclusions. (1) Lithium concentrations in tap water strongly spatially vary. Concentrations were higher in western cities than eastern cities (p=0.0096) because of geological sources (e.g., salt lakes) and mining. The lithium concentration in tap water from Lhasa was 77.8 µg L−1, 7.8 times the US Environmental Protection Agency reference concentration. (2) The mean and median lithium concentrations in Yangtze River water were 29.4% and 34.0% higher, respectively, in 2025 than 2006 and were higher downstream than upstream of mining hubs. (3) Wastewater treatments gives very low lithium removal efficiencies (<16% for anaerobic–oxic and anaerobic–anoxic–oxic processes), meaning lithium accumulates in aquatic environments. These results indicate a triple paradox – resource abundance/ecological vulnerability, industry growth/inadequate pollution control, and emerging health risks/regulatory gaps – that require urgent lifecycle governance strategies to align lithium utilization with UN Sustainable Development Goals 6 (Clean Water and Sanitation) and 12 (Responsible Consumption and Production).

AI.tldr: 中国锂离子电池产量快速增长导致水生环境中锂排放增加。研究发现：自来水锂浓度西部高于东部，拉萨超标7.8倍；长江水锂浓度2025年比2006年显著上升；废水处理对锂去除效率低(<16%)，存在资源丰富/生态脆弱、产业增长/污染控制不足、健康风险/监管缺失三重悖论。
AI.research_question: 中国水生环境中锂污染的空间分布特征、时间变化趋势及其环境风险是什么？
AI.motivation: 锂离子电池生产快速增长，中国占全球77%产能但缺乏国家水锂监测，面临环境风险
AI.theoretical_framework: 生命周期治理理论、可持续发展目标框架、环境风险评估理论
AI.method: 采集中国各地水样测定锂浓度，分析空间分布差异和时间变化趋势，评估废水处理效率
AI.findings: 1)自来水锂浓度西部高于东部，拉萨超标7.8倍；2)长江水锂浓度2025年比2006年上升29.4-34.0%；3)废水处理锂去除效率<16%
AI.theory_contributions: 提出锂污染三重悖论理论框架，丰富环境治理与可持续发展理论
AI.practical_contributions: 为制定锂生命周期治理策略提供科学依据，支持实现联合国可持续发展目标6和12

title: Increasing price transparency in the Dutch healthcare market does not affect provider choice
affiliations: Tilburg University, Tilburg University - Department of Econometrics & Operations Research, University of Twente and Tilburg University

detail.title: Increasing price transparency in the Dutch healthcare market does not affect provider choice
detail.abstract: AbstractPrice transparency is often viewed as an effective way to encourage price shopping and thereby lower healthcare expenditure. We use individual claims data to estimate the short-run effect of unexpected publication of prices by a major Dutch health insurer on spending and provider choice. The media reported prominently on potential savings and visits to websites providing information on prices initially increased. Another major insurer had negotiated different prices and did not publish them, so its patients serve as the control group in a difference-in-differences analysis. We first perform a case study of 6 frequent, non-emergency dermatological procedures. We find that spending, the likelihood to visit a new provider, and the distance traveled to the chosen provider remained unaffected. Next, we analyze a broader set of 675 procedures. We estimate the effect for each procedure and then perform a Bayesian meta-analysis to summarize the results. Again, we find that there is no effect of price transparency on spending. We provide an explanation for this and make a suggestion for a policy change that would make it more likely that patients choose cheaper providers.

AI.tldr: 荷兰健康保险公司意外公布医疗价格后，短期内对医疗支出和提供者选择没有显著影响，价格透明度政策未能降低医疗费用。
AI.research_question: 价格透明度政策是否能够有效降低医疗支出并影响患者对医疗服务提供者的选择？
AI.motivation: 价格透明度通常被视为鼓励价格比较从而降低医疗支出的有效方式，但实际效果需要实证验证。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于价格透明度理论和消费者行为理论，假设价格信息公开会促使患者选择更便宜的医疗服务提供者。
AI.method: 使用个体索赔数据，采用双重差分法分析，以未公布价格的另一家主要保险公司患者作为对照组。
AI.findings: 价格透明度政策对医疗支出、更换提供者的可能性以及就诊距离均无显著影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了价格透明度必然降低医疗支出的传统观点，揭示了信息不对称之外的障碍因素。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议政策调整以更有效地促使患者选择更便宜的医疗服务提供者。

title: Machine Learning-Based Lead Prioritization to Enhance B2C Sales Efficiency
affiliations: Maharaja Agrasen Institute of Technology, Maharaja Agrasen Institute of Technology, Maharaja Agrasen Institute of Technology and Maharaja Agrasen Institute of Technology

detail.title: Machine Learning-Based Lead Prioritization to Enhance B2C Sales Efficiency
detail.abstract: This paper presents a machine learning-driven approach to lead prioritization that replaces the traditional first-come, first-serve (FCFS) system in customer relationship management (CRM). The proposed system predicts conversion probabilities for incoming leads and dynamically assigns priority levels, ensuring that high-potential leads are addressed first. Using a production-scale dataset of more than 380,000 records, the XGBoost model achieved an ROC-AUC of 0.9158, PR-AUC of 0.3604, accuracy of 0.9241, precision of 0.315 and F1 score of 0.3919. The results confirm that the model outperforms heuristic FCFS allocation by identifying promising leads early in the pipeline. We detail the methodology, deployment architecture, and evaluation metrics, providing a replicable framework for intelligent CRM automation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于机器学习的潜在客户优先级排序方法，取代了传统的先到先得系统。使用XGBoost模型在38万条记录的数据集上实现了高准确率，能够早期识别高转化概率的潜在客户。
AI.research_question: 机器学习方法是否能比传统先到先得系统更有效地对潜在客户进行优先级排序？
AI.motivation: 传统CRM系统中的先到先得分配方式无法有效识别高价值潜在客户，导致销售资源分配效率低下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于机器学习预测模型的客户关系管理优化理论
AI.method: 使用XGBoost模型对38万条生产规模数据集进行训练，预测潜在客户的转化概率并动态分配优先级
AI.findings: XGBoost模型在ROC-AUC、准确率等指标上表现优异（ROC-AUC: 0.9158, 准确率: 0.9241），显著优于传统先到先得分配方法
AI.theory_contributions: 为CRM系统提供了基于机器学习的智能优先级分配理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个可复制的智能CRM自动化框架，能够提高销售团队的工作效率和转化率

title: Trade Secret Law in the United States: Evolution, Framework, and Federalization
affiliations: Vanderbilt University - Law School

detail.title: Trade Secret Law in the United States: Evolution, Framework, and Federalization

publicationDetails.journalName: Vanderbilt University Law School Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper traces the evolution of trade secret law in the United States from its origins in fragmented state common law to its current dual-track framework under the Uniform Trade Secrets Act (UTSA) and the federal Defend Trade Secrets Act (DTSA). It explains how the drive for predictability in a nationalized, information-driven economy led to codification of doctrines once rooted in tort, contract, and equity. The UTSA brought coherence by unifying definitions of “trade secret” and “misappropriation,” yet preserved flexibility through its state-based adoption model—creating what the paper terms a “uniformity paradox.” The DTSA further transformed the field by introducing a federal civil cause of action, aligning trade secrets with other federally recognized IP rights while deliberately avoiding preemption of state law. The analysis explores the continuing divergence among states in key areas such as the inevitable disclosure doctrine and employee mobility, illustrating how American federalism sustains diversity within a largely harmonized system. The paper concludes that U.S. trade secret law today is unified but not uniform: a pragmatic equilibrium between consistency and experimentation that reflects enduring policy tensions between innovation, competition, and labor freedom in the knowledge economy.

AI.tldr: 本文追溯了美国商业秘密法从分散的州普通法演变为当前在《统一商业秘密法》(UTSA)和《保护商业秘密法》(DTSA)下的双轨制框架的过程，分析了统一性与多样性之间的平衡机制。
AI.research_question: 美国商业秘密法如何从分散的州普通法演变为当前的双轨制框架，以及这种演变如何平衡统一性与多样性？
AI.motivation: 在信息化、全国化的经济中，对可预测性的需求推动了曾经根植于侵权法、合同法和衡平法的学说的法典化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 联邦主义理论、统一性悖论、知识产权保护与劳动力流动的平衡
AI.method: 历史分析和法律文本分析，追溯法律演变过程
AI.findings: 美国商业秘密法实现了统一但非一致的状态：UTSA通过统一定义带来一致性但保留州级灵活性，DTSA引入联邦民事诉讼但避免取代州法，形成了实用主义的平衡。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"统一性悖论"概念，揭示了联邦制如何在基本统一系统中维持多样性，为理解美国知识产权法律体系提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了在创新保护、竞争促进和劳动力自由流动之间实现平衡的法律框架设计参考，有助于理解不同司法管辖区在关键问题上的持续分歧。

title: The Trust Stack: How We Rebuild Credibility Online
affiliations: Vanderbilt University - Law School

detail.title: The Trust Stack: How We Rebuild Credibility Online

publicationDetails.journalName: Vanderbilt University Law School Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: The internet was never designed with a native layer of trust. As deepfakes, AI-generated misinformation, and engagement-driven algorithms flood the information ecosystem, traditional cues of authenticity have collapsed. This paper argues that rebuilding credibility online requires a systemic response—a “trust stack” that reintroduces verifiable provenance and semantic assessment into digital infrastructure. Drawing on behavioral science and design principles, it outlines how machine-readable trust indicators, modeled on security standards like HTTPS, could allow users to assess authenticity at a glance. The first layer would certify provenance through cryptographic metadata, as in emerging initiatives like the Coalition for Content Provenance and Authenticity (C2PA). A second, semantic layer would use AI and knowledge graphs to evaluate factual consistency and sourcing, translating complex verification into intuitive user signals. The paper compares this approach to labeling systems such as Nutri-Score and Creative Commons, identifying both their behavioral power and their vulnerability to industry capture. It concludes that trust must become an opt-out default of the digital ecosystem, driven by open standards, independent governance, and interoperable “trust-as-a-service” tools. The internet’s integrity, it suggests, depends not on censorship but on transparency engineered into its very code.

AI.tldr: 本文提出构建"信任栈"系统，通过可验证来源和语义评估重建在线可信度，包括加密元数据认证来源和AI评估事实一致性的双层架构，主张信任应成为数字生态的默认设置。
AI.research_question: 如何系统性地重建在线信息的可信度？
AI.motivation: 深度伪造、AI生成虚假信息和参与度驱动算法破坏了传统真实性线索，导致在线可信度崩溃
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为科学和设计原则，借鉴HTTPS等安全标准模型
AI.method: 提出双层"信任栈"架构：第一层通过加密元数据认证内容来源，第二层使用AI和知识图谱评估事实一致性和来源
AI.findings: 基于开放标准、独立治理和互操作"信任即服务"工具的信任栈可有效重建在线可信度
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了系统性的"信任栈"理论框架，将信任工程化为数字基础设施的核心组成部分
AI.practical_contributions: 为开发机器可读信任指标、内容来源认证标准和语义评估工具提供了实用指导

detail.title: Optimizing Retirement Financial Strategies: Integrating Annuities, Defined Contribution Plans, and Long-Term Care Costs

All rights reserved.

publicationDetails.detailsText: Wharton Pension Research Council Working Paper No. 18
publicationDetails.journalName: Wharton Pension Research Council / Boettner Center Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: Nursing home costs in the United States now exceed $100,000 per year, and government assistance programs such as Medicaid help out only when retirees are largely destitute. Moreover, health shocks driving the need for such care can arise suddenly in old age, are frequently permanent in nature, and can be associated with declining mental and physical abilities. These facts raise the important question of how households can best prepare to finance this final phase of life. Building on past research, we determine how retirees should manage payouts from defined contribution plans to balance trade-offs between consumption and health care cost shocks, using both retirement plan assets and annuitization. Our analysis explicitly integrates the role of taxes, required minimum distributions, bequest motives, and the possibility of retiree insolvency. We conclude that payout annuities, especially deferred and variable annuities, can be quite valuable for retirees, even when they face health shocks in later life.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了美国退休人员如何通过确定缴费计划的最佳支付策略来平衡消费与医疗成本冲击，特别强调年金（尤其是递延和可变年金）在应对晚年健康冲击中的价值。
AI.research_question: 退休人员应如何管理确定缴费计划的支付，以平衡消费与医疗成本冲击之间的权衡？
AI.motivation: 美国养老院费用已超过每年10万美元，政府援助计划仅在退休人员几乎破产时提供帮助，而健康冲击可能突然发生且具有永久性，这引发了如何最好地为这一生命最后阶段融资的重要问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于过去研究的退休金融理论，整合税收、最低分配要求、遗产动机和退休人员破产可能性等因素。
AI.method: 分析确定缴费计划的支付策略，包括退休计划资产和年金化，考虑消费与医疗成本冲击的权衡。
AI.findings: 支付年金，特别是递延和可变年金，对退休人员非常有价值，即使他们在晚年面临健康冲击。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了退休金融理论，提供了在健康冲击背景下平衡消费与医疗成本的管理框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为退休人员提供了具体的金融规划建议，强调年金在应对高额医疗费用中的重要性，有助于改善退休生活的财务安全。

title: Sugar supplementation affects ant-mealybug mutualism and promote natural enemies for mealybug control in pineapple systems
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Sugar supplementation affects ant-mealybug mutualism and promote natural enemies for mealybug control in pineapple systems
detail.abstract: Honeydew-producing hemipterans establish mutualistic interactions with ants, which collect honeydew while providing protection against natural enemies and other services. Although this association benefits hemipterans, it often exacerbates crop damage by increasing pest abundance. Providing alternative sugar resources has been proposed as a strategy to disrupt these associations, but its effectiveness remains poorly tested in tropical agrosystems. Here, we investigated whether sugar feeders could reduce ant-mealybug interactions in pineapple (Ananas comosus) fields on La Réunion, where the mealybug Dysmicoccus brevipes, a vector of Pineapple Mealybug Wilt-associated viruses (PMWaVs), poses a major threat to production. We deployed sugar feeders in replicated field plots and monitored ant, mealybug and predator abundances over ten months, complemented by sentinel prey assays to assess ant aggressiveness toward mealybugs. Mealybug abundance was positively associated with ant presence, while sugar supplementation reduced ant abundance by 42% on pineapple plants compared to controls. Predator abundance was higher in supplemented zones, likely due to both direct nutritional benefits and lower ant interference, but declined with distance from feeders. Three ant species, Solenopsis geminata, Pheidole megacephala and Brachymyrmex cordemoyi accounted for most interactions with mealybugs, with species-specific temporal dynamics but no response to sugar supplementation. Sugar supplementation represents a promising management lever, but its effect on mealybug remains context-dependent. Integrating sugar provisioning with complementary agroecological practices, such as biological control and habitat diversification, may maximize its impact and contribute to sustainable management of pineapple mealybug wilt disease.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过在菠萝田间部署糖源供给器，成功减少了蚂蚁与粉蚧的互利共生关系，降低了42%的蚂蚁数量，增加了捕食者数量，但粉蚧数量变化具有情境依赖性。
AI.research_question: 糖源供给能否有效减少热带农业系统中蚂蚁与粉蚧的互利共生关系？
AI.motivation: 蚂蚁与粉蚧的互利共生关系会加剧作物损害，特别是在菠萝生产中，粉蚧是菠萝粉蚧萎蔫相关病毒的主要传播媒介，对生产构成严重威胁。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于蚂蚁-粉蚧互利共生关系的生态学理论，以及通过提供替代糖源来干扰这种关系的管理策略。
AI.method: 在留尼汪岛的菠萝田间设置重复实验小区，部署糖源供给器，持续10个月监测蚂蚁、粉蚧和捕食者数量，并通过哨兵猎物试验评估蚂蚁对粉蚧的攻击性。
AI.findings: 糖源供给使菠萝植株上的蚂蚁数量减少42%；捕食者数量在糖源供给区域更高；三种主要蚂蚁物种（Solenopsis geminata、Pheidole megacephala、Brachymyrmex cordemoyi）与粉蚧的相互作用具有物种特异性时间动态，但对糖源供给无响应。
AI.theory_contributions: 证实了在热带农业系统中通过提供替代糖源可以干扰蚂蚁-粉蚧互利共生关系的有效性，深化了对这种生态管理策略作用机制的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 糖源供给是一种有前景的管理杠杆，建议与生物防治和生境多样化等农业生态实践相结合，以实现菠萝粉蚧萎蔫病的可持续管理。

title: Optional Fee-Shifting
affiliations: University of Minnesota - Minneapolis, University of Bern - Institute of Economics and University of St.Gallen

detail.title: Optional Fee-Shifting

publicationDetails.journalName: University of Minnesota Law School Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We study settlement bargaining under three alternative fee-shifting rules: the American Rule, the English Rule, and an optional fee shifting regime in which the defendant chooses whether the case will proceed under the American or the English Rule. The defendant knows whether his conduct gives rise to liability while the plaintiff only has a noisy signal. This two-sided asymmetric information creates scope for strategic misrepresentation: defendants who face liability may try to pass as if they do not, while plaintiffs with weak evidence may act as if they have a strong case. Optional fee-shifting has an information-generating function which, however, can be distorted by strategic efforts to send misleading signals. When litigation costs are similar for both parties, optional fee-shifting reduces litigation rates more effectively than either the American or the English Rule alone.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了三种费用转移规则下的和解谈判：美国规则、英国规则以及可选择费用转移制度。在双方信息不对称的情况下，可选择费用转移制度通过信息生成功能有效降低了诉讼率，优于单独使用美国或英国规则。
AI.research_question: 在双方信息不对称的背景下，可选择费用转移制度如何影响和解谈判和诉讼率？
AI.motivation: 理解不同费用转移规则在信息不对称环境下的效果，特别是可选择费用转移制度在降低诉讼率方面的潜力。

AI.method: 理论模型分析，比较三种费用转移规则下的均衡结果

AI.theory_contributions: 发展了可选择费用转移制度的信息生成理论，揭示了其在信息不对称环境下的独特作用机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于费用转移规则设计的实证依据，有助于优化司法效率

title: Seeking Advice from Doctor's Doctor? The Impact of Physician Peer Recognition on Patient Choice
affiliations: Harbin Institute of Technology and Texas Tech University - Area of Information Systems and Quantitative Sciences (ISQS)

detail.title: Seeking Advice from Doctor's Doctor? The Impact of Physician Peer Recognition on Patient Choice

declarations.ethicsApproval: All our data was collected from a large online healthcare webite that provides API for public use. All the data is publicly available for access and collection. In the data, there is no identifiable personal information or other personal information of patients or physicians. We did not do any survey or experiments, so there were no individual participants in our study.

detail.abstract: On online healthcare platforms (OHPs), a critical operational challenge pertains to helping patients find suitable physicians amid significant information asymmetries between the two parties. While patient-generated reviews are common, their utility is often limited due to patients' lack of medical knowledge and expertise. To address this issue, some OHPs have introduced physician peer recognition, where peer physicians provide expert endorsements for focal (recognized) physicians to guide patient choices. However, it is not clear whether and how physicians' peer recognition may affect patients' selection of physicians and participation in physicians' online consultations. We fill this gap by empirically examining the effect of physicians' peer recognition on focal physicians' consultation volume, along with its underlying mechanisms and boundary conditions. Using a large-scale dataset from a leading OHP, we find that physicians' peer recognition significantly increases patients' participation in focal physicians' online consultations. Our mechanism analysis suggests that this effect is driven by specific characteristics of the recognition content, particularly its types (e.g., ability-based and attitude-based recognition) and language attributes (e.g., certainty, length, and positive sentiment). However, the positive impact of physicians' peer recognition is weakened when the recognition is reciprocal, as it may raise patients' skepticism about the objectivity of the recognition. Furthermore, we find that physicians' peer recognition and patient evaluations act as complements, synergistically exerting a positive influence on patient consultation decisions. Our study contributes to the literature on operations management on OHPs, peer recognition, and patient consultation decision-making, offering practical implications for the service operations of OHPs.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨在线医疗平台上医生同行认可对患者咨询量的影响，发现同行认可能显著增加患者咨询量，这种效应受到认可内容类型、语言特征的影响，但互惠性认可会削弱其正面作用。同行认可与患者评价具有互补效应。
AI.research_question: 医生同行认可是否以及如何影响患者对医生的选择和在线咨询参与度？
AI.motivation: 在线医疗平台存在严重的信息不对称问题，患者生成的评价因缺乏医学专业知识而效用有限，需要探索同行认可机制的有效性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息不对称理论、同行认可理论、患者决策理论
AI.method: 使用领先在线医疗平台的大规模数据集进行实证分析
AI.findings: 1) 医生同行认可显著增加患者咨询量；2) 效应受认可内容类型（能力型vs态度型）和语言特征（确定性、长度、积极情感）驱动；3) 互惠性认可削弱正面影响；4) 同行认可与患者评价具有互补效应
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了在线医疗平台运营管理、同行认可和患者咨询决策相关文献
AI.practical_contributions: 为在线医疗平台的服务运营提供实践启示，帮助优化同行认可机制设计

title: Applying HRNS and Fuzzy MCDM to Map Risks in Rope Access Work
affiliations: Istanbul Yeni Yüzyıl University and Istanbul Yeni Yüzyıl University

detail.title: Applying HRNS and Fuzzy MCDM to Map Risks in Rope Access Work
detail.abstract: Industrial rope access is a work-at-height technique designed to safely reach and operate in elevated areas using ropes and associated equipment. Although regarded as a reliable system, this profession inherently involves significant risks. This study aims to conduct a detailed analysis of these risks and to identify the most effective protective measures. The HRNS method was employed for risk assessment, and the resulting data were statistically analyzed using IBM SPSS. Furthermore, based on expert evaluations, the Fuzzy CRITIC method was applied for criterion weighting, while the Fuzzy TOPSIS method was utilized to determine the most appropriate control measures. The HRNS analysis identified “Employer Responsibilities” and “Environmental Risk Factors” as the most hazardous categories. In contrast, the multi-criteria decision-making (MCDM) methods, offering more precise analytical capabilities, determined that “Environmental Risk Factors” represented the highest level of danger. Additionally, the findings indicated that addressing training deficiencies is the most effective strategy for reducing risks. In conclusion, considering weather conditions in work planning, ensuring personnel certification, providing regular in-house training and drills, addressing educational deficiencies, fulfilling employer obligations, and establishing an Emergency Action Plan (EAP) to support the psychosocial well-being of workers are essential measures for minimizing unacceptable risks in rope access operations.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用HRNS方法和模糊多准则决策方法分析工业绳索作业风险，发现环境风险因素是最危险类别，培训不足是最有效的风险降低策略。
AI.research_question: 工业绳索作业中存在哪些主要风险？最有效的防护措施是什么？

AI.method: 采用HRNS方法进行风险评估，IBM SPSS进行统计分析，基于专家评估应用模糊CRITIC方法进行准则加权，使用模糊TOPSIS方法确定最合适的控制措施
AI.findings: HRNS分析识别'雇主责任'和'环境风险因素'为最危险类别；MCDM方法更精确地确定'环境风险因素'危险程度最高；解决培训不足是最有效的风险降低策略
AI.theory_contributions: 将HRNS方法与模糊多准则决策方法结合应用于工业绳索作业风险评估，提供了更精确的风险分析方法
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了具体风险控制措施：考虑天气条件、确保人员认证、提供定期内部培训和演练、解决教育不足、履行雇主义务、建立紧急行动计划以支持工人心理健康

title: A Credit Risk-Based Clustering Approach for Banks in Malta
affiliations: Central Bank of Malta and Central Bank of Malta

detail.title: A Credit Risk-Based Clustering Approach for Banks in Malta

publicationDetails.detailsText: Central Bank of Malta Research Paper Series No. 07/2025
publicationDetails.journalName: Central Bank of Malta Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
In this paper we construct a bipartite network model for the Maltese banking sector and identify communities of banks based on overlapping credit exposures. By leveraging confidential supervisory bank-level data on total exposures, we identify four distinct bank clusters and compute relevant network metrics. This approach enables the assessment of exposure concentration, network nestedness, and the centrality of individual institutions within the system. Finally, we use this information to identify banks’ business models based on their credit risk profiles. In particular, we distinguish between generalist and specialist banks, based on their position within identified communities and the geographical composition of their exposures. This analysis complements the existing classification framework employed by the Central Bank of Malta from a credit risk perspective, and lays the groundwork for future research on the transmission of credit risk shocks within the
banking system.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了马耳他银行部门的二分网络模型，基于重叠信贷风险敞口识别银行群落，计算网络指标，评估风险集中度、网络嵌套性和机构中心性，并识别银行的业务模式（通用型vs专业型银行）。
AI.research_question: 如何基于信贷风险敞口网络识别马耳他银行部门的群落结构和业务模式？
AI.motivation: 从信贷风险角度补充马耳他中央银行现有的分类框架，为研究信贷风险冲击在银行系统中的传导奠定基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 二分网络模型、网络嵌套性理论、中心性理论、群落检测理论
AI.method: 利用监管层面的银行总敞口机密数据构建二分网络模型，识别银行群落，计算网络指标。
AI.findings: 识别出四个不同的银行集群，能够区分通用型和专业型银行，评估了风险集中度和网络嵌套性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于信贷风险敞口网络的银行群落识别方法，发展了银行业务模式的网络分类框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构提供了从信贷风险角度识别银行业务模式的新方法，有助于风险管理和监管政策制定。

title: Supply chain financial constraints and US manufacturers’ resilience: longitudinal analysis of disruption
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and University of Sussex Business School

detail.title: Supply chain financial constraints and US manufacturers’ resilience: longitudinal analysis of disruption
detail.abstract: This study examines how U.S. manufacturers use trade credit as a financial tool to enhance inventory resilience during major supply chain disruptions. Using 35,785 firm-level observations from 1980 to 2024, we analyse the relationship between trade credit, inventory turnover, and financial constraints around disruptions. Our findings show that manufacturers’ reliance on trade credit for inventory building remained limited until the COVID-19 pandemic, which marked a turning point in supply chain finance practices. We develop a conceptual framework grounded in working capital management and contingency theory, positioning financial constraints as a moderator in the trade credit–inventory relationship. Results indicate that while trade credit availability enables firms to maintain higher inventory resilience during disruptions, financial constraints reduce this capacity. The study advances supply chain finance research by linking trade credit to inventory resilience, highlighting their strategic roles in inventory management under uncertainty, and providing insights for firms navigating future disruptions.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨美国制造商如何在重大供应链中断期间使用贸易信贷作为金融工具来增强库存弹性。研究发现，在COVID-19大流行之前，制造商依赖贸易信贷建立库存的能力有限，但疫情成为供应链金融实践的转折点。
AI.research_question: 美国制造商如何利用贸易信贷作为金融工具来增强供应链中断期间的库存弹性？
AI.motivation: 理解在重大供应链中断期间，贸易信贷如何帮助制造商维持库存弹性，特别是在COVID-19大流行这样的转折点之后。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于营运资本管理和权变理论的概念框架，将财务约束定位为贸易信贷-库存关系中的调节变量。
AI.method: 使用1980-2024年35,785个企业层面的观察数据，分析贸易信贷、库存周转率和财务约束在供应链中断期间的关系。
AI.findings: 贸易信贷的可获得性使企业能够在中断期间保持更高的库存弹性，但财务约束会降低这种能力；COVID-19大流行标志着供应链金融实践的转折点。
AI.theory_contributions: 通过将贸易信贷与库存弹性联系起来，推进了供应链金融研究，强调了它们在不确定性下库存管理中的战略作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业应对未来供应链中断提供了见解，帮助企业在财务约束条件下优化贸易信贷使用以增强库存弹性。

title: Understanding Political Economy: The Global Challenges, from Media – to Immigration

detail.title: Understanding Political Economy: The Global Challenges, from Media – to Immigration
detail.abstract: This paper offers a comprehensive exploration of political economy as a multidisciplinary field that investigates the reciprocal relationship between economic systems and political structures. Drawing from economics, political science, sociology, and history, it highlights how political institutions and decisions shape economic outcomes-and vice versa-across national and global contexts. The study distinguishes political economy from conventional economics by emphasizing issues of power, equity, and governance, rather than market efficiency alone. Through critical analysis of media influence, social media dynamics, and immigration policy, the paper demonstrates how political economy provides essential insights into contemporary global challenges. By revisiting classical foundations and integrating modern case studies, it argues for the continued relevance of political economy in understanding systemic patterns and shaping informed policy responses in an increasingly interconnected world.

AI.tldr: 本文全面探讨政治经济学这一多学科领域，研究经济体系与政治结构之间的相互关系。强调政治制度如何影响经济结果，以及经济因素如何反作用于政治决策，区别于传统经济学对市场效率的单一关注。
AI.research_question: 政治经济学如何解释经济体系与政治结构之间的相互关系及其对当代全球挑战的影响？
AI.motivation: 传统经济学过度关注市场效率而忽视权力、公平和治理问题，需要多学科视角来理解经济与政治的复杂互动关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 融合经济学、政治学、社会学和历史学的多学科理论框架，强调权力、公平和治理在政治经济分析中的核心地位。
AI.method: 通过批判性分析媒体影响、社交媒体动态和移民政策等现代案例研究，结合古典理论基础进行综合研究。
AI.findings: 政治经济学为理解当代全球挑战提供重要见解，揭示了经济与政治相互作用的系统性模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 重新确立政治经济学在多学科交叉研究中的理论地位，强调权力和治理因素在经济分析中的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供基于政治经济学视角的决策框架，帮助理解并应对全球化背景下的复杂挑战。

title: Dynamics of State - Level Economic Growth in India: Using Panel and GMM Model with Sectoral Decomposition
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Dynamics of State - Level Economic Growth in India: Using Panel and GMM Model with Sectoral Decomposition
detail.abstract: This study explores the dynamic determinants of economic growth across Indian states by examining the impact of infrastructure, fiscal policy, and sectoral composition on Per Capita Gross State Domestic Product (GSDP). The analysis focuses on understanding how past economic performance, public expenditure, and energy demand interact to influence current economic outcomes. Methodology: Using an unbalanced panel of 27 Indian states over two decades, the study employs both Fixed Effects (FE) and Dynamic Panel Generalized Method of Moments (GMM) estimators. Principal Component Analysis (PCA) is applied to reduce dimensionality and multicollinearity in sectoral variables (Manufacturing, Agriculture, Construction, and Industry), resulting in a composite index (Sector_PC1). The GMM model incorporates lagged Per Capita GSDP to account for persistence and potential endogeneity, with robust diagnostics including the Sargan test and Arellano-Bond autocorrelation tests. Findings: Findings from the dynamic GMM model reveal that lagged Per Capita GSDP is a highly significant predictor, confirming the importance of growth momentum. Capital Expenditure and Sector_PC1 exhibit consistently positive and significant effects, underscoring the role of strategic public investment and sectoral performance in driving economic growth. Notably, Power Requirement shows a significant negative impact in the GMM model, suggesting that inefficiencies or structural challenges in energy usage may constrain development. Tax Revenue, while significant in the static FE model, becomes insignificant in the dynamic framework, indicating its influence may be indirect or delayed. The study concludes that dynamic modelling better captures the economic realities of Indian states, with implications for policy aimed at sustaining growth, optimizing capital investment, and enhancing energy efficiency. Policymakers should prioritize infrastructure and sectoral development while addressing structural inefficiencies in energy usage to foster long-term, inclusive economic growth.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过固定效应和动态面板GMM模型分析印度各邦经济增长的决定因素，发现滞后人均GSDP、资本支出和部门综合指数对经济增长有显著正向影响，而电力需求呈负向影响，税收收入在动态模型中不显著。
AI.research_question: 印度各邦经济增长的动态决定因素是什么？基础设施、财政政策和部门构成如何影响人均邦内生产总值？
AI.motivation: 理解过去经济表现、公共支出和能源需求如何相互作用影响当前经济结果，为印度各邦制定可持续增长政策提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经济增长理论、动态面板数据模型、内生增长理论
AI.method: 使用27个印度邦20年不平衡面板数据，采用固定效应模型和动态面板GMM估计方法，运用主成分分析处理部门变量多重共线性问题。
AI.findings: 滞后人均GSDP是显著预测因子；资本支出和部门综合指数对经济增长有持续正向影响；电力需求在GMM模型中呈显著负向影响；税收收入在动态模型中不显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了动态建模在捕捉印度各邦经济现实方面的优越性，强调了增长动量的重要性，为发展中国家区域经济增长研究提供方法论参考。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供实证依据，建议优先发展基础设施和部门建设，优化资本投资，解决能源使用中的结构效率问题，以促进长期包容性经济增长。

title: An Adaptive Multi-Agent Bitcoin Trading System

detail.title: An Adaptive Multi-Agent Bitcoin Trading System
detail.abstract: This paper presents a Multi Agent Bitcoin Trading system that utilizes Large Language Models (LLMs) for alpha generation and portfolio management in the cryptocurrencies market. Unlike equities, cryptocurrencies exhibit extreme volatility and are heavily influenced by rapidly shifting market sentiments and regulatory announcements, making them difficult to model using static regression models or neural networks trained solely on historical data [53]. The proposed framework overcomes this by structuring LLMs into specialised agents for technical analysis, sentiment evaluation, decision-making, and performance reflection. The system improves over time through a novel verbal feedback mechanism where a Reflect agent provides daily and weekly natural-language critiques of trading decisions. These textual evaluations are then injected into future prompts, allowing the system to adjust indicator priorities, sentiment weights, and allocation logic without parameter updates or finetuning. Back-testing on Bitcoin price data from July 2024 to April 2025 shows consistent outperformance across market regimes: the Quantitative agent delivered over 30% higher returns in bullish phases and 15% overall gains versus buy-and-hold, while the sentiment-driven agent turned sideways markets from a small loss into a gain of over 100%. Adding weekly feedback further improved total performance by 31% and reduced bearish losses by 10%. The results demonstrate that verbal feedback represents a new, scalable, and low-cost method of tuning LLMs for financial goals.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于大语言模型的多智能体比特币交易系统，通过专业分工的智能体进行技术分析、情绪评估、决策制定和绩效反思，并采用自然语言反馈机制持续优化交易策略，在比特币市场测试中显著超越买入持有策略。
AI.research_question: 如何利用大语言模型构建能够适应加密货币极端波动性和快速变化市场情绪的多智能体交易系统？
AI.motivation: 加密货币市场具有极端波动性，且受市场情绪和监管公告影响显著，传统的静态回归模型或仅基于历史数据训练的神经网络难以有效建模。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多智能体系统理论、大语言模型在金融领域的应用、自然语言反馈机制、技术分析与情绪分析结合的交易策略。
AI.method: 构建包含技术分析、情绪评估、决策制定和绩效反思四个专业智能体的多智能体系统，通过自然语言反馈机制持续优化交易决策。
AI.findings: 在2024年7月至2025年4月的比特币数据回测中，量化智能体在牛市阶段收益超过买入持有策略30%，整体收益高15%；情绪驱动智能体在横盘市场中将小幅亏损转为超过100%的收益；周度反馈机制使总绩效提升31%，熊市损失减少10%。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于自然语言反馈的LLM调优新方法，为金融领域LLM应用提供了可扩展、低成本的优化途径。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了能够适应加密货币市场特性的多智能体交易系统，为投资者提供了有效的量化交易工具，特别是在不同市场环境下均能获得超额收益。

title: Fully Online Matching with General Stochastic Arrivals and Departures
affiliations: ,  and Nanyang Technological University

detail.title: Fully Online Matching with General Stochastic Arrivals and Departures
detail.abstract:
We study a fully online matching problem with general stochastic arrivals and departures. In this model, each online arrival follows a known identical and independent distribution over a fixed set of agent types. Its sojourn time is unknown in advance and follows type-specific distributions with known expectations. The goal is to maximize the weighted reward from successful matches. To solve this problem, we propose a linear program (LP)-based algorithm whose competitive ratio is lower bounded by 0.192 under mild conditions. To demonstrate the challenges of the problem, we further establish several hardness results. In particular, we show that no online algorithm can achieve a competitive ratio better than 1/2 in this model, and if using our LP as a benchmark for competitive ratio analysis, no algorithm can achieve a better ratio than 1/3.
When no assumptions are made regarding the sojourn time distributions, we demonstrate that it is impossible to achieve a positive competitive ratio for the general case using our LP as a benchmark for competitive ratio analysis.
We further extend our model to accommodate general sojourn times under Poisson arrivals and demonstrate a better competitive ratio compared to state-of-the-art results derived under Poisson arrivals and departures, a special case of our general settings.
Finally, we demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of our algorithm numerically.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了具有一般随机到达和离开的完全在线匹配问题，提出了基于线性规划的算法，在温和条件下竞争比下界为0.192，并建立了多个困难性结果，证明最优竞争比不超过1/2。
AI.research_question: 如何设计有效的在线算法来解决具有一般随机到达和离开的匹配问题，以最大化加权匹配收益？
AI.motivation: 现实世界中的许多匹配问题（如拼车、在线广告等）都涉及随机到达和未知停留时间的代理，现有研究通常对停留时间分布做出强假设，需要更一般的模型。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于线性规划的在线匹配理论，竞争比分析框架，随机过程理论
AI.method: 提出基于线性规划（LP）的在线算法，使用理论分析和数值实验验证算法性能
AI.findings: 1）LP-based算法在温和条件下竞争比下界为0.192；2）证明最优竞争比不超过1/2；3）无停留时间分布假设时无法获得正竞争比；4）在泊松到达下获得优于现有结果的竞争比
AI.theory_contributions: 1）建立了具有一般随机到达和离开的在线匹配问题的理论框架；2）提供了算法竞争比的严格下界；3）建立了问题的困难性上界；4）扩展了泊松到达下的理论结果
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为实际匹配系统提供了有效的在线算法；2）算法在数值实验中表现出良好的效果和效率；3）为拼车、在线广告等应用提供了理论指导

title: Biodiversity Risk Exposure and Analysts' Forecasts
affiliations: The University of Western Australia - UWA Business School, The University of Western Australia - UWA Business School and The University of Western Australia

detail.title: Biodiversity Risk Exposure and Analysts' Forecasts
detail.abstract: We document that, at the firm-level, higher biodiversity risk exposure is associated with significantly lower earnings forecast accuracy and greater forecast dispersion among financial analysts. These effects are more pronounced for firms with higher earnings volatility or more opaque disclosure environments. Further tests reveal that analysts' experience, industry, and biodiversity risk expertise mitigate these effects. Additionally, stakeholder biodiversity awareness alleviates the impact of biodiversity risk on analysts' forecasts' accuracy and dispersion. Our findings highlight the effects of biodiversity risk on capital markets through analysts' information processing and forecasts.

AI.tldr: 企业层面的生物多样性风险暴露与分析师盈利预测准确性显著负相关，与预测分散度正相关。这种影响在盈利波动性较高或信息披露环境不透明的企业中更为明显。分析师经验、行业专长和生物多样性风险专业知识能够缓解这种影响，利益相关者的生物多样性意识也有缓解作用。
AI.research_question: 生物多样性风险如何影响金融分析师对企业盈利预测的准确性和分散度？
AI.motivation: 生物多样性风险作为新兴的环境风险因素，其对资本市场信息环境的影响尚未得到充分研究，特别是对金融分析师预测行为的影响机制需要深入探讨。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信息不对称理论和分析师预测行为理论，探讨生物多样性风险如何通过影响企业信息环境来干扰分析师的信息处理过程。
AI.method: 实证研究方法，使用企业层面的生物多样性风险暴露数据和分析师预测数据，通过回归分析检验相关假设。
AI.findings: 生物多样性风险暴露与分析师盈利预测准确性显著负相关，与预测分散度正相关；这种影响在盈利波动性高、信息披露不透明的企业中更明显；分析师经验和专业知识以及利益相关者意识能够缓解这种负面影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了环境风险对资本市场信息环境影响的理论框架，首次系统探讨生物多样性风险对分析师预测行为的影响机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者、监管机构和企业在评估和管理生物多样性风险方面提供实践指导，强调了分析师专业能力和利益相关者意识在缓解生物多样性风险影响中的重要性。

title: An Evaluation of Global Experiments with the Four-Day Work Week and Their HR Outcomes

detail.title: An Evaluation of Global Experiments with the Four-Day Work Week and Their HR Outcomes
detail.abstract: The Four-Day Work Week (4DWW) has gained momentum globally as organizations and policymakers seek out options to the conventional work structures. This paper synthesizes evidence from trials across different countries on a global scale as well as company-led pilots in a bid to evaluate the outcomes for human resource (HR) policy and practice. Findings signify consistent benefits in employee well-being, work-life balance and talent attraction, with varied outcomes on productivity subject to industry, sector and organizational preparedness. Concerns relating to workload consolidation, client service management and cultural alignment, however, persist. The paper examines the effects on well-being, talent management, performance, equity and employment relations from the HR perspective. A synthesis framework outlines corresponding variations and highlights inconsistencies, especially with Global South research. The review established that the 4DWW is not an exhaustive model but it presents remarkable prospects for HR leaders to align productivity, flexibility and people-centric policies.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了全球范围内四天工作制的试验证据，发现其在员工福祉、工作生活平衡和人才吸引方面有持续益处，但生产力效果因行业和组织准备程度而异。研究从HR视角探讨了福祉、人才管理、绩效、公平和雇佣关系的影响。
AI.research_question: 四天工作制对人力资源政策和实践的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 随着全球组织和政策制定者寻求传统工作结构的替代方案，四天工作制在全球范围内获得发展动力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人力资源政策框架，包括员工福祉、人才管理、绩效管理和雇佣关系理论。
AI.method: 文献综述和证据合成方法，分析全球不同国家的试验和公司主导的试点项目。
AI.findings: 四天工作制在员工福祉、工作生活平衡和人才吸引方面带来持续益处；生产力效果因行业、部门和组织准备程度而异；存在工作量整合、客户服务管理和文化适应方面的担忧。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个综合框架，概述了相应的变化并强调了不一致性，特别是在全球南方研究方面。
AI.practical_contributions: 为HR领导者提供了将生产力、灵活性和以人为本政策相结合的显著前景，但四天工作制并非适用于所有情况的通用模式。

title: From Slaves to Synths? Superintelligence and the Evolution of Legal Personality
affiliations: National University of Singapore (NUS) - Faculty of Law

detail.title: From Slaves to Synths? Superintelligence and the Evolution of Legal Personality
detail.abstract: This paper examines the evolving concept of legal personality through the lens of recent developments in artificial intelligence and the possible emergence of superintelligence. Legal systems have long been open to extending personhood to nonhuman entities, most prominently corporations, for instrumental or inherent reasons. Instrumental rationales emphasize accountability and administrative efficiency, whereas inherent ones appeal to moral worth and autonomy. Neither is yet sufficient to justify conferring personhood on AI. Nevertheless, the acceleration of technological autonomy may lead us to reconsider how law conceptualizes agency and responsibility. Drawing on comparative jurisprudence, corporate theory, and the emerging literature on AI governance, this chapter argues that existing frameworks can address short-term accountability gaps, but the eventual development of superintelligence may force a paradigmatic shift in our understanding of law itself. In such a speculative future, legal personality may depend less on the cognitive sophistication of machines than on humanity's ability to preserve our own moral and institutional sovereignty.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了人工智能发展对法律人格概念的影响，认为现有法律框架可以解决短期责任问题，但超级智能的出现可能需要对法律本身进行范式转变。
AI.research_question: 人工智能和超级智能的发展如何影响法律人格概念？

title: The Karelin Method And Rapid Decision-Making: A Framework For Sustainable High-Performance In Manufacturing Organizations
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: The Karelin Method And Rapid Decision-Making: A Framework For Sustainable High-Performance In Manufacturing Organizations
detail.abstract: This study presents an integrated framework combining focused intensity management (the Karelin Method) with rapid decision-making protocols to create sustainable competitive advantage in manufacturing organizations. Drawing on research from organizational behavior, cognitive psychology, and operations management, we demonstrate how the strategic combination of increased work hours, improved efficiency, and concentrated focus on high-impact activities can generate productivity improvements of 400-600%. We further examine how decision velocity serves as a force multiplier for these productivity gains. Multiple case studies document the application of these principles across manufacturing sectors, showing consistent patterns of transformational improvement with profit increases ranging from 150% to 400%. The framework addresses a critical gap in management literature: how to create and sustain high performance without organizational burnout. Our research contributes to operations management theory by integrating previously separate research streams on productivity optimization, decision velocity, and organizational sustainability into a unified framework with documented multiplicative effects.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一个结合专注强度管理（卡列林方法）与快速决策协议的综合框架，旨在为制造组织创造可持续竞争优势。研究表明，通过战略性地结合增加工作时间、提高效率以及专注于高影响力活动，可以实现400-600%的生产率提升，而决策速度则作为这些收益的倍增器。

detail.abstract: In threshold public good games, the presence of small amounts of coalitional behaviour can have large spillover effects on the behavior of individuals, who become more cooperative as a consequence. This phenomenon exhibits tipping point behavior, where a small increase in coalitional behavior leads to explosive growth in the level of public goods provision. The model uses a novel combination of procedural rationality and coalitional dynamics. It is robust to both low and high information environments, in both cases giving principled and rigorous derivations of coalitional dynamics for which individual dynamics in the literature are special cases.

detail.abstract:
This article examines how public international law might apply to cyber-based operations against critical

infrastructure, particularly by examining the Tallinn Manual 2.0, given the Manual's particular prominence in

Western legal circles. Taking a sector-by-sector approach, this article shows how international law as restated in

the Manual would permit a state actor to launch cyber operations against critical infrastructure in some circumstances,

opening vulnerable and sensitive assets to sophisticated attacks from foreign adversaries. Nevertheless, many types of

critical infrastructure are entitled to some manner of special legal protections under the law of armed conflict.

detail.abstract: In 1991 and 2008, Israel abolished the equivalents of 1¢ and 5¢ coins, respectively, effectively eliminating low-denomination coins and introducing rounding in cash transactions. When totals were rounded up, shoppers incurred a small rounding tax. Using detailed data on price endings and basket sizes across supermarkets, drugstores, small groceries, and convenience stores, we estimate that the magnitude of the rounding tax borne by Israeli consumers averaged only 0.001%–0.002% of revenues in the fast-moving consumer goods markets. These findings have implications for the ongoing debate regarding the desirability and viability of abolishing the 1¢ and 5¢ coins in the US.

detail.abstract: This paper introduces the concept of Patience Alpha-a theoretical framework aimed at understanding the excess return potentially generated by long-term investment behavior. The analysis distinguishes between deterministic and behavioral components, which improve realized returns through compounding, tax deferral, and bias avoidance, and a risk-based component, the Patience Risk Premium, which may represent a true priced factor in financial markets.

title: Mutualism on wheels: Using backhaul empty electric trucks to charge private electric cars on highway networks
affiliations: Southwest Jiaotong University, Southwest Jiaotong University, New York University (NYU) - New York University, Abu Dhabi, Southwest Jiaotong University, Southwest Jiaotong University and New York University (NYU) - New York University, Abu Dhabi

detail.title: Mutualism on wheels: Using backhaul empty electric trucks to charge private electric cars on highway networks
detail.abstract: The inadequate charging infrastructure for private electric cars (PECs) on intercity highways remains a critical barrier to large-scale electric vehicle adoption. This paper proposes a novel mutualistic system that employs backhaul empty electric trucks (BEETs) as temporary mobile chargers for PECs, thereby enabling BEETs to secure additional revenue. We develop an optimization framework for a multi-modal charging environment, where PECs can access charging via fixed charging stations, battery-to-battery stationary charging (B2BSC), or battery-to-battery in-motion charging (B2BIC). The proposed model, initially formulated as a mixed-integer nonlinear program (MINLP), is transformed into a computationally efficient mixed-integer linear program (MILP) model. A case study on the Chengdu-Chongqing (China) intercity highway network demonstrates the system's effectiveness. Results reveal a win-win outcome: PECs experience significant travel delay reductions, while BEETs obtain substantial additional revenue, ensuring their active participation. Sensitivity analyses further reveal the existence of an optimal pricing zone that balances BEET profitability with PEC participation, and highlight the impact of travelers' value of time on system performance. This study introduces an innovative and sustainable solution to alleviate range anxiety on intercity highways, offering valuable insights for transportation planners and service operators.

title: When ESG Demand Backfires: Greenwashing, Cost Convexity, and Policy Design
affiliations: Vietnamese German University

detail.title: When ESG Demand Backfires: Greenwashing, Cost Convexity, and Policy Design
detail.abstract: We develop a signaling model in which value-maximizing firms choose between genuine ESG action and superficial washing. A washing equilibrium arises when low-impact firms find it optimal to pool on a misleading signal rather than undertake costly improvement. Stronger investor demand for ESG can perversely expand the washing set and lower social welfare. The severity of this paradox hinges on the curvature of the genuine-action cost curve. The paradox is weakest for mildly convex costs, vanishes at the linear knife-edge, and is most severe for concave or hyper-convex costs. High verification probabilities are decidedly effective at mitigating the problem, whereas congestion-style washing penalties merely dampen it. The results point to a clear policy hierarchy that prioritizes strong transparency and incentives that keep the cost of genuine improvement within a feasible convex range.

detail.title: European Crisis -NATO vs non-NATO SME (Firm) Economic Benefits?

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Affiliation Bournemouth University as Advanced Senior Researcher
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract:
This research review explores 10,000 SMEs (firms) across 27 Eastern European economies, comparing NATO and non-NATO countries, using pre-crisis 2019 data from World Bank and EBRD (European Bank for Reconstruction and Development). It contributes to broader debates on “European NATO” or “European peacekeeping force.” It contributes towards a gap in scientific research knowledge with geopolitics that can aid decision-making and foreign geo-policy, providing exploratory initial measures of positive differences in means for Eastern Europe’s ‘NATO vs non-NATO.’

The research introduces the concept of “alliance power,” integrating it with the core themes of financial constraints, bribery incidence, and productivity. The exploratory findings suggest a potential positive “NATO effect” and a positive “NATO economic effect” on SMEs (small medium enterprise firms). Defence with security guarantees for business and trade seems imperative. SMEs in or close to conflict or war zones face disrupted flights, risk exposure to drones, damaged transport, and undercover deliveries or business operations are not trackable contributions to GDP economic measures. Furthermore, failures in defence with power and internet outage impair SMEs operations. All deters foreign investors ready to invest in a development growth zone with an attractive risky high return yield. A form of military Keynesianism is an economic policy based upon the premise that a government by increasing defence spending can increase economic growth and GDP. It is a stimulus policy according to John Maynard Keynes, who died just before World War II ended. To extrapolate, future implications are economies investing in (increasing) “alliance power” spending, like NATO, suggested as not only defence but a potential fiscal policy with positive economic benefits for the fastest growing SME firms.

“The security of one country is a foundation for stability, economic growth, and prosperous society. NATO's purpose is to guarantee the freedom and security of its members, with the statistical analyses providing evidence, therefore contributing to the attractiveness of a member country as a host for FDI, which would boost investment and capital stock growth dynamics and increased exports and potential output in the longer run, productivity growth, decreased unemployment as well as sustainable development (Elezi and Kurtishi, 2019).” In essence, this review is a call for future research that needs doing into the contentious speculative notion of not only a NATO effect but a beneficial positive NATO economic effect beyond pure defence function. Logically, the aspiration after attainment of peace stability comes relevant sustainability business transformation beyond finance economic destabilisation (Palley, Giammetti, and Meridionale 2024; Vidler, 2024) where SMEs in manufacturing (like precious minerals - Vakulchuk, 2020;2023) could support both an economy and critical defence. Can Eastern European NATO membership achieve both, is further NATO accession of new members (near the Russian borders) or an alternative peacekeeping force concept of most of the key European NATO players possible to benefit not only Eastern Europe, the Eastern Frontier but the whole of Europe?

AI.tldr: 本研究通过对27个东欧经济体的10,000家中小企业进行分析，发现北约成员国身份可能带来积极的"北约效应"和"北约经济效应"，通过安全保证促进中小企业发展和吸引外国投资。

AI.findings: 初步探索性发现表明存在潜在的积极"北约效应"和"北约经济效应"，安全保证对商业和贸易至关重要，冲突地区的企业面临运营中断风险。

title: Leniency Laws and Lucrative Trades: The Impact of Antitrust Policy on Insider Profits
affiliations: , University of Texas at Dallas - School of Management - Department of Finance & Managerial Economics and Independent

detail.title: Leniency Laws and Lucrative Trades: The Impact of Antitrust Policy on Insider Profits
detail.abstract: We study the impact of antitrust enforcement on insiders' trading profits. The notion is that trading profits and product market collusion are related because collusion enhances insiders' informational advantage. Using staggered crosscountry adoption of leniency laws, we show stronger enforcement curbs trading profits. Likewise, trading profits increase when enforcement decreases due to nearby DOJ office closures. Sensitivity of trading profits to antitrust enforcement varies with a firm's likely role in collusive arrangements, its monitoring effectiveness, degree of information asymmetry between insiders and outsiders, and the industry's propensity for collusion. We also document that stronger antitrust enforcement lowers the informativeness of insider trades.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现反垄断执法会降低内部人的交易利润，因为更强的执法削弱了产品市场合谋，从而减少了内部人的信息优势。
AI.research_question: 反垄断执法如何影响内部人的交易利润？
AI.motivation: 内部人交易利润与产品市场合谋相关，因为合谋增强了内部人的信息优势。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于内部人交易理论和反垄断经济学理论，探讨执法强度与内部人信息优势的关系。
AI.method: 使用交错跨国宽大政策采用和DOJ办公室关闭作为准自然实验，进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 更强的反垄断执法会降低内部人交易利润；执法强度对交易利润的影响因企业特征和行业特征而异；更强的执法降低了内部人交易的信息含量。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了反垄断执法与内部人交易利润的理论联系，揭示了执法通过影响合谋行为进而影响信息不对称的机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构提供了反垄断执法对资本市场影响的证据，有助于完善内部人交易监管政策。

title: Integrated Service Ecosystems: From Idea to Scaling
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Integrated Service Ecosystems: From Idea to Scaling
detail.abstract: This monograph systematizes practical methods for designing and scaling integrated service ecosystems that combine mutually reinforcing services (e.g., service station → car wash → auto parts; kids’ club → restaurant → retail). It formalizes market validation, legal/financial architecture (CAPEX/OPEX, break-even), SOP-driven operations, and digital strategy (CRM, online booking, IoT/analytics) into reproducible templates. Two production cases (DeLuxe Wash and Kids Club & MiniKidi) illustrate location logic, pricing, risk tables, cross-selling maps, loyalty programs, and franchise playbooks, with conservative payback horizons of ~1.5–2.0 years under baseline assumptions. The monograph closes with resilience (war/blackouts), ESG, and a US market entry checklist. Materials include tables/figures for CAPEX, risk mitigation, staffing, and KPIs to enable rapid replication and due-diligence-ready documentation.

AI.tldr: 该专著系统化地提供了设计和扩展集成服务生态系统的实用方法，包括市场验证、法律/财务架构、标准化运营流程和数字战略，并通过两个案例展示了具体实施细节和约1.5-2年的投资回收期。
AI.research_question: 如何系统化地设计和扩展集成服务生态系统？
AI.motivation: 为服务企业提供可复制的模板和方法论，帮助其构建相互强化的服务组合并实现规模化运营。
AI.theoretical_framework: 集成服务生态系统理论、标准化运营流程(SOP)、数字战略框架、财务分析模型。
AI.method: 案例研究方法，通过DeLuxe Wash和Kids Club & MiniKidi两个生产案例进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 集成服务生态系统可以通过系统化方法实现约1.5-2年的投资回收期，包含位置逻辑、定价策略、风险管理和交叉销售等关键要素。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统化地形式化了集成服务生态系统的设计框架和运营模式。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可复制的模板、风险缓解策略、KPI指标和尽职调查文档，支持企业快速复制和规模化运营。

title: The Wage Blind Spot: How the Absence of Compensation Data Traps Africa's Informal Economy
affiliations: CCHRC

detail.title: The Wage Blind Spot: How the Absence of Compensation Data Traps Africa's Informal Economy

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper. This study was conducted independently without any external or institutional bias.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is based exclusively on secondary data and publicly available policy documents. No human participants or confidential organisational data were involved; hence, formal ethics approval was not required. All data were handled responsibly and analysed in compliance with standard academic research ethics and data protection principles.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. It was self-funded by the author under the auspices of the Citadel Centre for Human Resources Research and Consulting.

detail.abstract: Despite decades of formalization initiatives across Sub-Saharan Africa, over 85% of employment remains informal (ILO, 2024). While existing research emphasizes regulatory burden and taxation as primary barriers, this paper identifies a critical blind spot: the near-total absence of reliable compensation data in African labour markets. Drawing on behavioural economics and information asymmetry theory, I argue that workers and small businesses cannot make informed decisions about formalization when they lack basic knowledge of formal sector wages and total rewards. This wage information vacuum creates uncertainty that reinforces informality, even when other barriers are reduced. Using secondary data from ILO, World Bank Enterprise Surveys, and national labour force statistics across 12 African countries, I demonstrate the scale of compensation data scarcity and present preliminary evidence of its correlation with persistent informality rates. I introduce a novel Wage Data Availability Index (WDAI) and show significant gaps compared to developed economies. The findings suggest that investments in compensation transparency and HR data infrastructure-including both public labour market information systems and private sector research initiatives-could substantially accelerate formalization. This represents an overlooked but potentially transformative intervention point for development organizations. I conclude by proposing a phased research agenda beginning with primary data collection in Nigeria, demonstrating why Africa-specific compensation research is not merely an HR tool but a critical development infrastructure need.

AI.tldr: 本文指出非洲劳动力市场中可靠的薪酬数据几乎完全缺失是阻碍就业正规化的关键盲点，即使其他障碍减少，这种信息不对称仍会强化非正规性。
AI.research_question: 薪酬数据缺失如何影响撒哈拉以南非洲地区的就业正规化进程？
AI.motivation: 尽管非洲进行了数十年的正规化倡议，但超过85%的就业仍是非正规的，现有研究主要关注监管负担和税收，而忽略了薪酬数据缺失这一关键因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为经济学和信息不对称理论
AI.method: 使用ILO、世界银行企业调查和12个非洲国家劳动力统计数据的二手数据分析
AI.findings: 薪酬数据严重稀缺，与持续的非正规就业率相关，引入的薪酬数据可用性指数显示与发达经济体存在显著差距
AI.theory_contributions: 识别了薪酬数据缺失作为正规化障碍的新机制，扩展了信息不对称理论在发展经济学中的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 建议投资薪酬透明度和HR数据基础设施，包括公共劳动力市场信息系统和私营部门研究计划，以加速正规化进程

title: Fashion to Landfill: The Hidden Cost of Textile Waste

detail.title: Fashion to Landfill: The Hidden Cost of Textile Waste
detail.abstract: With millions of tonnes of clothing discarded annually, the fashion business is one of the biggest contributors to global textile waste. The sources of textile waste, their effects on the environment, and the concealed expenses connected with fashion to landfill are all discussed in this article. The paper offers a more sustainable approach to textile trash management that may be applied worldwide by examining present disposal methods and looking into possible solutions including recycling models.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了时尚产业对全球纺织废物的巨大贡献，分析了纺织废物的来源、环境影响和隐藏成本，并提出了包括回收模型在内的可持续管理方案。

title: Managing Conflict in Air Traffic Communication: Insights from High-Stress Operational Contexts
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Managing Conflict in Air Traffic Communication: Insights from High-Stress Operational Contexts
detail.abstract: Effective communication between pilots and air traffic controllers (ATCs) is a cornerstone of aviation safety, yet it also represents a potential source of operational risk when conflict emerges under time pressure. This study investigates how communication conflict develops and resolves in high-stakes aviation contexts, focusing on pilot–ATC interactions during the COVID-19 pandemic. Using quantitative content analysis, 257 real-world communication episodes were coded from VASAviation transcripts. A deductive coding scheme based on Rahim’s conflict styles and Hample and Krueger’s tactical typology guided the analysis. Binary logistic regression showed that collaborating and accommodating styles predicted the use of integrative tactics, which in turn increased the likelihood of conflict resolution. In contrast, competing and avoiding styles were associated with distributive tactics, which reduced the probability of resolution. These findings highlight the critical role of constructive communication strategies in mitigating interpersonal conflict and maintaining operational safety under high workload and stress conditions. The study contributes to understanding human factors and communication resilience in aviation systems, offering implications for crew resource management (CRM), safety training, and error prevention frameworks.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过分析飞行员与空管在COVID-19疫情期间的真实通信记录，发现合作型和包容型冲突处理风格能促进整合性策略使用，从而提高冲突解决概率；而竞争型和回避型风格则与分配性策略相关，降低冲突解决可能性。
AI.research_question: 在高风险航空环境中，通信冲突如何发展和解决？飞行员与空管之间的冲突处理风格如何影响冲突解决结果？
AI.motivation: 飞行员与空管之间的有效沟通是航空安全的基石，但在时间压力下出现的沟通冲突可能带来操作风险，特别是在COVID-19疫情期间的高压环境下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Rahim的冲突处理风格理论（合作型、包容型、竞争型、回避型）以及Hample和Krueger的战术类型学（整合性战术vs分配性战术）
AI.method: 定量内容分析，对257个来自VASAviation转录的真实通信事件进行编码分析，采用基于理论的演绎编码方案，使用二元逻辑回归分析
AI.findings: 合作型和包容型冲突处理风格预测整合性战术的使用，进而提高冲突解决可能性；竞争型和回避型风格与分配性战术相关，降低冲突解决概率
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对高风险环境中人际冲突动态的理解，为航空系统中人为因素和通信韧性研究提供理论贡献
AI.practical_contributions: 为机组资源管理（CRM）、安全培训和错误预防框架提供实践启示，强调建设性沟通策略在高压工作环境中的重要性

title: AI-Driven Generative Design of Topology-Optimized Lattice Structures for Additive Manufacturing in China’s Precision Equipment Industry
affiliations: Tsinghua University

detail.title: AI-Driven Generative Design of Topology-Optimized Lattice Structures for Additive Manufacturing in China’s Precision Equipment Industry
detail.abstract: China’s accelerating shift toward high-value precision equipment demands ultralight, high-strength components that can be produced cost-effectively at scale. This paper presents a hybrid AI-driven generative design framework that couples deep reinforcement learning (DRL) with topology optimization to automatically synthesize lattice infill structures tailored for laser powder-bed fusion (LPBF). Using a curated dataset of 3,842 mechanical test coupons extracted from 21–25-year-old Chinese aerospace and medical implant repositories, we train a graph neural network (GNN) surrogate that predicts as-built stiffness and fatigue life from voxel-based mesostructured. The DRL agent explores a continuous 32-dimensional design space of beam diameters, node positions, and pore sizes while respecting LPBF process constraints such as a minimum 0.2 mm feature size and 45° self-support angle. Multi-objective reward functions minimize mass and maximize specific stiffness under stochastic loading spectra derived from in-service telemetry of 1,847 industrial robots across Guangdong and Jiangsu provinces. Compared to conventional solid-body topology optimization, the generated lattices reduced average part weight by 34% while increasing fatigue life by 28%, validated through 162 physical builds on EOS M290 and Huizhou HS-M280 machines. The open-source dataset and code are released to foster reproducible research in AI-CAD for additive manufacturing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合深度强化学习和拓扑优化的混合AI生成设计框架，用于自动生成适用于激光粉末床熔融的晶格填充结构，相比传统方法可减重34%并提高疲劳寿命28%。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个AI驱动的生成设计框架来自动合成适用于激光粉末床熔融工艺的轻量化高强度晶格结构？
AI.motivation: 中国加速向高价值精密设备转型，需要能够大规模经济生产的高强度超轻部件。
AI.theoretical_framework: 深度强化学习与拓扑优化相结合的混合生成设计框架，图神经网络作为替代模型预测力学性能。
AI.method: 使用3,842个机械测试样本训练GNN替代模型，DRL代理在32维设计空间中探索，考虑LPBF工艺约束，多目标奖励函数优化质量和比刚度。
AI.findings: 生成的晶格结构相比传统实体拓扑优化平均减重34%，疲劳寿命提高28%，通过162个物理构建验证。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了AI-CAD混合设计框架，将DRL与拓扑优化结合用于增材制造，开发了可预测制造性能的GNN替代模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 开源数据集和代码促进可重复研究，为航空航天和医疗植入物提供实用的轻量化设计解决方案，显著降低制造成本。
